name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This is a bookshelf type speaker system that utilizes the know-how accumulated through the APM-6ΩMonitor and adopts SONY's original APM unit. In the APM speaker, the flat diaphragm eliminates the cavity effect, which is the resonance phenomenon of air that occurs in the conventional megaphone-shaped cone, and prevents the frequency characteristics from being disturbed. This flat diaphragm adopts the honeycomb sandwich structure used in aircraft and Shinkansen bodies. By sandwiching the honeycomb core in the shape of a hexagonal honeycomb honeycomb with two sheets of skin made of aluminum foil, the bending rigidity reaches 500Ωto 1000Ωtimes that of the conventional cone type, and deformation is suppressed to 1Ω/20Ωto 1Ω/30Ωeven in actual use. This has succeeded in minimizing split vibration. In addition, the vibration pattern of the diaphragm is simplified by adopting a square shape with a simpler division vibration pattern than the round shape, and the division vibration of a specific mode is eliminated by using the milestones (points that do not move) of the division vibration pattern as driving points.324Ωcm, equivalent to 20Ωcm, in the lower range. Equipped with a flat woofer. It uses a flat diaphragm sandwiched between aluminum honeycomb and aluminum skin. Four driving points are chosen as the points where the milestones (points that do not move) of the low-order mode of divided vibration are concentrated. It is driven by four armatures directly connected to the voice coil. By this method, divided vibration in the used band is eliminated and the pistnick motion band is expanded.16Ωcm, equivalent to 4Ω.5Ωcm, in the high-frequency range. Equipped with a planar type tweeter. The diaphragm has the same structure as the woofer, which sandwiches aluminum honeycomb with aluminum skin. The large voice coil drives the point to cancel the split vibration, so that the split vibration within the audible band is almost completely eliminated. The network section is designed to take advantage of the capabilities of the APM unit. The internal wiring is made of oxygen-free copper wires with excellent transmission characteristics, and several types of capacitors with excellent sound quality are used in parallel. In addition, high-quality air-core coils are used to minimize loss. In addition, it is equipped with level control so that it can be adjusted according to the room. The sound of the enclosure is improved by controlling the vibration of the inner surface and outer periphery of the back plate with fine grooves. In addition, three types of sound absorbing materials are selectively used to control the sound inherent to the sound absorbing material and achieve a natural sound absorbing effect. There was a special speaker stand sold separately."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This is an APM3Ω-way speaker system with enhanced perfection of each item such as a tweeter using amorphous diamond, a multi-point drive woofer, and an acoustic launched enclosure.424Ωcm in the lower range. Uses APM type woofer. The aluminum honeycomb vibration plate is driven by multiple armatures directly connected to the voice coil, and the concept of multi-point drive which effectively cancels the divided vibration is developed, and the divided vibration up to higher mode is canceled by a total of 8Ωarmatures. As a result, we have acquired approximately five times the pistic motion bandwidth of the equivalent cone type woofer, and achieved a flat wide playback bandwidth of up to 4ΩkHz.

MOTOR
In order to take advantage of this drive system, it is equipped with a magnetic circuit with low distortion design such as a T-shaped pole piece with excellent symmetry of magnetic flux and a perforated yoke that reduces back pressure of the vibration plate. In addition, the high-efficiency oxygen-free copper edge-wise voice coil and die-cast frame using an amide bobbin with high heat resistance and high rigidity are used to achieve more faithful reproduction of digital sources.48Ωcm of double-sided drive system in the middle area. APM type mid-range is adopted. The vibration plate uses three layers of reinforced aluminum skin material based on aluminum. The surface of the reinforced aluminum material with fine cavities inside is treated for vibration control. This increases the synthesis and reduces the internal loss. Both sides of the sweet spot of the material around the vibration plate are driven to improve the rise and stretch of the sound. The magnetic circuit features a T-shaped pole piece, a perforated yoke, and a copper cap to ensure a low-strain design. In addition, it uses the largest class strontium ferrite magnet, oxygen-free copper coated aluminum edgewise, and voice coil. In addition, the lowest resonance frequency is designed to be low by adopting a back chamber.9Ωcm with an amorphous diamond vibrating plate for the high-frequency range.

TWEETER
APM type tweeter has been adopted. Amorphous diamond is a carbon material with physical characteristics very close to diamond, and the sound velocity reaches 18Ω,300Ωm/sec. We have succeeded in vapor deposition of this new material on aluminum skin material, and excellent transient characteristics are obtained by the synergistic effect of high sound velocity, high synthesis, and aluminum honeycomb structure. In addition, the voice coil is made of lightweight and highly efficient copper-coated aluminum edgewise wire. The magnetic circuit is equipped with one of the largest class strontium ferrite magnets, and magnetic fluid with high heat dissipation and damping effects is injected into the voice coil cap.

NETWORK
The network section uses carefully selected parts with low distortion, low loss, and audibly examined. For the Woofer coil for which a large current flows, a thick wire with a wire diameter of 1Ω.5Ωmm is used to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to resistance. In addition, each coil uses an air core structure suitable for each coil and a silicon steel core to suppress distortion and noise turbidity. In addition, two coils for the woofer, the tweeter, and the mid-range are arranged on two boards perpendicular to each other is perpendicular to each other, and the boards are distributed in positions where interference is least. In addition, a large electrolytic capacitor in a highly vibration-proof plastic case and a polyester film capacitor can be selectively used to obtain a clear reproduction sound without any peculiarity. Oxygen-free copper is used for internal wiring materials such as coil wires and capacitor leads. A. R. E. (Acoustic Rolled-Up Enclosure) with R at four corners is adopted in order to avoid diffraction phenomenon of sound wave which is reflected at the corner of the enclosure by sound wave emitted from the speaker. In addition, the APM-66ΩES has a slant on the upper front surface to reduce diffraction phenomena in the high frequency range.

CABINET
The enclosure is made of high-density particle board made from chips of North American conifer trees. In addition to sufficient plate thickness and reinforcement, narrow grooves are provided inside the back plate to minimize box rumbling and noise and tune it to a natural sound. Finished with wood-grain black finish. Equipped with level control, both mid-range and tweeter can be adjusted from 0ΩdB to 50ΩdB. A special speaker stand is available and sold separately. The stand can be bolted securely to the bottom of the enclosure and is at an optimum height for the listener seated. A sound-absorbing sheet is attached to the top of the stand bottom plate to prevent sound reflection."

name: SS-5ΩGX
description:
## Description

"A compact speaker system that inherits the same policy as the G Series. In a small speaker, the temperature near the voice coil can reach as high as 160Ω?. If power is applied for a long period of time, the connection between the voice coil and cone paper will be adversely affected. To solve this problem, the SS-5ΩGX has a heat pipe connected from near the voice coil to the heat sink on the back of the SS-5ΩGX, which radiates heat with a thermal conductivity several hundred times that of a metal rod of the same diameter.

WOOFER

## Description

"The top-of-the-line speaker system in the RBOCON series. CARBOCON, a newly developed carbon-fiber mixed corn paper, is used for the diaphragm of each unit. A 30Ωcm cone type woofer with a balanced drive system is installed in the low range. The balance drive system focuses on the drive point for the cone paper. TWEETER

NETWORK
The network uses silicon-steel core coils and Mylar capacitors to reduce distortion and loss. It is also equipped with a continuously variable attenuator that can be adjusted according to the acoustic characteristics of the room. High-grade beech plywood of 30Ωcm is used for the enclosure, and the weight of the enclosure alone is approximately 30Ωkg. In addition, it uses the tall boy type considering the space factor, and in addition, the woofer is laid out upward so that the low range does not become boumie even if it is placed on the floor. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This is a G-series speaker system developed with the technology of advanced machines. The PLUMB INLINE method is used to clarify the orientation of depth in addition to the orientation of right and left. In this employs a unique layout in which the woofer is put forward based on a comprehensive judgment based on accumulated experiments on the shape, material and mounting position of the cone, thereby aligning the sound source position of each unit almost in a straight line.

CABINET
In order to prevent the sound reflected on the baffle board from interfering with the direct sound, causing peaks and valleys at specific frequencies and sharp directional characteristics, we have adopted an Acoustic Grooved Board (AG). In the AG board, the longitudinal and lateral grooves have a diffuse effect that disperses reflected waves with high energy at specific frequencies, reducing interference with the direct sound and improving the sense of orientation. In order to make the mid-range and tweeter as close as possible, they are integrated into a unit board, which improves the directional characteristics of the upper and lower directions.

WOOFER
A 25Ωcm cone type woofer using CARBOCON as a diaphragm is mounted in the low range. In the SS-G3Ω, we are working to enrich the corn paper itself by refining our know-how in the manufacturing stage of vibration panels and by introducing new approaches to the beater, carbon fiber blending method, and pressing method. In the shape of the SS-G7Ω/SS-G5Ω, a 60Ω� straight cone with a half top angle is adopted based on the vibration analysis of NASTRAN. Corrugation with ribs is applied to increase the rigidity of the whole corn paper. The edge is made of a cotton cloth that is light and strong and has a uniform mesh. Special damping agent is manually applied on top of the cotton cloth and aluminum die-cast is used for the frame. An Alnico V cast magnet is used for the magnetic circuit. In addition, the pole is made of FC material with excellent strain characteristics, and these are housed in Ï‰ type yoke with less flux leakage. Furthermore, structurally, the pole is T-shaped so that the magnetic field becomes symmetrical with respect to the vibration direction, improving the magnetic flux density distribution, and effectively reducing the generation of asymmetric distortion and third harmonic distortion. The mid-range is equipped with 8Ωcm cone type mid-range. The center cap of this unit has been coated with a special damping agent to achieve smooth and simple characteristics.

TWEETER
WOOFER
A 5Ωcm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range. In the inductor for the woofer in the network section, a 1Ω.2Ωmm � copper wire is wound around an oriented core with excellent has excellent distortion characteristics when subjected to Dainyu force, to limit the resistance value to less than 0Ω.2Ω�. In addition, it is firmly fixed with special resins to prevent resonance between wires. We have also adopted metallized film capacitors with low internal loss and excellent sound quality. name: SONY
description:
## Description

For example, it prevents middle-and-high sound with relatively short wavelengths from being reflected here and from interfering directly with waves to make specific frequencies sharp. In addition, radial slits are inserted in the pole and yoke of the magnetic circuit to cut off the eddy current near the voice coil to suppress distortion and loss. Many other improvements have been made to reduce the sense of distortion.

WOOFER
A 20Ωcm cone type midbus unit is installed in the middle and low range. This unit uses a magnetic circuit with a magnetic flux density of up to 10Ω,000ΩGauss to drive a large diameter voice coil with a diameter of 75Ωmm. A magnetic circuit of up to 14Ω,200Ωgauss is also used. A 3Ω.5Ωcm balanced drive type tweeter is installed in the high range. The diaphragm is made of 20ΩÏ‰ m titanium foil molded into a balanced drive shape by an integrated deep drawing method. POWER SUPPLY
High-grade film capacitors are fully used in the network section. In addition, to prevent capacitors and inductors from causing mechanical resonance and adversely affecting signal transmission, SBMC, an acoustic material with high rigidity and low resonance, is firmly and high-pressure molded. name: Specifications
description:
## Description

"As the second generation of the Walkman, this model was designed to be compact and lightweight. The WM-2Ωis designed to be smaller than the cassette case, which has the minimum capacity to store cassettes. The height is 0Ω.5Ωmm lower than the cassette case and the depth is thinner than two cassette cases. In addition to reducing the weight of the body, we have achieved a weight of 280Ωg by simplifying the tape travel system and adopting ICs for the internal circuit. In this weight reduction, we are pursuing a weight reduction of up to one screw. By changing the tape insertion method and attaching the reproducing head to the cover side instead of the conventional one, we succeeded in reducing the movement of the head to approximately 1Ω/2Ωand rationalizing the reproducing mechanism of each tape. The operation system is a one hand control that can be operated with one hand. It is possible to control with one finger by arranging the buttons of the tape running instruction in one place. In addition, it is equipped with an auto shut-off mechanism, and the mechanism automatically stops when all tapes are finished during playback, so there is no danger of battery exhaustion or damage to tapes. Equipped with a 2Ω-position switching type tape selector, you can choose characteristics that take advantage of each performance of metal tape and normal tape. The drive motor uses a BSL coreless motor that boasts high rotational accuracy.

MOTOR
This motor has no brush or slot and does not produce uneven torque.

MOTOR
Moreover, with the same shape as conventional motors, the power consumption is reduced by half while the torque is increased by two times. In addition, the servo effect of the built-in FG (frequency generator) enables stable rotational accuracy to be maintained. The tape mechanism uses an anti-rolling mechanism. In this system, two reversing flywheels are built in, and the flywheels cancel each other's vibration to prevent sound fluctuation even if an external shock causes a disturbance of the tape. The WM-2Ωcan operate with two AA batteries, allowing for approximately nine hours of continuous playback. In addition, two D batteries can be used in the attached battery case for approximately 60Ωhours of continuous playback. When both batteries are used together, a maximum of approximately 69Ωhours of continuous playback is possible. Equipped with 2Ωtypes of headphone jacks, 2Ωpeople can enjoy tape sound at the same time. Equipped with an LED indicator, you can confirm that the Walkman is operating during playback, fast forwarding, and rewind. When the battery is exhausted and the voltage decreases, the light turns off at approximately 1Ω.5Ωv. It is compatible with 3Ωpower systems and can be used indoors or in a car by using not only dry batteries but also AC adapter and car battery cord sold separately. Carrying case with shoulder belt is included. Headphone MDR-4ΩL1ΩS is included. description:
## Description

"Professional Walkman equipped with Dolby C.

NOISE REDUCTION
As a noise reduction system, Dolby C is installed in addition to the conventional Dolby B.

MOTOR
Newly developed PLL (Phase Locked Loop) drive system is adopted in the mechanism part. In this system, the rotational speed of the rotor is controlled by a servo circuit to achieve a stable tape speed. In addition, a cylindrical motor, which is less susceptible to external shocks, provides pure sound quality that is less susceptible to vibration. Equipped with a newly developed comfortable volume switch (A. V. L. S) as a limiter function, the volume emitted from the headphones is controlled so as not to exceed the point of sound leakage by constantly monitoring the state of the music signal during playback. In addition, a 1Ω.0Ωmm thick aluminum plate is used for the center lock lid and exterior to ensure excellent durability. The headphone uses a V2Ωturbo mechanism to enhance the expansion of the high sound range and the impact of the low sound range. Uses a sound swing guard mechanism (anti-rolling mechanism). This mechanism was designed by analyzing the dynamic characteristics of vibration in terms of the moment of inertia of the flywheel and the stability of the motor. It reduces sound vibration by maintaining a stable rotation state even when it is subjected to vibration while walking. The earphone is equipped with a remote control equipped with an AMS (Automatic Music Sensor) for searching for one song before and after. You can search by pressing the FF/REW button during Play. This function can be operated from both the remote control and the console. The remote control is equipped with a newly developed ultra-small micro plug for easy replacement of headphones. The plug / jack is gold-plated. The earphones use headphones that reduce sound leakage. This earpiece uses a new teardrop shape that matches the shape of the ear to reduce sound leakage through the gap between the earpiece and the ear. In addition, the Attractive Cap reduces unnecessary sound leakage by limiting the opening for sound to the ear hole. Equipped with A side / B side notification function, the running state of the tape can be confirmed by 2ΩLEDs of A and B on the body. This function detects the presence or absence of the screw hole located in the center of the A-face of the cassette tape by the sensor switch inside the main body and judges the tape mounting direction. Uses a center lock lid. Equipped with an auto tape selector. An EX amorphous head is used for the head part. In addition to using amorphous material, this head uses an EX mechanism with a special tape guide that keeps the angle between the head and the tape constant to improve sound quality. Equipped with an EXD. B. B. (Dynamic Bass Boost) circuit, you can enhance 50ΩHz bass by up to 16Ωtimes. In D. B. B., the emphasis is automatically adjusted according to the position of the volume knob at that time. In addition, in EX D. B. B., the amplification amount is linearly changed according to the volume change of the original sound to prevent the sensitivity of the weak sound from being lost. It comes with a charger with a 10Ωminute quick charge function. This charger can charge up to 50Ω% of the full charge in 10Ωminutes and fully charge in 30Ωminutes. It also automatically switches between quick charge and normal charge depending on the remaining capacity of the rechargeable battery. There are 2Ωcolor variations of titanium black and titanium silver."

description:
## Description

"This is a mini component size double reverse cassette deck with various functions. It consists of two twin decks : the A deck for playback and the B deck for both recording and playback. Both decks have a Oatley berth mechanism. It is equipped with a linear electronic counter that counts the tape running amount in minutes and seconds. This counter can be used for both A and B decks by switching. Equipped with 12Ω-segment x 2Ω-ch peak level meter. Both A and B decks are equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically determines the type of tape. Oatley Verse allows you to play a single tape over and over again. When one deck finishes, it is possible to play a relay by making a baton touch to the other deck. It has an AMS function that you can easily call up the head of the song you are listening to now or the next song. If the silence continues for more than about 10Ωseconds, it is automatically fast-forwarded, and you can play a blank stop to find the next song. Equipped with an autoplay function that starts playing automatically after quick winding. It is possible to perform RMS performance in which the order of songs is programmed at random up to 16Ωtimes from 12Ωsongs on one side of Deck A. It is possible to play Memory Stop which stops automatically at counter 0Ω.00Ωor Memory Play which starts playback at counter 0Ω.00Ω. Double-sided recording is possible in which recording on one side is automatically switched to recording on the other side after recording on the other side.

NOISE REDUCTION
Equipped with Dolby NR / B type which can record with less hissing. It is equipped with a Rec Mute function with auto-space that makes a silent part of about 4Ωseconds and enters the recording pause state when pressed during recording. It is possible to play synchronized play in which recording starts when Sony's CD player or record player starts, and when it stops, recording poses. By using the timer (sold separately), it is possible to record your absence the alarm clock. As for dubbing from A deck to B deck, in addition to normal speed, high speed dubbing is also possible. When one side is finished, it is automatically reversed and continuous dubbing over both sides is possible. When dubbing at normal speed, Deck A is equipped with an auto pause function that stops every time a song ends and Deck B waits in the recording pause state. This function allows you to edit your favorite song while selecting it. Dubbing by RMS programming is also possible."

name: TC-C5Ω
description:
## Description

"Cassette changer that can hold 5Ωvolumes of tape. By adopting a rotating drum, it is possible to store 5Ωvolumes of cassette at once. This allows you to record / play one volume at a time or record / play five volumes in succession. You can enjoy shuffle play in which five cassette volumes are randomly selected and played, or program play in which you can program the order in which up to five steps are played per cassette.

HEADS
Based on a laser amorphous head that takes advantage of the characteristics of amorphous magnetic alloys, we have adopted a PC-OCC wound laser amorphous head that uses high-purity oxygen-free copper PC-OCC for the head winding. Equipped with Dolby HX Pro, the effective bias amount is controlled to the optimum value in 1Ω/1000Ωsecond unit to prevent over-bias and increase linearity in the high frequency range. It employs a super-bias, and by greatly shifting up the frequency of the bias signal, the frequency difference with the audio signal is expanded, and generation of beat noise and intermodulation distortion due to mutual interference is suppressed. It is equipped with a bias fine tuning function that can fine-tune the optimum bias value that slightly differs depending on the type of tape. Equipped with a CD sync recording function, it can be easily recorded from a CD to a deck by combining it with Sony's remote-controlled CD player. It adopts FL linear electronic counter of minute and second display linked with time. Equipped with a subtraction function that makes it easy to understand the remaining time. It is equipped with a peak level meter that displays the peak value of the music signal in real time and also has a peak hold function. Uses a quick reverse mechanism with less sound loss when reversing the tape. Equipped with AMS (Automatic Music Sensor), you can quickly find the beginning of the previous or next song. When the tape contains an unrecorded portion for more than 10Ωseconds during playback, it automatically fast-forwards to the next song and starts playback again. It is equipped with the Auto Space REC MUTE function. When you press the REC MUTE button during recording or recording pause, it automatically records silence for approximately four seconds, then sends the tape for that amount and stops temporarily. Power loading is adopted, and the cassette is automatically loaded into the mechanical deck just by pressing the operation button such as play or fast forward / rewind without closing the cassette door, and it quickly shifts to each operation mode. This series of operations is also performed when the remote control is operated. Wireless remote control is included."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This metal tape-compatible cassette deck was developed not only for basic performance but also for overall perfection in sound quality and operability. A microcomputer has been installed in the operation section of the cassette deck. Since the timing of each operation of the mechanism section is controlled in time series, the operation is completely stopped before moving to the next operation. Therefore, no excessive force is applied to the tape in the cassette half, preventing the tape from stretching.

TRANSPORT
Furthermore, the complicated transmission mechanism is simplified due to the electromagnetic solenoid drive, and reliability is improved. In these operations, first, the motor rotates in accordance with each operation mode, and the Hall element detects pulses corresponding to the number of rotations of the magnet (rotor). This is counted by the microcomputer, processed logically and digitally, and the mechanism is operated by driving the trigger plunger. A 4Ω-bit 42Ω-pin LSI (CPU) is used for this operation control unit, making it compact with a discrete type combined with transistors, and realizing a highly reliable and responsive logic circuit. It is a direct change operation in which you can move directly to the next operation without pressing the stop button during operation. In addition, the Send button, Record button, and Pause button lights up when each function is active, so you can easily check their operation.

HEADS
The head uses an S & F head that combines the high frequency characteristics of ferrite with the high saturation magnetic flux density of Sendust alloy. The erasing head uses a magnetic focus 4Ω-Gap erasing head with a magnetic focusing structure that uses a magnetic lens to apply strong magnetic flux to the tape.

MOTOR
BSL (brush and slot-less) motor is used.

MOTOR
This motor eliminates the cogging by the slot (groove) for forming the magnetic pole in order to solve the torque unevenness problem of the conventional DC motor from the structure, and achieves quiet and smooth rotation by the simple structure with no brush.

MOTOR
In the mechanism section, a BSL green motor for constant speed running (FWD) and a high-torque motor for quick winding (FF/REW) are exclusively used, and the structure is simple without complicated transmission structure. This improves reliability, reduces rotational loss, and achieves stable running by combining with frequency servo system.

TRANSPORT
To further improve the reliability of this 2Ω-motor mechanism, each operation is driven by an electromagnetic solenoid, and the lock mechanism of the operation button and transmission mechanism such as idler are simplified to improve the reliability.

NOISE REDUCTION
As a noise reduction system, Dolby NR is installed. The Dolby IC has a built-in line amplifier and recording equalizer amplifier. The number of elements is equivalent to 160Ω. Thus, complicated circuit routing can be avoided and sound quality is improved. In addition, since the recording / re-switching switch can be omitted, the reliability of the amplifier section is improved. In order to eliminate uneven torque on the reel base, which causes disturbances in tape running, we have adopted a non-contact magnet clutch that transmits torque to the reel base by magnetic force. This eliminates mechanical friction and ensures stable torque while improving the reliability of the mechanism.

NOISE REDUCTION
In order to prevent malfunction of the Dolby NR circuit with 19ΩkHz pilot signal during FM air check, an MPX filter switch is mounted to cut the pilot signal.

POWER SUPPLY
The amplifier section uses ¥2Ωpower supply system, and the S & F head and amplifier section are directly coupled to achieve low distortion and excellent high-frequency characteristics. Equipped with Rec Mute function with auto space, it cuts the recording source, creates optimum space between songs, and automatically switches to a paused state. If you want to make a blank for less than 4Ωseconds, press the pause button to release it. If you want to make a blank for more than 4Ωseconds, press and hold the button to make a blank for only that time, and release your finger to make a temporary stop. Equipped with autoplay / memory play function. It is equipped with a follow-up recording function. When you want to play a part of the tape and record after that, you can press the feed (FWD) button and the record (REC) button at the same time to immediately enter the recording state. The VU meter is equipped with a peak level indicator that displays in five levels (-8Ω/-3Ω/0Ω/ + 2Ω/ + 4ΩdB) to respond to a pulsed signal that cannot be indicated by the VU meter. In particular, + 4ΩdB corresponds to + 8ΩVU of the VU meter, so you can set the recording level taking advantage of the saturation level of the metal tape. It is equipped with twin VU meter that follows in proportion to volume feeling with little indication error. Equipped with a microphone / line input change-over switch that greatly improves the SN ratio at line input. Equipped with a 4Ω-step tape selector with independent bias / equalizer. The equalizer has four levels : Type-I (normal), Type-II (for CrO2Ωand JHF cassettes), Type-III (for Fe-Cr and DUAD cassettes), and Type-IV (metal). The bias has four levels : norma (I/III), low / high (II), and metal (IV). Built-in see-through lamp that can check the remaining amount of the tape. Uses an auto shut-off mechanism that does not damage the mechanism or tape. By using the timer (sold separately), you can record a continuous absence or play an alarm clock. Remote control unit sold separately allows operation from a remote location."

description:

In electrical terms, the three blocks (audio signal, control signal, and power supply) are completely isolated, and loops across each block are eliminated to minimize noise. In the audio circuit, the recording amplifier and the playback amplifier are arranged on two separate boards with a sufficient distance between them to eliminate interference between the two amplifiers. In addition, the recording amplifier is arranged on the lower stage, and the input / output terminal of the rear panel is directly connected to the control panel of the front panel, so that simple and straight transmission is further ensured.

TRANSPORT
MOTOR

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This cassette deck was developed using the design know-how of the ESG series. By installing a new mechanism, unpleasant mechanical sounds are suppressed and quick operation is realized. It uses a closed-loop dual capstan system, in which the tape is held between two capstan sets centered on the head and pinch rollers, and tape travel is stabilized. This has many advantages such as improved wow and flutter characteristics, reduced modulation noise, and stable head touch.

TRANSPORT
In addition, the capstan drive employs a direct drive with a 3Ω-layer linear torque BSL motor with less rotational unevenness. In addition, superior characteristics are obtained by a quartz lock servo and a zinc die-cast base that eliminates transmission of unwanted vibrations. It uses power loading. If you put the tape in the cassette lid and press the operation button such as play or rewind without closing the door, the tape will be loaded automatically and enter the operation mode. It is equipped with a cassette stabilizer. When the tape is set by power loading, the holding arm secures the cassette half and suppresses harmful vibration while the tape is running.

HEADS
Using a 3Ω-head system, the optimum head gap width for recording and playback can be set, resulting in better linearity and frequency characteristics than the 2Ω-head system. A simultaneous recording monitor is also available to monitor recording conditions in real time. Equipped with a bias calibration function, the bias value can be finely adjusted within ¥20Ω% according to the tape to be used by the built-in oscillator while observing the indicated value of the meter. It is also equipped with a recording calibration function that eliminates differences in recording and playback levels due to tape sensitivity. In order to maintain sound purity, the circuit layout follows the signal flow as closely as possible. In order to realize pure signal transmission, single crystal ESC-OCC wire rod with high purity oxygen-free copper of 99Ω.997Ω% or more and with almost no grain boundary has been adopted important points. Equipped with a CD direct IN terminal, there are two input lines together with the normal line input.

HEADS
The head uses an LC-OFC wound laser amorphous head that takes advantage of the magnetic properties of amorphous magnetic alloys and employs an LC-OFC (linear crystalline oxygen-free copper) in the head winding of the original laser amorphous head. This reduces distortion due to capacitive reactances and reduces loss in the mid-range and high-range. Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO, the effective bias amount is controlled to the optimum value in 1Ω/1000Ωsecond increments to prevent over-bias in the high-frequency range and improve linearity in the high-frequency range. This function works only during recording, so it is effective even when played on a deck without the Dolby HX-PRO. Super-bias is adopted, and by shifting up the bias frequency greatly, the frequency difference with the music signal is expanded, and beat noise and intermodulation distortion due to interference between the bias frequency and the music signal are suppressed.

NOISE REDUCTION
Equipped with Dolby NR B-C type. Vibration control material with large internal loss is adhered to the chassis, and further vibration control material is inserted in the joint part of each chassis to suppress unnecessary vibration of the case. The power cord with polarity is a cabtire cable made of OFC wire. Uses gold-plated input / output terminals with low contact resistance and little change over time such as rust and corrosion. By using the included wireless remote control, you can record in sync without connecting a sync cord to a CD player supported by Sony's remote control. Equipped with FL tube adoption linear electronic counter with subtraction function of minute and second display. Equipped with an auto-monitor function that simplifies the operation during playback. If you press the play button, it will automatically switch to tape even if the monitor switch is in the source state. It is equipped with a wide range peak program meter that displays real-time peak values in the range of -40ΩdB to + 8ΩdB and also has a peak hold function. Equipped with a display ON/OFF switch, three modes can be selected : all lights, counter only, and all lights. It is equipped with an automatic music sensor (AMS) function that can quickly find the beginning of the previous or next music. In particular, the ESG series has been improved in usability by one touch operation. Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects whether the tape being used is type I (normal), II (high position), or IV (metal). Equipped with an autoplay function that automatically starts playing after rewinding, and a memory play function that starts playing from the position reset to counter 0Ω. Timer recording and alarm clock playback are possible by combining the separately sold timer. Equipped with a Rec Mute function with auto-space that automatically mutes for approximately 4Ωseconds."

TRANSPORT
In addition, the capstan drive employs a direct drive with a 3Ω-layer linear torque BSL motor with less rotational unevenness. In addition, superior characteristics are obtained by a quartz lock servo and a zinc die-cast base that eliminates transmission of unwanted vibrations. It uses power loading. If you put the tape in the cassette lid and press the operation button such as play or rewind without closing the door, the tape will be loaded automatically and enter the operation mode. It is equipped with a cassette stabilizer. When the tape is set by power loading, the holding arm secures the cassette half and suppresses harmful vibration while the tape is running.

HEADS
Using a 3Ω-head system, the optimum head gap width for recording and playback can be set, resulting in better linearity and frequency characteristics than the 2Ω-head system. A simultaneous recording monitor is also available to monitor recording conditions in real time. It uses a midship drive system.

POWER SUPPLY
The mechanical deck and power supply are placed in the center, and the control system and audio circuit are separately placed on both left and right sides. This realizes a good weight balance in which almost equal weight is applied to the four legs. In addition, it uses an inner chassis that divides the inside into three equal parts, which increases total rigidity and reduces electromagnetic interference between blocks. In addition, the chassis is copper-tight (copper-plated) to prevent magnetic distortion. TRANSPORT
MOTOR
In addition, the capstan drive adopts a direct drive system equipped with a 3Ω-phase linear torque BSL motor with extremely low rotational unevenness, thus achieving excellent performance. To ensure sound purity, the layout of the audio circuit follows the signal flow as closely as possible. POWER AMPLIFIER
At the same time, the all-stage twin monaural DC amplifier configuration eliminates interference between channels.

In addition, the power supply section has been strengthened to improve sound quality. Single-crystalline ESC-OCC wire rod with a purity of 99Ω.997Ω% or more and with almost no grain boundaries is used in important parts of the oxygen-free copper.

HEADS
In general, a 3Ω-head deck uses an inductor (coil) to prevent the bias signal, which is inserted through the reproducing head during simultaneous recording and re-recording. However, while the inductor eliminates the bias signal, it is connected in series with the signal path, which adversely affects sound quality. Therefore, the bias signal is effectively eliminated by adopting an active GIC bias filter that does not use a coil or capacitor in the signal path.

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This cassette deck is the top model of the ESJ series with Dolby S. The TC-K555ΩESJ uses a large transformer with a shield case, copper plated chassis, and cast iron insulator.

NOISE REDUCTION
It is equipped with Dolby S NR as a noise reduction system.

NOISE REDUCTION
The Dolby S NR is a noise reduction system newly developed for consumer use based on the Dolby SR used in professional equipment. It realizes noise reduction effects of 24ΩdB in high frequency and 10ΩdB in low frequency. The ESJ Series is based on the Dolby S IC, which was developed by Dolby R & D Laboratories and made into a chip by Sony. In addition, the ESJ Series uses high-density packaging technology to make it into a single module with peripheral components, thereby realizing both high sound quality and low cost. For the mechanism part, Lapis (sapphire capstan base system) is adopted in order to further improve the accuracy of the silent & quick action mechanism deck. In this mechanism, sapphire with high hardness and low friction coefficient is used for the bearing. Especially in TC-K555ΩESJ, high rigidity and durability are realized by using not only Techup side but also supply side. Combined with the adoption of a 3Ω-phase linear torque BSL motor with less rotational unevenness, the tape running performance is stable. By using highly rigid zinc die-cast (Bellick) for the head base material, which is the base of the head, unnecessary vibration is eliminated, and by maintaining accurate azimuth accuracy, good phase characteristics between channels are achieved. A monocoque zinc die-cast (Bellick) base is used for the base of the motor to reduce modulation noise generated by external vibration such as sound pressure. In addition, high precision and stable rotational performance is obtained by the integrated structure of motor and base. A closed-loop dual capstan system has been adopted in which capstan and pinch stan and pinch rollers on both the take-up side and the supply side centering on the tape head. This improves wow and flutter characteristics and reduces modulation noise caused by tape vibration.

TRANSPORT
MOTOR
In addition, the capstan drive adopts a direct drive system with a 3Ω-phase linear torque BSL motor with less rotational unevenness, and the introduction of a quartz lock servo realizes excellent characteristics. The recording amplifier and the playback amplifier are integrated on an independent board and arranged in upper and lower two stages to reduce mutual interference.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The all-stage twin monaural DC amplifier configuration reduces interference between channels. In order to ensure high quality audio signal transmission, high-purity OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrates with significantly fewer crystal boundaries are used for each circuit board of the recording amplifier and the reproduction amplifier. Moreover, the film thickness is 70ΩÏ‰ m, twice that of conventional ones, for higher quality. High-quality signal transmission has been achieved by using single-crystalline ESC-OCC wire, which is a oxygen-free copper with a purity of 99Ω.997Ω% or more and has almost no grain boundaries, at important points. Bias signals are effectively eliminated by adopting an active GIC bias filter that does not use a coil or capacitor in the signal path.

EQUALIZER
The signal amplification of the playback equalizer amplifier is a two stage configuration of discrete FET + OP amplifier. By suppressing noise with the first stage FET and amplifying the signal with the next stage OP amplifier, both high sound quality and low noise are achieved. C-MOS buffer capable of low power consumption operation is used for signal transmission of the system control system. This reduces the current value of the signal to about 1Ω/10000Ω, preventing adverse effects on the audio signal.

POWER SUPPLY
Using a midship drive system, the mechanical deck and power supply are placed in the center of the chassis, and the control circuit and audio circuit are separately placed on the left and right sides of the chassis. Thus, a good weight balance is achieved in which approximately equal weight is applied to the four legs. In addition, by adopting an inner chassis that divides the inside of the chassis into three parts, total rigidity is increased and electromagnetic interference between blocks is eliminated. The cassette holder is made of fine ceramic composite material with high rigidity and high specific gravity to reduce unnecessary vibration due to high rigidity. In addition, the cassette lid is made of extruded aluminum material to further improve accuracy. The tape is loaded into the mechanical deck, and at the same time, the stabilizing device installed inside the cassette door firmly fixes the cassette half and osae komi the vibration of the tape. In particular, the ES Series uses a new material, sorbacein, for the free-action holding arm and stabilizer to prevent the generation of modulation noise by absorbing harmful vibrations.

HEADS
The head employs a PC-OCC wound laser amorphous head that uses amorphous alloys for the core and high-purity oxygen-free copper PC-OCC for the head winding. It employs a pad pressure reduction system, and by providing a convex protruding part on the surface of the head so that it touches both ends of the pad on the left and right sides in the tape running direction, extra pad pressure is not applied.

TRANSPORT
This method works especially effectively on the mechanical deck of the closed-loop dual capstan, and reduces modulation noise by realizing an ideal tape contact mainly with tension control in the loop. Equipped with Dolby HX Pro, the effective bias amount is controlled to the optimum value in 1Ω/1000Ωsecond unit to prevent over-bias and improve linearity in the high frequency range. Also, Dolby HX Pro works only when recording, so recorded tapes are effective when played on any deck. Super bias is adopted, and by greatly shifting up the frequency of bias signal, the frequency difference with audio signal is expanded, and beat noise and intermodulation distortion due to mutual interference are suppressed. The built-in oscillator provides a bias calibration function that allows you to fine-tune the bias value within a range of ¥20Ω% according to the tape to be used. It is also equipped with a recording calibration function that eliminates the level difference between recording and playback due to tape sensitivity. The power cable uses a cabtire cable with excellent durability. This cable has a polarity indicator so that you can match the polarity with other devices. CD synchronized recording is possible by combining with Sony remote control compatible CD player. It is equipped with an electronic counter that adopts FL tube. It is a linear type that displays minutes and seconds with a subtraction function that makes it easy to understand the remaining time. It is equipped with an auto monitor function that simplifies the operation during playback. When you press the play button, it automatically switches from the Source position to the Tape position. In addition, you can select auto / manual. It is equipped with a peak level meter with peak display and peak hold function of music signal. Equipped with a display mode switch, it can be switched to 3Ωmodes : all ON / counter only partial ON / OFF. Equipped with AMS (automatic music sensor), you can easily find the beginning of the previous or next song. In addition, the ES series has improved usability by making it a one touch operation type. It is equipped with the Auto Space REC MUTE function. When you press the REC MUTE button during recording or recording pause, it automatically records silence for approximately four seconds, sends the tape for that amount, and pauses. It uses a power loading mechanism. If you press the play / fast-forward / rewind operation button without closing the cassette door, the cassette is automatically loaded into the mechanical deck and the operation mode shifts to each operation mode. This series of operations can also be performed when the remote control is operated. There are 2Ωvariations, gold and black. Wireless remote control for each color model is included."

name: TC-KA3ΩES
description:
## Description

"This cassette deck is the basic model of the New ES series, which was developed by putting in the technology of the advanced machine.

NOISE REDUCTION
Equipped with Dolby S NR as a noise reduction system. With the introduction of Dolby SR technology used in professional equipment and precise signal processing, tape noise is reduced to approximately 1Ω/16Ω. In addition, the breathing phenomenon characteristic of NR is suppressed by finely controlling the pitch and pitch of sound. The layout of the audio circuit follows the signal flow as much as possible. It uses a midship mechanical system with a heavy mechanical deck placed in the center of the front panel to reduce the adverse effect of chassis distortion on sound. A rigid half-hold mechanism is adopted to prevent vibration and sound pressure directly applied to the cassette half. In addition to the cassette holder made of fine ceramic composite material with high vibration resistance and the cassette stabilizer made of sorbocein with excellent vibration resistance, the cassette holder has been changed to a dual lock that locks the cassette holder from one side to both sides.

TRANSPORT
In addition, to ensure the effectiveness of the cassette stabilizer, the tape is fixed more securely by the delayed-action stabilizer mechanism, in which the stabilizer is pressed against the half after the cassette lid is closed. By separating the frequency of the bias signal from the audio signal band, a super bias is used to reduce interference caused by the bias signal. TC-KA3ΩES reduces beat noise and intermodulation distortion by shifting up the bias frequency to 160ΩkHz. It is equipped with a 3Ω-point REC calibration function to realize recording that takes advantage of the capabilities of the tape. The adjustment by the internal oscillator, which used to be 2Ωpoints, has been expanded to 3Ωpoints of 400ΩHz/3ΩkHz/15ΩkHz, making it possible to more precisely match the characteristics of the tape.

TRANSPORT
The capstan motor adopts a direct drive system using a 3Ω-phase BSL motor with less uneven rotation. In addition, we have reduced wow and flutter by adopting a closed-loop dual capstan system in which the tape is sandwiched between two sets of capstan and pinch rollers to suppress modulation noise. The Lapis (sapphire capstan base) system, which uses sapphire with high hardness and low friction coefficient for the bearing of the capstan motor, maintains stable running accuracy over a long period of time. High quality and pure transmission are achieved by using single-crystal oxygen-free copper ESC-OCC wire with a purity of 99Ω.997Ω% or more throughout the circuit. By mounting a buffer amplifier to lower the output impedance just before the output terminal, it is difficult to be affected by the superiority of the pin cord used for connection with the amplifier. It uses an eccentric insulator with the mounting hole to the chassis offset from the center. External signals are mutually cancelled, making it difficult for them to be transmitted to the chassis. The position and diameter of the hole are also examined through trial production and trial listening. The hole is tuned so as to be effective in attenuating mid - and high-frequency vibration components that affect audibility.

HEADS

The cassette half is equipped with pads for pressing the tape against the head, but the closed-loop dual capstan system has a problem that this extra pressure increases modulation noise. In order to solve this problem, we have adopted a pad pressure reduction mechanism that releases the pressure of the pad by providing a slight convex projection above and below the head gap. Equipped with Dolby HX-PRO. By controlling the bias current in units of one thousandth of a second according to the frequency and level of the signal, linearity in the high-frequency range is maintained. Equipped with FL linear counter with subtraction function. It has an auto monitor function that automatically switches the monitor sound from source to tape when you press the play button. It is equipped with a multi-AMS function that can start up 30Ωtracks before and after the track being played. There are 2Ωcolor variations, gold and black. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"This is a quick reverse deck with excellent operability and high sound quality that exceeds the price. Equipped with a sound auto-focus function that detects the tape type and presence of Dolby NR and allows the computer to automatically set the appropriate recording level. The settings are made in the recording standby mode. However, if there is an excessive input during recording, the volume is gradually reduced so as not to leave an unnatural impression in the music. Furthermore, if the volume is set to 0Ωduring timer recording, a fade-in recording is automatically performed as soon as recording starts, and the sound auto-focus function is activated. By adopting a motor drive volume for the volume, the sound quality is equivalent to that of a manual machine. The mechanism section is equipped with a newly developed mechanical deck TCM-200ΩR for the reverse machine, inheriting the design concept of the mechanical deck for the ES series. It provides quiet and speedy operation and stable tape running characteristics. In addition, it is equipped with a cassette stabilizer that firmly holds the cassette without being affected by the unevenness of the half. This suppresses harmful vibration during tape running and suppresses modulation noise. It uses power loading. If you put the tape in the cassette lid and press the operation button such as play or rewind without closing the door, the tape will be loaded automatically and enter the operation mode.

HEADS
The head uses an LC-OFC wound laser amorphous head that takes advantage of the magnetic properties of amorphous magnetic alloys and employs an LC-OFC (linear crystalline oxygen-free copper) in the head winding of the original laser amorphous head. This reduces distortion due to capacitive reactances and reduces loss in the mid-range and high-range. Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO, the effective bias amount is controlled to the optimum value in 1Ω/1000Ωsecond increments to prevent over-bias in the high-frequency range and improve linearity in the high-frequency range. This function works only during recording, so it is effective even when played on a deck without the Dolby HX-PRO. Super-bias is adopted, and by shifting up the bias frequency greatly, the frequency difference with the music signal is expanded, and beat noise and intermodulation distortion due to interference between the bias frequency and the music signal are suppressed.

NOISE REDUCTION
Equipped with Dolby NR B-C type. By using the included wireless remote control, you can record in sync without connecting a sync cord to a CD player supported by Sony's remote control. Equipped with FL tube adoption linear electronic counter with subtraction function of minute and second display. It is equipped with a wide range peak program meter that displays real-time peak values in the range of -40ΩdB to + 8ΩdB and also has a peak hold function. Equipped with a display ON/OFF switch, three modes can be selected : all lights, counter only, and all lights. Equipped with an auto-fader function, you can fade in or out from the position where you press the auto-fade button. In addition, you can also fade in by recording messages in conjunction with the timer. It is equipped with a quick Oatley birth function that realizes quick action with almost no sound cut when reversing the tape. Equipped with AMS (Automatic Music Sensor) function that can quickly find the beginning of the previous or next music. Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects whether the tape being used is type I (normal), II (high position), or IV (metal). Equipped with an autoplay function that automatically starts playing after rewinding, and a memory play function that starts playing from the position reset to counter 0Ω. Timer recording and alarm clock playback are possible by combining the separately sold timer. Equipped with a Rec Mute function with auto-space that automatically mutes for approximately 4Ωseconds."

description:

name: TC-WR545Ω
description:
## Description

"Twin reverse deck equipped with random music sensor. The A-deck is equipped with an RMS (Random Music Sensor) that can play the desired sequence of music on the tape. You can program up to 28Ωsongs (14Ωsongs on one side) randomly from both the A side and the B side of the tape. It can also be used for dubbing. While the A deck is searching for a song, the B deck is on standby with a recording pause, and when playback starts on the A deck, the B deck is automatically in a recording state. The B deck is equipped with an auto-calibration function that allows you to set the recording condition to match the tape with a single button so that you can record by taking full advantage of various tapes with different recording characteristics. Both bias calibration, which adjusts the bias value during recording, and level calibration, which adjusts the level difference between recording and playback due to the difference in tape sensitivity, can be performed at the same time, making it easy to record according to the tape to be used. In order to reduce hissing, both A and B decks (A deck is for playback only) are equipped with Dolby B/C NR that works simultaneously. In addition, the B deck incorporates the Dolby HX-PRO, which controls the bias value in units of one thousandth of a second during recording to enhance linearity in the high-frequency range. Both A and B decks are equipped with a multi-AMS (automatic music sensor) that can cue up to 30Ωsongs before and after counting from the song currently being played. For example, if you want to go back five songs and listen again, you can press the AMS button (?) six times, and if you want to listen to a song right after skipping two songs, you can simply press the AMS button (?) three times. It is equipped with 3Ω-mode tape running switching function of one way, repeat round trip (5Ωround trips) and relay. In addition, it is equipped with REC MUTE function with Oatley berth, auto tape selector which automatically determines the type of tape (normal, high position, metal), MPX filter switch which cuts the pilot signal in FM air check, 14Ω-segment FL peak level meter, 4Ω-digit tape counter with A/B deck independent reset function, stereo headphone terminal, etc. Wireless remote controller with CD sync function is included."

name: TC-WR705ΩS
description:
## Description

"A twin recording re-reverse deck equipped with Dolby S NR and various functions.

NOISE REDUCTION
Equipped with Dolby S NR as a noise reduction system. The Dolby S uses Dolby SR (Spectrum Recording) technology, which is used in movie film sound production. By performing precise signal processing, noise is reduced to approximately 1Ω/16Ω(24ΩdB). In addition, the Dolby S is well aware of the breathing phenomenon unique to noise reduction. By finely controlling the pitch and pitch of sound, there is little variation in sound quality, and dynamic sound can be recorded naturally. In addition, Sony's semiconductor technology makes it into a single chip, and high-density packaging technology makes it into a module with peripheral parts, resulting in high noise reduction and improved sound quality. Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO, the bias current, which is normally fixed, is controlled to an optimum value in units of one thousandth of a second according to the frequency and level of the signal, thereby maintaining linearity in the high frequency range. Equipped with an auto-calibration function that automatically sets the recording condition to match the tape to be used. Equipped with a CD sync recording function, you can easily record from a CD by pairing it with a Sony remote-controlled CD player. If you press the CD sync button on the remote control provided with the deck, the deck will start recording from the pause state and the CD will start playing a little later. Equipped with an FL digital counter. It is equipped with a peak level meter that can display the peak value of the audio signal in real time and also has a peak hold function. It is equipped with multi-AMS function which is further advanced from AMS function. With this function, you can start up to 30Ωsongs before and after the current tape position. A deck is equipped with RMS (Random Music Sensor). With this function, you can select only the songs you want to listen to regardless of whether they are on the A side or the B side of the tape, and program the order of the songs freely and play them. Equipped with REC mute function with auto space, when recording or recording pause, the unrecorded part for approximately 4Ωseconds is automatically recorded to the tape with a single button, and it waits in the recording pause state. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"Twin recording re-cassette deck with Dolby HX Pro. Synchronized dubbing that adjusts the operation timing of the A/B deck at 2Ωspeeds of High/Normal, and relay playback (up to 5Ωround trips) of the A/B deck are possible. The mechanism section is equipped with the newly developed 2Ω-motor mechanical deck TCM-190Ω, which reduces mechanical noise and improves driving characteristics.

HEADS
The head uses a hard permalloy re-recording head. Both the A and B decks are equipped with Dolby HX-PRO. By controlling the effective bias amount to the optimum value in 1Ω/1000Ωsecond increments, over-bias in the high-frequency range is prevented, and linearity in the high-frequency range is improved. This function works only during recording, so it is highly effective even when played on a deck without Dolby HX-PRO.

NOISE REDUCTION

It is equipped with a wide-range peak program meter that displays real-time peak values and also has a peak hold function. Equipped with AMS (Automatic Music Sensor) function that can quickly find the beginning of the previous or next music. It is equipped with a blank skip function that fast-forwards to the beginning of the next song when there is a silent part of more than 10Ωseconds and restarts the performance. It is equipped with an auto pause function. When dubbing at normal speed, the A deck waits for each song in a pause state and the B deck waits in a recording pause state. By using this function, you can dub while selecting songs. Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects whether the tape being used is type I (normal), II (high position), or IV (metal). Equipped with an autoplay function that automatically starts playing after rewinding, and a memory play function that starts playing from the position reset to counter 0Ω. name: TC-WR950Ω
description:
## Description

"Recording and re-reverse twin cassette deck equipped with super bias system and twin Dolby system. Equipped with a super bias system that greatly improves sound quality at high speed. When the tape speed is doubled, the frequency of the music signal is also doubled, and a 15ΩkHz signal becomes 30ΩkHz. Therefore, in conventional high-speed dubbing, the harmonic component of the high-frequency music signal approaches the frequency of the bias current (105ΩkHz) and causes beat generation, so that the high-range frequency characteristic is suppressed. The TC-WR950Ωemploys a super-bias system in which the bias frequency is set to 210ΩkHz, which is twice that of the conventional system. As a result, the generation of beat is greatly reduced even at double speed, and the frequency characteristics extended to high frequencies and a wide dynamic range are obtained. Amorphous alloy with excellent magnetic properties is used as the core material for the recording and re-recording head of each A/B deck, and LC-OFC is used for the head winding to improve sound quality. LC-OFC is a large-size oxygen-free copper crystal with a purity of more than 99Ω.995Ω% and reduces distortion due to capacitive reactances. It improves SN ratio and frequency characteristics.

NOISE REDUCTION
Each of the A and B decks is equipped with a Dolby NR system. The 3Ωpositions of B type / C type / OFF can be set independently on both decks.

NOISE REDUCTION
In addition, the Cross Dolby NR dubbing, which converts C-type recorded tapes into B-type tapes and dubs, is also possible.

NOISE REDUCTION
Each Dolby NR circuit is equipped with two circuits, one for normal speed and the other for high speed, enabling free Dolby conversion even during double-speed dubbing. The dubbing level can be adjusted to prevent distortion by reducing the level when dubbing from high-output metal tape to normal tape. You can also perform operations such as fade-in and fade-out. Adjustment can be performed at both normal speed and high speed. The A Deck is equipped with an RMS (Random Music Sensor) function that allows you to program up to 12Ωsongs on one side of the cassette up to 16Ωtimes in the order of your choice. You can also select a song by simply selecting it in the program order with the 12Ωkeys. Pressing the START key repeats the selection Ï‰ playback one after another. You can also double-speed dubbing of program songs, create a library of original edits, and add programs after starting RMS. When you press the display switch key or the 12Ωkey, the peak level meter section changes to the RMS display. The program music and the music being selected / played are displayed separately and the progress of RMS playback can be seen. In addition, you can check the order of program music with the check key. Equipped with a linear electronic counter that digitally displays the amount of tape travel in minutes and seconds. The tape travel amount of each A/B deck is counted independently, and the approximate travel amount of each deck is displayed by switching between A and B. The count continues even when not displayed, and the tape travel amount of each deck can be checked immediately during simultaneous recording or dubbing. It is also equipped with a subtraction function that can directly read the remaining amount of the tape. In addition to normal speed, high speed (double speed) synchronized dubbing is possible. At normal speed, you can edit the tape using the auto pause function. When dubbing at normal speed and the AUTO PAUSE key is turned ON, Deck A stops at the end of each song and Deck B is in the recording pause state. It is equipped with a blank skip function that automatically fast-forwards when there is a non-signal portion of more than 10Ωseconds during playback and starts playback from the beginning of the next song. In addition, when dubbing at normal speed, the recording deck automatically rewinds the non-signal portion of more than 10Ωseconds on the playback side and shortens it to about 5Ωseconds, making it possible to make a tape with a uniform interval between songs. The AMS (Automatic Music Sensor) function allows you to cue the current or next song. In addition to simultaneous recording on the A/B deck, the 3Ω-position direction mode switch allows one side recording / rerecording, two side recording, or one volume cycle playback. In addition, in RELAY mode, you can record both sides of the tape on the A deck and then record both sides of the tape on the B deck by the relay operation, enabling long-duration continuous recording using two volumes of tape. When playing back, you can repeatedly play both sides of the tape on the A deck and then play both sides of the tape on the B deck, enabling long-duration listening. Equipped with a triple color direction indicator that displays the tape running status in three colors : orange (STOP/FF/REW), green (PLAY), and red (REC). Equipped with quick reverse function by infrared sensor. Equipped with a 12Ω-segment x 2Ω-ch double indication FL peak level meter that can display real-time peak value and peak hold simultaneously. Equipped with TypeI/II/IV auto tape selector. Auto play and counter linked memory stop / play are available. Equipped with Rec Mute function with auto space. An optional timer allows recording of absence and alarm clock playback. Simultaneous recording and relay recording are also available. Equipped with a headphone port with variable output. It comes with a wireless remote control that can be used on either the A or B deck by switching the switch. In addition to tape movement commands such as recording and playback, fast forward and rewind, this remote control can reset linear electronic counters, memory, and A/B switching."

description:
## Description

"This is an L-cassette deck with improved usability by making maximum use of the auto mechanism. Equipped with an automatic tape selector, the optimum bias value and equalizer are set automatically by the combination of the micro switch built into the compartment and the detection hole provided at the bottom of the cassette shell, and the indicator lamp lights up. Automatic Dolby NR detection is possible. When recording Dolby NR, it is automatically judged by folding the tab at the bottom of the shell of the L Cassette, and recording and playback are performed with Dolby NR On. HEADS

MOTOR

Equipped with a soft eject mechanism."

These technologies ensure a high dynamic range. The pulse D/A converter operates at 45Ωmega pulses per second, and it completely eliminates differential non-linear distortion, glitch, and 0Ωcross distortion, which were difficult with conventional methods. The CDP-591Ωuses a single-mode pulse D/A converter. A single pulse D/A converter provides a 4ΩD/A output that outputs positive-phase and negative-phase LR signals. To take advantage of the pulse D/A converter, the high-density linear converter system is equipped with a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter in the front stage. This circuit achieves a high dynamic range by performing a highly accurate oversampling operation and a first order noise-shaping operation on the operation result. A direct digital sink is included to eliminate jittering issues. In this system, the master clock is formed on the same chip as the pulse D/A converter, and jitter is eliminated in principle by eliminating jitter immediately before the electronic switch, which is the final stage of the pulse D/A converter.

description:
## Description

"A CD player with 8Ωx over-sampling 18Ω-bit D/A conversion for high sound quality while equipped with rich functions. A direct digital sink is used to prevent phase disturbance caused by jitter. In the CDP 790Ω, a digital sync IC connected to the D/A converter readjusts the voltage time axis of the digital signal to the accuracy of the master clock, which is free from jitter, and sends it to the D/A converter, enabling more faithful D/A conversion with accurate phase. The digital circuit is equipped with the next-generation LSI CXD-2500Ω, the fourth generation. In the CXD 2500Ω, the RAM capacity has been increased to 32Ωkbit from the conventional external configuration. Moreover, it is integrated into a single chip. This enables digital data exchange inside the LSI, greatly reducing unnecessary radiation noise, reducing interference with audio circuits, and improving error correction capability. A newly developed pickup with a built-in RF amplifier is used in the pickup section, enabling low-impedance signal output and improving sound quality through low-noise and high-stability.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III. The S Servo II prevents the disturbance of the servo current from adversely affecting the analog section through the power supply. Noise components that adversely affect the analog section are removed with a low-pass filter to supply a smooth servo current.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the power supply from the weak power supply section is stabilized to reduce the influence on the audio circuit. Aluminum panel is used for the front panel. Equipped with a custom edit function, you can perform seven functions : peak search, multi-disc program, time edit, program edit, time fade, variable fade and manual fader. With the Peak Search function, you can perform a high-speed search of all songs and play them repeatedly for about 4Ωseconds before and after the point where the volume level is the highest. The multi-disk program feature allows you to edit tapes across multiple disks. Insert a disc and press the multi-program button to display Disc-1Ω. Program the song you want to insert, eject it, insert the second disc, and program the song you want to insert. This function can be programmed up to 24Ωsongs and up to 6Ωdiscs. With the Time Edit function, you can use the Time Set button or the Direct Key to set the length of one side of the tape. When you press the Edit button again, the program is performed for side B. You can also program the songs you want to include first and then time-edit the remaining time. It has a program performance function of up to 24Ωsongs. Equipped with 6Ω-mode repeat function of 1Ωsong / all songs / part (remote control only) / program / shuffle / delete shuffle. description:
## Description

"A CD player with an advanced pulse 8ΩD/A converter. The D/A converter is equipped with an advanced pulse D/A converter (CXD-2562Ω). The Pulse D/A converter uses oversampling and noise shaping techniques to compress a 16Ω-bit digital signal and outputs an audio signal with a current source and an electronic switch. This eliminates glitches, 0Ωcross distortion, and differential non-linear distortion that were unavoidable with conventional methods. The Advanced Pulse D/A converter is a further development of this. The Advanced Pulse D/A converter reduces requantization noise in the audible band and uses third order noise shaping to avoid a sudden increase in noise outside the audible band. The Advanced Pulse D/A converter is an IC with the introduction of Sony's proprietary high-precision arithmetic operation method that leads to a higher density pulse output. In the advanced pulse D/A converter, two outputs of pulse length modulation (PLM) waves, which are complementary to each other, are differentially synthesized, and a complimentary service PLM consisting of single-channel 4ΩD/A outputs is employed to achieve even higher precision and resolution. The digital filter uses a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter and provides a high dynamic range by outputting accurate oversampling to the D/A converter. It is equipped with a direct digital sink and the master clock is formed on the same chip as the pulse D/A converter. This allows the electronic switch of the pulse D/A converter to be turned on and off more accurately, eliminating harmful jitter and reducing sound quality degradation. The servo circuit uses a high-precision digital servo. In this circuit, the signal from the optical pickup is A/D converted, filtered and controlled by digital processing, and then D/A converted again to operate the optical pickup, making it possible to adjust the servo amount according to each disc. The high-precision servo uses a high-sampling rate, high-precision, high-resolution A/D converter and D/A converter to realize a more ideal servocontrol and low power consumption by digitizing. The tray section is equipped with a newly designed clamped roller mechanism that sandwiches the tray side with eight rollers to reduce tray vibration and improve vibration control. Aluminum front panel is adopted.

During this time period, jitter occurs in the digital signal. The original information of a digital signal is a sequence of encoded numerical values that is not affected by the transmission system, but when it is transmitted as an electrical signal, it is a sequence of pulse signals. For this reason, digital signals that have passed through many circuits fluctuate irregularly, with the pulse width being longer or shorter than it should be. As a result, the clock has jitter, and the time-axis accuracy of the signal deteriorates during D/A conversion. In the digital sync IC, the timing of the digital signal generated by the signal processing LSI is adjusted to the accuracy of the master clock immediately before the D/A converter. The master clock that determines the time axis accuracy of the signal is directly connected to the D/A converter. By adjusting the timing to the accuracy of the clean master clock that does not include jitter, the digital signal is adjusted again and output to the D/A converter. Since the effect of jitter does not affect the D/A converter and beyond, D/A conversion with accurate phase and faithful D/A conversion is possible. The digital filter is equipped with CXD 1244Ωwhich is an 8Ωfs 45Ω-bit noise shaping digital filter. This digital filter performs 8Ωtimes oversampling and resamples the signal from 44Ω.1ΩkHz to 352Ω.8ΩkHz (8Ωtimes the sampling frequency) to increase the distance between the audio signal and the unwanted high-frequency components. This enables the use of a low-order low-pass filter with gentle cut-off characteristics in the analog portion after D/A conversion, greatly improving the group delay characteristics. The CXD 1244Ωachieves the in-band ripple characteristics of ¥0Ω.00001ΩdB and the echo level of -124ΩdB or less due to its 45Ω-bit high-order computing capability. The CXD 1244Ωis capable of performing extremely high-precision operations with a 45Ω-bit operation bit length. However, since the D/A converter can have only a limited number of bits, round-off errors occur and remain as quantization noise. To solve this problem, we have adopted a high-resolution D/A converter with excellent characteristics and introduced a noise-shaping method, which is incorporated into the CXD 1244Ω. Noise shaping takes advantage of an over-sampling time interval to incorporate low-order bit information that is normally lost by round-off errors into high-order data. Equipped with digital de-emphasis function. In digital de-emphasis, the de-emphasis process conventionally composed of analog circuits is digitally processed inside the digital filter, eliminating sound quality degradation caused by parts and circuits, and achieving ideal gain and phase characteristics. The D/A converter IC is equipped with a high-precision linear D/A converter. This is a high-speed operation type that corresponds to the data output speed of the 8Ωfs digital filter and enables more advanced D/A conversion, which improves linearity for small level signals. In addition, this D/A converter is a single-chip IC with high stability of conversion operation and realizes linear operation from the most significant bit to the least significant bit. Therefore, in principle, there is no nonlinear element in input / output characteristics. Therefore, additional circuits such as gain switching are unnecessary, and the analog circuit section is simplified. In addition, by making the left and right channels independent of each other, the phase shift between the channels is eliminated.

MOTOR
