The pause is automatically inserted between the A side and the B side. In program edit, you program the songs you want to put on the A side of the tape in the order you like, then press the pause button and continue to program the B side. With the Time Fade function, if you set the time beforehand, the FOMA terminal automatically fades out approximately five seconds before the time and enters a pause state. The manual fader function allows manual operation to fade in / out. With this function, the fade operation takes approximately 5Ωseconds from where the button is pressed. It includes custom file functionality with three functions : disk memory, custom index, and program bank. With Disk Memo, when you insert a disc, a message you enter appears on the display, followed by the number of songs and the total duration of performance. You can make a note of up to 10Ωcharacters per disc. You can use 46Ωletters, numbers, and special symbols. The custom index allows you to set an index of up to 10Ωpoints at any location on a single disk, even if no index information is recorded on the disk itself. The index set includes a rehearsal function that allows fine tuning in steps of approximately ¥0Ω.15Ωseconds. In the Program Bank, you can directly record a program set with the Program Performance function that can play up to 20Ωsongs continuously. You can call up the program with the File Recall button, or you can directly bank the contents of a program set with Custom Edit. It is equipped with a file recall function that allows you to check what files have been stored so far without having to insert a disk. This allows you to check without having to insert a disk, and also to erase the file contents on the spot. It is equipped with delete shuffle function for 99Ωsongs. Equipped with a multi-mode timer function, you can start from your favorite music, shuffle play and repeat. By combining the custom index function, it is also possible to play the alarm clock with any phrase. Two types of analog output terminal are mounted : fixed and variable. The headphone port is equipped with a headphone port with a lineout linked volume that flashes when the remote control is operated. Equipped with an optical digital output. It is equipped with a program performance function of up to 20Ωsongs, 6Ω-mode repeat function of 1Ωsong / whole song / part (remote control only) / program / shuffle / custom index, and auto space function. ## Description

"A CD player equipped with a newly developed pulse 4ΩD/A converter as well as custom edit and file functions. The D/A converter consists of a high-density linear converter system, a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter and a pulse D/A converter. The Pulse D/A converter consists of a current source and an electronic switch. It expresses music waveform by switching two values of 0Ωand 1Ωat high speed. By this, the amplitude level is always constant and changes only in the time axis direction. The PLM (Pulse Length Modulation) wave is output. By passing it through a low-pass filter, unwanted high-frequency noise outside the audio band is removed and music waveform is obtained. To reduce quantization noise in the audible band up to 20ΩkHz, the pulse D/A converter is equipped with a multi-stage noise shaping operation that employs 64Ωtimes oversampling and the Sony Extended Noise Shaping method. Oversampling reduces quantization noise in the audible band by increasing the sampling frequency. Noise shaping reduces quantization noise in the audible band by feeding back the requantization error to the input side when the number of bits is reduced. These technologies ensure a high dynamic range. The pulse D/A converter operates at 45Ωmega pulses per second, and it completely eliminates differential non-linear distortion, glitch, and 0Ωcross distortion, which were difficult with conventional methods. The CDP-991Ωuses a single-mode pulse D/A converter. A single pulse D/A converter provides a 4ΩD/A output that outputs positive-phase and negative-phase LR signals. To take advantage of the pulse D/A converter, the high-density linear converter system is equipped with a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter in the front stage. This circuit achieves a high dynamic range by performing a highly accurate oversampling operation and a first order noise-shaping operation on the operation result. A direct digital sink is included to eliminate jittering issues. In this system, the master clock is formed on the same chip as the pulse D/A converter, and jitter is eliminated in principle by eliminating jitter immediately before the electronic switch, which is the final stage of the pulse D/A converter.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III. In the S Servo III, the high-frequency noise component of the servo current is removed with a low-pass filter to supply a smooth servo current, which stabilizes the power supply from the power supply and prevents adverse effects on sound quality. A digital CLV servo is installed in the drive system servo circuit that controls disk rotation. The digital CLV servo detects the rotation of the spindle motor and controls it with 10Ω-bit resolution to maintain an accurate linear velocity regardless of the disk's inner or outer circumference. It also detects the difference in inertial mass between the 12Ωcm CD and 8Ωcm CD disks to drive more appropriately. Low noise and high stability are achieved by incorporating an RF amplifier in the pickup section. The digital signal processing LSI uses the fourth generation LSI for the Sony CD player. Previously external RAM has been upgraded to a capacity of 32Ωkbit and built into the digital signal processing LSI. The precision of the signal processing capability is further enhanced by adopting the strict 6Ω-fold error correction method. Aluminum panel is used for the front panel.

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"CD player with DSP function in addition to CD roulette function. The CDP-C715Ωis equipped with a digital signal processor (DSP). The DSP uses digital signal processing to reproduce the surround effect produced by reflected sound and reverberation sound. You can enjoy seven types of sound field space (hall, church, jazz club, stadium, disco, lybloom and BGM) with one touch operation. You can also adjust the sound quality and reverberation of the set sound field to your preference and store it in a DSP file for each disc. The DSP function is not designed to work with optical digital output. It is equipped with a serial chain function and can connect two CDP-C715Ωs. The connection can be done with one touch using the attached cable, and combination play such as chain play in which 2Ωplayers play the disc alternately one by one. The disc tray features a CD roulette that allows you to load five discs at once, allowing you to play five discs in a row, play programs across five discs, and play shuffles. The D/A converter consists of a high-density linear converter system, a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter and a pulse D/A converter. The CDP-C715Ωuses a single-mode pulse D/A converter. A single pulse D/A converter provides a 4ΩD/A output that outputs positive-phase and negative-phase LR signals. The Pulse D/A converter consists of a current source and an electronic switch. It expresses music waveform by switching two values of 0Ωand 1Ωat high speed. By this, the amplitude level is always constant and changes only in the time axis direction. The PLM (Pulse Length Modulation) wave is output. By passing it through a low-pass filter, unwanted high-frequency noise outside the audio band is removed and music waveform is obtained. To reduce quantization noise in the audible band up to 20ΩkHz, the pulse D/A converter is equipped with a multi-stage noise shaping operation that employs 64Ωtimes oversampling and the Sony Extended Noise Shaping method. Oversampling reduces quantization noise in the audible band by increasing the sampling frequency. Noise shaping reduces quantization noise in the audible band by feeding back the requantization error to the input side when the number of bits is reduced. These technologies ensure a high dynamic range. The pulse D/A converter operates at 45Ωmega pulses per second, and it completely eliminates differential non-linear distortion, glitch, and 0Ωcross distortion, which were difficult with conventional methods. A 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter is installed in front of the pulse D/A converter to ensure a high dynamic range by performing high-precision oversampling operation and first order noise-shaping operation on the operation result. A direct digital sink is included to eliminate jittering issues. In this system, the master clock is formed on the same chip as the pulse D/A converter, and jitter is eliminated in principle by eliminating jitter immediately before the electronic switch, which is the final stage of the pulse D/A converter.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III. In the S Servo III, the high-frequency noise component of the servo current is removed with a low-pass filter to supply a smooth servo current, which stabilizes the power supply from the power supply and prevents adverse effects on sound quality. A digital CLV servo is installed in the drive system servo circuit that controls disk rotation. The digital CLV servo detects the rotation of the spindle motor and controls it with 10Ω-bit resolution to maintain an accurate linear velocity regardless of the disk's inner or outer circumference. It also detects the difference in inertial mass between the 12Ωcm CD and 8Ωcm CD disks to drive more appropriately. Low noise and high stability are achieved by incorporating an RF amplifier in the pickup section. The digital signal processing LSI uses the fourth generation LSI for the Sony CD player. Previously external RAM has been upgraded to a capacity of 32Ωkbit and built into the digital signal processing LSI. The precision of the signal processing capability is further enhanced by adopting the strict 6Ω-fold error correction method.

By this, the amplitude level is always constant and changes only in the time axis direction. The PLM (Pulse Length Modulation) wave is output. By passing it through a low-pass filter, unwanted high-frequency noise outside the audio band is removed and music waveform is obtained. To reduce quantization noise in the audible band up to 20ΩkHz, the pulse D/A converter is equipped with a multi-stage noise shaping operation that employs 64Ωtimes oversampling and the Sony Extended Noise Shaping method. Oversampling reduces quantization noise in the audible band by increasing the sampling frequency. Noise shaping reduces quantization noise in the audible band by feeding back the requantization error to the input side when the number of bits is reduced. These technologies ensure a high dynamic range. The pulse D/A converter operates at 45Ωmega pulses per second, and it completely eliminates differential non-linear distortion, glitch, and 0Ωcross distortion, which were difficult with conventional methods. The CDP-M51Ωuses a single-mode pulse D/A converter. A single pulse D/A converter provides a 4ΩD/A output that outputs positive and negative phase LR signals. To take advantage of the pulse D/A converter, the high-density linear converter system is equipped with a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter in the front stage. This circuit achieves a high dynamic range by performing a highly accurate oversampling operation and a first order noise-shaping operation on the operation result. A direct digital sink is included to eliminate jittering issues. In this system, the master clock is formed on the same chip as the pulse D/A converter, and jitter is eliminated in principle by eliminating jitter immediately before the electronic switch, which is the final stage of the pulse D/A converter.

It also detects the difference in inertial mass between the 12Ωcm CD and 8Ωcm CD disks to drive more appropriately. Low noise and high stability are achieved by incorporating an RF amplifier in the pickup section. The digital signal processing LSI uses the fourth generation LSI for the Sony CD player. Previously external RAM has been upgraded to a capacity of 32Ωkbit and built into the digital signal processing LSI. The precision of the signal processing capability is further enhanced by adopting the strict 6Ω-fold error correction method.

description:
## Description

"A CD player that inherits the design philosophy of CDP-X5000Ωand introduces newly developed technologies such as variable digital filters. An optical system fixing mechanism has been adopted for the mechanism, and the optical pickup is fixed to the strong base part and the disk side is moved. This greatly reduces vibration of the pickup, and the current required for servo is limited to relatively slow movement to compensate for distortion and eccentricity of the disk, and the fluctuation of servo current is reduced. While taking advantage of the optical system fixing method, a top-loading method is adopted to reduce the size. The disc is set by sliding the lid of the top panel by hand and fixed with a stabilizer.

TRANSPORT
In addition, the mechanism has a unique floating structure inside, and it is mounted directly on the chassis to obtain simplicity and stable drive performance. The servo circuit uses a high-precision digital servo, and by adjusting the servo amount of the optical pickup for each disc being played, servocontrol that more accurately reflects the disc condition is possible. The digital filter is equipped with a newly developed variable (V. C.) digital filter. The cut-off characteristics and phase characteristics of digital filters can be set by equations, and sound quality can be changed by changing these characteristics. Therefore, we have registered multiple equations for newly developed digital filter ICs so that you can select your favorite position according to your audio equipment, room environment, and music. In addition to the standard position with sharp roll-off characteristics, the CDP-X3000Ωis equipped with No. 1Ω, 2Ωand 3Ωwith slow roll-off characteristics. You can choose from a total of four positions. The Standard and Spline variable digital filters use full feed-forward digital filters. This digital filter employs a three step coupling of a double-type digital filter, which first generates complementary data at the midpoint between the data obtained from the disk and the data, and then uses the resulting data to create the next complementary data. Conventional digital filters use only the high-order bits by rounding the low-order bits of the calculation results obtained here, but this rounding error causes requantization noise. The full-feed-forward digital filter realizes an oversampling operation that also reflects low-bit data by performing a full-feed forward (FF) operation that combines the low-bit data with the result of the next stage operation. This eliminates almost all requantization noise in the audible band, greatly improving the quality of low-level signals. A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter. In this method, a stable and clean current source is prepared, and the current pulse is generated by switching using the output of the pulse generator. This eliminates the influence of voltage fluctuations and the influence of voltage noise in the arithmetic circuit, which are problems with conventional pulse D/A converters that use voltage. It also employs a complimentary service PLM that differentially synthesizes the output of the pulse D/A converter to reduce harmonic distortion. The chassis adopts a mono-box structure and realizes a structure in which vibration is hardly transmitted by combining high-strength members with screws. An eccentric insulator is used for the legs. This insulator is designed with the mounting hole offset from the center, and vibration propagation to the chassis is reduced by mutually canceling external vibration. The position and diameter of the hole are determined through repeated trial production and trial listening. This is particularly effective in attenuating mid - and high-frequency vibration components that affect audibility. An R core transformer is used for the power supply. In the R-core transformer, magnetic flux leakage and vibration are greatly reduced by making the iron core a circular doughnut type with no breaks. Two digital output systems are mounted : optical and coaxial. The digital output can be turned ON/OFF, and turning it OFF reduces the influence on the analog output. Equipped with a custom edit function, you can control functions such as peak search, program edit, manual fader and variable fade. It is equipped with functions such as shuffle play, delete shuffle, 5Ω-mode repeat and index search. Wireless remote control is included."

In addition, the digital circuit board is reduced to a minimum volume, separated from the audio circuit board, and placed on the mechanical deck to minimize the impact on the audio section. The digital filter is a full feed-forward type digital filter. This digital filter uses a 3Ω-stage connection method with a double-type digital filter. First, complementary data is generated at the midpoint between the data obtained from the disk and the data, and the resulting data is used to create the next complementary data. In the conventional digital filter, only the high-order bits are used by rounding the low-order bits of the calculation result obtained here. However, this rounding error causes requantization noise. The full-feed-forward digital filter realizes an oversampling operation that also reflects low-bit data by performing a full-feed forward (FF) operation that combines the low-bit data with the result of the next stage operation. This eliminates almost all requantization noise in the audible band, greatly improving the quality of low-level signals. A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"CD player with fixed optical system mechanism. An optical system fixing mechanism has been adopted for the mechanism, and the optical pickup is fixed to the strong base part and the disk side is moved. This greatly reduces vibration of the pickup, and the current required for servo is limited to relatively slow movement to compensate for distortion and eccentricity of the disk, and the fluctuation of servo current is reduced. The disc is designed to be attached to the turntable using a built-in chucking mechanism. The digital filter is a full feed-forward type digital filter. This digital filter uses a 3Ω-stage connection method with a double-type digital filter. First, complementary data is generated at the midpoint between the data obtained from the disk and the data, and the resulting data is used to create the next complementary data. In the conventional digital filter, only the high-order bits are used by rounding the low-order bits of the calculation result obtained here. However, this rounding error causes requantization noise. The full-feed-forward digital filter realizes an oversampling operation that also reflects low-bit data by performing a full-feed forward (FF) operation that combines the low-bit data with the result of the next stage operation. This eliminates almost all requantization noise in the audible band, greatly improving the quality of low-level signals. A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter. In this method, a stable and clean current source is prepared, and the current pulse is generated by switching using the output of the pulse generator. This eliminates the influence of voltage fluctuations and the influence of voltage noise in the arithmetic circuit, which are problems with conventional pulse D/A converters that use voltage. It also employs a complimentary service PLM that differentially synthesizes the output of the pulse D/A converter to reduce harmonic distortion. By placing the master clock section close to the D/A converter, more accurate processing is possible. In addition, by supplying a pure clock to the peripheral digital calculation section via a direct digital sink, the total capacity of the D/A conversion section is enhanced. The servo circuit uses a high-precision digital servo, and by adjusting the servo amount of the optical pickup for each disc being played, servocontrol that more accurately reflects the disc condition is possible. A center mechanical mounting system has been adopted for the internal layout, and the mechanical deck, which is the only mechanical operation section, is placed in the center of the chassis to minimize the rotational moment applied to the chassis and improve the stability against vibration. An eccentric insulator is used for the legs. This insulator is designed with the mounting hole offset from the center, and vibration propagation to the chassis is reduced by mutually canceling external vibration. The position and diameter of the hole are determined through repeated trial production and trial listening. This is particularly effective in attenuating mid - and high-frequency vibration components that affect audibility. The AMS is a rotary music selection method using a jog dial to pick up a few songs before or after, enabling speedy music selection utilizing the sense of the fingertips. It has a custom edit function and features such as peak search, time edit, just edit, program edit, time fade, manual fader and variable fade. It is equipped with functions such as 99ΩDelete Play, 99ΩShuffle Play, Music Scan, Auto Space and 7Ωmode repeat. A plated pin jack is used for the output terminal. Equipped with an optical digital output. Equipped with a headphone output terminal with volume. Wireless remote control is included."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A CD player based on CDP-502ΩES with added digital output and insulator. The digital audio interface outputs enable transmission over a single digital cable along with signals such as emphasis ON/OFF, sub-code, and synchronization signals applying Phase Double Mark (biphasemark) modulation based on the standard format of the CD-standard. This completely separates the CD's rotating machinery from the audio circuit, making the delicate audio circuit less susceptible to mechanical vibration of the rotating machinery and to noise from digital and servo circuits. In addition, a pin jack is used for the output terminal, and an isolation pulse transformer is used for the signal output part with a sealed electromagnetic shield structure to separate the ground line. The Unilinear converter system is used in the digital section to perform digital signal processing by fully synchronizing circuits such as D/A converters, digital filters, and EFM de-modulators with a single master clock. This eliminates in principle beat generation due to interference between two or more clocks. In addition, the EFM de-modulator, which used to be three chips, has been integrated into one chip, resulting in a simpler structure. The CDP 552Ωesd is equipped with a digital filter that oversamples the digital signal before D/A conversion to increase the frequency band distance between the unwanted component and the music signal. Furthermore, since the ripple characteristic in the audio band is less than 0Ω.01ΩdB and the attenuation in the stopband is 80ΩdB, the attenuation characteristic of the low-pass filter after D/A conversion can be made smooth and good phase characteristics can be obtained. In order to realize simple and straight transmission, the rotary system, digital circuit, and analog circuit are completely separated. In addition, the position of the mounting screw is also examined repeatedly, and the internal layout is designed with structural rigidity in mind. As a result, resonance, which affects sound quality, is suppressed in various details. In addition, the audio circuit is a twin-mono configuration with Lch and Rch separation by bus bar, and a 7Ωth-order GIC (Generalized Impedance Converter) low-pass filter is adopted, in which the music signal passes only through the resistance of the series arm of the filter.

POWER SUPPLY
In the power supply section, a large 35ΩVA transformer with more than double allowance in actual use is used. The power transformer consists of an OFC winding, an OFC lead wire, and a Z-material core.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the power transformer is separated into three windings for analog circuits, digital & servo, and display to reduce mutual interference. The rectifier diode also uses an ultrafast recovery diode with a recovery time of 35Ωnsec and a rating of 10ΩA with a margin.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the analog power supply circuit is composed of a discrete high-speed stabilized power supply, and a large electrolytic capacitor using ceramic powder and a tantalum capacitor with excellent high-frequency characteristics for bypassing between the power supply and the earth ground are used to enhance the supply capability and response of the power supply section for signals. We put in a lot of carefully selected parts. Starting with a copper-plated chassis that greatly eliminates magnetic distortion, the amplifier section is equipped with a high-quality operational amplifier.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, a mold-type non-inductive styrene capacitor is used for the integration circuit, a composite capacitor with non-inductive electrodes made of polystyrene and polypropylene derivatives for the emphasis time constant, and an LC (linear crystal) -OFC is used for the wires for audio signals. The crystals of Type 1Ωoxygen-free copper (purity of 99Ω.995Ω% or more) are enlarged and the number of crystal boundaries is reduced to reduce sound quality degradation due to capacitive reactances. In addition, as for the resistance, we use many kinds of metal film resistance with a tolerance of 1Ω% or less by applying non-magnetic coating to the OFC lead wire of the copper cap, and also use the line-out volume with carefully examined terminal material. It uses a linear motor tracking mechanism that integrates a linear motor and an optical block, which is also used for professionals. It enables high-speed access with a selection time of approximately one second from the first song on the disc to the start of the last song. In addition, there is almost no mechanical noise and reliability and durability are greatly improved by the integrated structure of drive type and optical system without transmission mechanism such as gear. In addition, the entire mechanical block has a floating structure to suppress external vibration. Four high-rigidity large insulators are included to ensure vibration prevention. Equipped with a music calendar that directly displays the track number of up to 20Ωsongs on the disc. It is equipped with RMS (Random Music Sensor) function of up to 20Ωsongs which can be added or changed even while playing. Equipped with functions such as one touch direct selection and shuffle play with 20Ωkeys, repeat between one song / all songs / A and B parts, AM (Automatic Music Sensor) function that allows you to easily find the beginning of a song you want to listen to, music search function that allows you to fast forward / rewind while listening to a song, and index search function. It employs a push-loading linear skating system that closes even when the disk table is pushed, further increasing the operating speed. It is also equipped with an auto-space play function that automatically sets the interval between songs to 3Ωseconds during program performance and shuffle play, and an auto-delay function that creates a 2Ω-second blank before the start of performance when directly selecting channels. Equipped with two output terminals, variable and fixed. Equipped with a timer standby switch and an accessory terminal designed to improve the system. Wireless remote controller RM-D502Ωis included."

"This CD player was developed based on the design philosophy of the reference CDP 557Ωesd. The digital filter uses a newly developed IC (CXD1144Ω) with an 8Ωx oversampling 18Ω-bit digital filter. This newly developed digital filter has an extremely high-order 293Ωorder preserving in salt capability, and achieves an in-band ripple characteristic of ¥0Ω.00001ΩdB and an attenuation of 120ΩdB or more in the stopband. As a result, the generation of echo components caused by ripple can be suppressed to a negligible level. In particular, the reproducibility of the rising of a single sound of piano is improved. In addition, by increasing the sampling frequency from 44Ω.1ΩkHz to 352Ω.8ΩkHz by 8Ωtimes over sampling, the quantization noise in the audio band can be greatly reduced. At the same time, the distance between the music signal component and the unnecessary high-frequency component has been expanded to 332Ω.8ΩkHz. Thus, the cutoff characteristics of the low-pass filter after D/A conversion can be relaxed, further improving the group delay characteristics. The D/A converter is equipped with a Staggered 4ΩD/A converter system to improve the resolution of the 16Ω-bit D/A converter. This method uses four D/A converters, two for each L/R channel, for staggered operation. These converters support sampling frequencies up to 352Ω.8ΩkHz and enable high-speed, high-precision 8Ωx D/A conversion. A newly developed aluminum die-cast base unit is adopted for the base unit which is the base of the optical system mechanism, and the trace stability is improved by effectively suppressing unnecessary vibration. In addition, the entire base unit is made into a floating structure by double suspension containing high viscoelastic gel rich in vibration absorption, and the effect of external vibration is strictly eliminated. The pickup section has no transmission mechanism such as gears, and uses a linear motor tracking mechanism that enables high-speed access with extremely quiet operation. A mechanical block, which tends to be a source of vibration inside the player, is attached to a G (Gibraltar) base and then firmly fixed to the chassis. This G base material contains calcium carbonate with the same composition as marble, added to a special resin and reinforced with glass fiber. This material is the same as that used in the ES series amplifier chassis. It has the features of extremely high rigidity and excellent vibration damping characteristics, and it is easy to tune from the shape and acoustic aspect. This reduces the transmission and resonance of vibrations that degrade sound quality. In consideration of the effect of sound pressure radiated from the speakers, a damper made of special rubber material is installed in the opening of the front panel where the disk tray is stored to improve airtightness when the tray is stored, thereby blocking even slight air vibrations. The chassis uses a high-rigidity double structure metal chassis with structure equivalent to CDP-557ΩESD. In addition, the W chassis with a laminated structure consisting of two plates of sufficient thickness is adopted for the bottom plate, and rigidity and vibration control are thoroughly enhanced. It uses a taper chucking method that absorbs the eccentricity due to the error of the center hole of the disk and keeps it within a negligible range.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo II, which is an improved version of S Servo. The operating principle of the S servo is that the RF-IC detects signal drop-out caused by scratches or dirt, calculates the timing of the next drop-out based on the rotation cycle of the disk, and optimally controls the servo amount of both tracking and focus servo circuits just before the drop-out to minimize the occurrence of errors. The S Servo II performs even more precise predictive control of the servo amount. The prediction time accuracy is improved from 1Ω/8Ω,000Ωsecond to 1Ω/10Ω,000Ωsecond. Moreover, by supporting CLV (constant linear velocity), this accuracy is maintained at any position inside and outside the disk. Compared to the method in which the servo amount is controlled after the drop-out occurs, the trace stability is improved and the disturbance of the servo current is greatly reduced. The analog circuit has a twin-mono configuration that follows the signal flow, and phase shift and mutual interference between channels are eliminated from the root. In addition, the circuit configuration has been greatly simplified by incorporating digital filters. In addition, the MOS gate transfer method is adopted for digital data transmission to the analog system to prevent data current from mixing into the analog system ground, thereby eliminating factors of sound quality degradation.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is composed of 11Ωindependent stabilized power supplies with separate windings for each signal system to eliminate mutual interference between circuits. Uses carefully selected parts such as an ES board that prevents unnecessary capacitance. It is equipped with a digital processing soft muting circuit, and it prevents click noise by instantly muting when the performance stops or poses are operated. It has two digital outputs, coaxial and optical, with a time axis correction latch located just before the coaxial digital output to more strictly eliminate the fine jitter component. Equipped with a digital / analog output changeover switch to prevent mutual interference. There are two analog outputs, fixed and variable. Equipped with line-out volume for headphone output as well. These volumes can be controlled by remote control and are motor-driven when the volume is adjusted by remote control. A custom file function is included as a new function. This function allows the CD player to store up to 226Ωtitles of music information and messages input by the listener for each disc. Each time a disc is replaced, the CD player automatically identifies which disc it is, recalls the memory, displays messages for each disc, and plays the disc according to the performance information. Custom files have three functions : disk memos, custom indexes, and program banks. You can file disk notes and either custom indexes or program banks. Disk Memo allows you to enter your own message up to 10Ωcharacters per disk. The custom index can be set up to a maximum of 6Ωpoints per disk. To set the index, press the FILE button during playback to specify the point. The program bank can store up to 20Ωprogram performance functions. By memory backup, stored contents are retained even when power is turned off. Equipped with a program edit function, editing program can be done for each A/B side of the tape at one time. It has a delete shuffle function that allows you to shuffle and play only your favorite songs. Equipped with 6Ω-mode repeat of 1Ωsong / whole song / part (remote control only) / program / shuffle / custom index. It is equipped with a time keeper function with the next display to know the next program performance music. Equipped with auto space / auto pause function. Equipped with Music Search. Wireless remote control is included."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A CD player developed by inheriting the technology of the high-grade machine. Digital sync ICs are used to reduce jitter that occurs when digital signals are transmitted. The pit information read from the disk is converted into a digital signal by a signal processing LSI and sent to a digital filter and a D/A converter. During this time period, jitter occurs in the digital signal. The original information of a digital signal is a sequence of encoded numerical values that is not affected by the transmission system, but when it is transmitted as an electrical signal, it is a sequence of pulse signals. For this reason, digital signals that have passed through many circuits fluctuate irregularly, with the pulse width being longer or shorter than it should be. As a result, the clock has jitter, and the time-axis accuracy of the signal deteriorates during D/A conversion. In the digital sync IC, the timing of the digital signal generated by the signal processing LSI is adjusted to the accuracy of the master clock immediately before the D/A converter. The master clock that determines the time axis accuracy of the signal is directly connected to the D/A converter. By adjusting the timing to the accuracy of the clean master clock that does not include jitter, the digital signal is adjusted again and output to the D/A converter. Since the effect of jitter does not affect the D/A converter and beyond, D/A conversion with accurate phase and faithful D/A conversion is possible. The digital filter is equipped with CXD 1244Ωwhich is an 8Ωfs 45Ω-bit noise shaping digital filter. This digital filter performs 8Ωtimes oversampling and resamples the signal from 44Ω.1ΩkHz to 352Ω.8ΩkHz (8Ωtimes the sampling frequency) to increase the distance between the audio signal and the unwanted high-frequency components. This enables the use of a low-order low-pass filter with gentle cut-off characteristics in the analog portion after D/A conversion, greatly improving the group delay characteristics. The CXD 1244Ωachieves the in-band ripple characteristics of ¥0Ω.00001ΩdB and the echo level of -124ΩdB or less due to its 45Ω-bit high-order computing capability. The CXD 1244Ωis capable of performing extremely high-precision operations with a 45Ω-bit operation bit length. However, since the D/A converter can have only a limited number of bits, round-off errors occur and remain as quantization noise. To solve this problem, we have adopted a high-resolution D/A converter with excellent characteristics and introduced a noise-shaping method, which is incorporated into the CXD 1244Ω. Noise shaping takes advantage of an over-sampling time interval to incorporate low-order bit information that is normally lost by round-off errors into high-order data. Equipped with digital de-emphasis function. In digital de-emphasis, the de-emphasis process conventionally composed of analog circuits is digitally processed inside the digital filter, eliminating sound quality degradation caused by parts and circuits, and achieving ideal gain and phase characteristics. The D/A converter IC is equipped with a high-precision linear D/A converter. This is a high-speed operation type that corresponds to the data output speed of the 8Ωfs digital filter and enables more advanced D/A conversion, which improves linearity for small level signals. In addition, this D/A converter is a single-chip IC with high stability of conversion operation and realizes linear operation from the most significant bit to the least significant bit. Therefore, in principle, there is no nonlinear element in input / output characteristics. Therefore, additional circuits such as gain switching are unnecessary, and the analog circuit section is simplified. In addition, by making the left and right channels independent of each other, the phase shift between the channels is eliminated. The audio circuits after the D/A converter are twin-mono in accordance with the signal flow, eliminating phase shift and mutual interference between channels.

MOTOR
The mechanism uses Sony's linear motor tracking mechanism that enables high-speed access with quiet operation, and is equipped with a G (Gibraltar) base unit with excellent vibration control. This is made by adding calcium carbonate, which has the same composition as marbles, to a special resin and reinforcing it with glass fiber. The Kyoshin sharpness is greatly reduced and high rigidity is obtained. In addition, the entire mechanical block has a floating structure to eliminate external vibrations and prevent unwanted vibrations and resonance. In order to eliminate the influence of sound pressure radiated from speakers, a damper made of a special rubber material is installed in the opening of the front panel where the disk tray is stored to improve airtightness when the tray is stored, thereby eliminating the influence of air vibration entering from the front. An integrated monocoque chassis is adopted for the chassis structure, and a double-structured top plate made of two sheets of steel plate is used for the top plate to increase rigidity by preventing unnecessary vibration.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III. The SS Servo III, noise components that cause adverse effects are removed through a low-pass filter, and the influence on the audio circuit is reduced by sending a smooth servo current to the servo circuit. Moreover, unnecessary vibration of the optical system mechanism is also suppressed. It is equipped with a custom edit function that combines three functions : time edit, program edit, and time fade. With Time Edit, you enter the time for one side of the tape and press the Edit button to program the music to be played in order from the first song. When you encounter a time-over song, the program automatically selects the longest song within the time range. Press the Edit button once to continue the program for the A side, and press the Edit button again to continue the program for the B side. The pause is automatically inserted between the A side and the B side. In program edit, you program the songs you want to put on the A side of the tape in the order you like, then press the pause button and continue to program the B side. With the Time Fade function, if you set the time beforehand, the FOMA terminal automatically fades out approximately five seconds before the time and enters a pause state. The manual fader function allows manual operation to fade in / out. With this function, the fade operation takes approximately 5Ωseconds from where the button is pressed. It includes custom file functionality with three functions : disk memory, custom index, and program bank. With Disk Memo, when you insert a disc, a message you enter appears on the display, followed by the number of songs and the total duration of performance. You can make a note of up to 10Ωcharacters per disc. You can use 46Ωletters, numbers, and special symbols. The custom index allows you to set an index of up to 10Ωpoints at any location on a single disk, even if no index information is recorded on the disk itself. The index set includes a rehearsal function that allows fine tuning in steps of approximately ¥0Ω.15Ωseconds. In the Program Bank, you can directly record a program set with the Program Performance function that can play up to 20Ωsongs continuously. You can call up the program with the File Recall button, or you can directly bank the contents of a program set with Custom Edit. It is equipped with a file recall function that allows you to check what files have been stored so far without having to insert a disk. This allows you to check without having to insert a disk, and also to erase the file contents on the spot. Equipped with a multi-mode timer function, you can start from your favorite music, shuffle play and repeat. By combining the custom index function, it is also possible to play the alarm clock with any phrase. Two types of analog output terminal are mounted : fixed and variable. The headphone port is equipped with a headphone port with a lineout linked volume that flashes when the remote control is operated. It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system. The digital output can be switched on / off. Equipped with 6Ωmode repeat function of 1Ωsong / whole song / part (remote control only) / program / shuffle / custom index, and auto space function. Equipped with 2Ω-speed Music Search that enables fast forward / fast backward while listening to music. Slow mode can only be operated from the remote control. Comes with a 20Ω-key wireless remote control with volume control."

description:
## Description

"This CD player was developed as an integrated new reference model following the separate R1Ωby putting in the technology cultivated in CDP-R1Ωand DAS-R1Ω. Digital sync ICs are used to reduce jitter that occurs when digital signals are transmitted. In the digital sync IC, the timing of the digital signal generated by the signal processing LSI is adjusted to the accuracy of the master clock immediately before the D/A converter. The master clock that determines the time axis accuracy of the signal is directly connected to the D/A converter. By adjusting the timing to the accuracy of the clean master clock that does not include jitter, the digital signal is adjusted again and output to the D/A converter. Since the effect of jitter does not affect the D/A converter and beyond, D/A conversion with accurate phase and faithful D/A conversion is possible. The digital filter is equipped with CXD 1244Ωwhich is an 8Ωfs 45Ω-bit noise shaping digital filter. This digital filter performs 8Ωtimes oversampling and resamples the signal from 44Ω.1ΩkHz to 352Ω.8ΩkHz (8Ωtimes the sampling frequency) to increase the distance between the audio signal and the unwanted high-frequency components. This enables the use of a low-order low-pass filter with gentle cut-off characteristics in the analog portion after D/A conversion, greatly improving the group delay characteristics. The CXD 1244Ωachieves the in-band ripple characteristics of ¥0Ω.00001ΩdB and the echo level of -124ΩdB or less due to its 45Ω-bit high-order computing capability. The CXD 1244Ωis capable of performing extremely high-precision operations with a 45Ω-bit operation bit length. However, since the D/A converter can have only a limited number of bits, round-off errors occur and remain as quantization noise. To solve this problem, we have adopted a high-resolution D/A converter with excellent characteristics and introduced a noise-shaping method, which is incorporated into the CXD 1244Ω. Noise shaping takes advantage of an over-sampling time interval to incorporate low-order bit information that is normally lost by round-off errors into high-order data. Equipped with digital de-emphasis function. In digital de-emphasis, the de-emphasis process conventionally composed of analog circuits is digitally processed inside the digital filter, eliminating sound quality degradation caused by parts and circuits, and achieving ideal gain and phase characteristics. The D/A converter IC is equipped with a high-precision linear D/A converter. This is a high-speed operation type that corresponds to the data output speed of the 8Ωfs digital filter. It enables more advanced D/A conversion. This improves linearity for small-level signals. In addition, this D/A converter is an IC composed of one chip with high stability of conversion operation and realizes linear operation from the most significant bit to the least significant bit. Therefore, there is no nonlinear element in the input / output characteristics in principle. This eliminates the need for additional circuits such as gain switching and simplifies the analog circuit section. In addition, by making the left and right channels independent of each other, the phase shift between the channels is eliminated. The audio circuits after the D/A converter are twin-mono in accordance with the signal flow, eliminating phase shift and mutual interference between channels. MOTOR

Moreover, unnecessary vibration of the optical system mechanism is also suppressed. A damper made of a special rubber material is installed in the opening of the front panel where the disk tray is stored to improve airtightness when storing the tray. This eliminates the effect of air vibration entering from the front. The chassis structure uses the FB chassis, which follows the trend of the separate CD player R1Ω. In addition to selecting members with sufficient thickness and strength, the entire chassis is firmly joined by the frame surrounding the outer circumference and the beams before and after passing the front and rear to ensure high strength. In addition, the CDP-X7ΩESD employs a new construction that further develops the idea of no vibration and no resonance. In this construction, the power transformer, which tends to be a source of vibration and noise, is placed on the left side farthest from the audio board, and the mechanical deck, which tends to be susceptible to vibration from the floor, is placed closer to the center, away from the insulator. In addition, as a countermeasure against high-frequency noise, the digital circuit board and audio circuit board are separated by a shield plate, the FL display is placed under the mechanical deck, and the internal chassis is entirely plated with copper. The selenium mic insulator is used for the leg part to increase stability. You can use the program edit function from the remote control. In program edit, you program the songs you want to put on the A side of the tape in the order you like, then press the pause button and continue to program the B side. It is equipped with a manual fader function that can be operated from a remote control, and fade in / out is possible within approximately 5Ωseconds from where the button is pressed. It has a custom file function. The custom index allows you to set an index of up to 10Ωpoints at any location on a single disk, even if no index information is recorded on the disk itself. The index set includes a rehearsal function that allows fine tuning in steps of approximately ¥0Ω.15Ωseconds. In the Program Bank, you can directly record a program set with the Program Performance function that can play up to 20Ωsongs continuously. You can call up the program with the File Recall button, or you can directly bank the contents of a program set with Custom Edit. The CDP-X7ΩESD does not have a disk memory function. The File Recall function can be operated from the remote control so that you can check what files have been stored so far without having to insert a disk. This allows you to check without having to insert a disk, and also to erase the file contents on the spot. Equipped with a multi-mode timer function, you can start from your favorite music, shuffle play and repeat. By combining the custom index function, it is also possible to play the alarm clock with any phrase. There are two types of analog output terminals, fixed and variable. Gold-plated terminals are used. It also has a balanced output terminal. Equipped with headphone terminal with lineout linked volume. It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system. The digital output can be switched on / off, and the coaxial digital output has a latch for time axis compensation just before the output, making it a latched digital output in which minute jitter components are eliminated more strictly. Equipped with a display on / off function that turns off the FL display when necessary. Wireless remote control is included. ## Description

"ES series CD player with high density linear converter system. The newly developed high-density linear converter system is used for the D/A converter, and the newly developed CXD 2552Ωis used for the D/A converter. The CXD 2552Ωdoes not consist of multiple current sources and corresponding electronic switches used in the conventional multi-bit system. Instead, one current source is turned on / off by one electronic switch. By increasing the operating speed of the electronic switch, the number of pulses is speed of the electronic switch, and the sound is produced by the compressional waves of pulses. In the pulse D/A converter, the waveform becomes smoother and the performance improves as the number of pulses increases. The number of pulses is determined by the master clock of the pulse D/A converter. In the CXD-2552Ω, the maximum operating frequency of the master clock is 50ΩMHz (50Ωmillion pulses per second). The digital operation circuit that determines the appearance of the high and low pulses uses the Sony Extended Noise Shaping digital operation method developed by Sony to realize a high-density pulse train. This method not only achieves a high dynamic range, but also provides sound quality that is essentially free from differential non-linear distortion, glitches and 0Ωcross distortion. The High Density Linear Converter System has two stages of D/A conversion : oversampling and Sony Extended Noise Shaping. The oversampling operation includes a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter, CXD 1244Ω, which provides full noise shaping across all stages and a sufficiently large operation range for more accurate D/A conversion. A direct digital sink is incorporated to eliminate jitter that is a problem with digital signals. The direct digital sink eliminates jitter by adjusting the digital signal to the accuracy of the master clock to prevent signal phase disturbance. This circuit is also built on the chip of the pulse D/A converter. Jitter is removed immediately before the electronic switch, which is the final stage of the pulse D/A converter, so that the element of jitter generation is eliminated in principle. The digital circuit is equipped with CXD 2500Ω, which is the fourth generation LSI. In the CXD 2500Ω, the RAM capacity has been increased to 32Ωkbit and integrated into a single chip. This enables digital data exchange inside the LSI, greatly reducing unnecessary radiation noise, reducing interference with audio circuits, and improving error correction capability. A newly developed optical pickup with a built-in RF amplifier is used in the pickup section, and low noise and high stability are realized by enabling low impedance signal output.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III.

POWER SUPPLY
In the S Servo II, the noise component of the servo current is removed with a low-pass filter to provide a smooth servo current, which stabilizes the power supply from the power supply and reduces the influence on the audio circuit. FB chassis is used for the chassis part. The FB chassis uses a metal material with sufficient thickness and strength for the chassis material, and the whole chassis is firmly joined by the frame surrounding the outer circumference and the front and rear beams passing through the front and rear, thus reducing adverse effects on the circuit due to internal and external vibrations. G-base unit is adopted for the mechanism part. In the G-base unit, in order to suppress the decrease in trace accuracy due to vibration and resonance, calcium carbonate of the same composition as marbles is added to a special resin and strengthened with glass fiber. This reduces the sharpness of the Kyoshin and reduces the influence of external vibration and provides high rigidity. In order to eliminate the influence of sound pressure from the speakers, a damper made of a special rubber material is installed in the opening of the front panel where the disk tray is stored. By improving the airtightness of the tray, the influence of air vibration entering from the front surface is eliminated. The disc tray is made of the same material as the G-base unit to prevent unnecessary external vibration from being applied to the disc. The internal construction is designed to eliminate vibration and noise, and the effect of noise generated from the FL display is considered to be not small. Therefore, it is placed on the lower part of the mechanical deck away from the circuit board, and the mechanical deck itself is placed closer to the center away from the leg part to avoid vibration from the floor.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with two transformers. The digital servo section and audio section are fed independently to eliminate interference from the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, rubber dampers are used in four floating locations to prevent the vibration of the transformer from being transmitted to the audio circuit section. The audio circuit is a twin-mono configuration that follows the signal flow, eliminating phase shift and mutual interference between channels.

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"ES series CD player with newly developed pulse 8ΩD/A converter. The D/A converter consists of a high-density linear converter system, a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter and a pulse D/A converter. The Pulse D/A converter consists of a current source and an electronic switch. It expresses music waveform by switching two values of 0Ωand 1Ωat high speed. By this, the amplitude level is always constant and changes only in the time axis direction. The PLM (Pulse Length Modulation) wave is output. By passing it through a low-pass filter, unwanted high-frequency noise outside the audio band is removed and music waveform is obtained. To reduce quantization noise in the audible band up to 20ΩkHz, the pulse D/A converter is equipped with a multi-stage noise shaping operation that employs 64Ωtimes oversampling and the Sony Extended Noise Shaping method. Oversampling reduces quantization noise in the audible band by increasing the sampling frequency. Noise shaping reduces quantization noise in the audible band by feeding back the requantization error to the input side when the number of bits is reduced. These technologies ensure a high dynamic range. The pulse D/A converter operates at 45Ωmega pulses per second, and it completely eliminates differential non-linear distortion, glitch, and 0Ωcross distortion, which were difficult with conventional methods. The newly developed pulse D/A converter has a 4ΩD/A output that outputs positive-phase, negative-phase, and each LR signal. The ES Series is equipped with two pulse D/A converters in the complimentary service mode, in which two pulse D/A converters are used to produce 8ΩD/A outputs. In the complimentary service mode, two pulse D/A converters are modulated and differentially synthesized so that they are complementary to each other. This mode has the effect of canceling harmonic distortion and improves the distortion factor. In addition, the SN ratio is improved by doubling the output current value. To take advantage of the pulse D/A converter, the high-density linear converter system is equipped with a 45Ω-bit noise-shaping digital filter in the front stage. This circuit achieves a high dynamic range by performing a highly accurate oversampling operation and a first order noise-shaping operation on the operation result. A direct digital sink is included to eliminate jittering issues. In this system, the master clock is formed on the same chip as the pulse D/A converter, and jitter is eliminated in principle by eliminating jitter immediately before the electronic switch, which is the final stage of the pulse D/A converter. Low noise and high stability are achieved by incorporating an RF amplifier in the pickup section. The digital signal processing LSI uses the fourth generation LSI for the Sony CD player. Previously external RAM has been upgraded to a capacity of 32Ωkbit and built into the digital signal processing LSI. The precision of the signal processing capability is further enhanced by adopting the strict 6Ω-fold error correction method. The drive circuit of the optical pickup uses a newly designed fine drive.

POWER SUPPLY
This circuit uses a balanced push-pull drive circuit with ¥2Ωpower supply system instead of a single-drive circuit with one side ground in the past. This circuit is separated from the earth by using a balanced push-pull drive circuit with ¥2Ωpower supply system. This eliminates noise current from entering the power supply line and realizes a cleaner optical pickup drive.

The G-base unit is made by adding calcium carbonate, which has the same composition as marble, to a special resin and reinforcing it with glass fiber to prevent loss of trace accuracy due to vibration and resonance. description:
## Description

"An ES series CD player with an optical system fixing mechanism. Newly developed optical system fixing mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part. In this system, the optical pickup is fixed to the main body of a strong mechanical base, and vibration of the disk surface is suppressed by a stabilizer made of brass. Thus, a mechanism with very little fluctuation is realized. This reduces the burden on the servo for correcting the operation of the optical pickup and greatly improves sound quality.

MOTOR
In addition, the spindle motor for rotating the disk is equipped with a BSL motor that achieves high precision and quiet rotational performance with less cogging. The digital filter is equipped with a newly developed full feed-forward digital filter. In the full-feed-forward digital filter, an FF (full-feed-forward) arithmetic block is provided to transmit data that had been truncated due to the limitation of arithmetic capability in the conventional method. This enables extremely precise musical expression and eliminates the maximum quantization noise in the audible band caused by data truncation, thereby greatly improving signal quality, especially at small levels. The D/A converter is equipped with a current pulse D/A converter. The current pulse D/A converter uses a current instead of a voltage to express the pulse, eliminating the effect of voltage fluctuations in principle. Moreover, it is less affected by noise from the arithmetic circuit, so it achieves a significant improvement in sound quality. The complimentary service PLM method is used. Among the four outputs of the pulse D/A converter, two outputs of the PLM waves, which have a complementary relationship with each other, are differentially synthesized to reproduce an output waveform with less harmonic distortion.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with a high-precision digital servo. This circuit uses a high sampling rate A/D and D/A converter to achieve servocontrol that better reflects the disc condition. The drive circuit of the disc rotation system and optical pickup employs a fine drive composed of balanced push-pull capable of canceling in-phase noise components, so that noise components that adversely affect sound quality do not flow into the earth line. In order to maintain high audio signal purity inside the chassis, we have adopted a digital minimum board. In addition to separating the digital circuit board from the audio circuit board, the digital circuit board is laid out on the mechanical deck section to minimize noise splash to the audio section. The analog low-pass filter uses an active-type Cowell low-pass filter with excellent group delay characteristics suppress the generation of wide-area noise. The line amplifier uses a DC servo system to eliminate the coupling capacitor from the audio signal path. In addition, a high-performance amplifier with FET input is used to separate the noise component from the low-pass filter at the front stage by the high-impedance input characteristic of FET.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses two R-core transformers with excellent electromagnetic characteristics and very little magnetic flux leakage. The audio circuit and digital circuit are fed independently to eliminate mutual interference. FB chassis is used for the chassis structure. In this structure, the entire chassis is firmly joined by the outer frame and beams connecting the front and rear, ensuring rigidity and improving vibration resistance. A center mechanical mount system is adopted, and the mechanical deck is placed in the center of the chassis to minimize the rotational moment applied to the chassis and improve stability against vibration. Newly developed eccentric insulator is used for the leg part. In this insulator, by offsetting the screw fixing position from the center, the effect of mutually canceling the vibration entering from the outer circumference of the insulator is obtained. A newly developed static lighting type fluorescent display tube is adopted for the display, and by using a display with less switching, vibration and noise from the display tube are suppressed. The Custom Edit function allows you to perform peak search (remote control only), time edit, just edit, program edit, time fade, manual fader (remote control only) and variable fade. It has a custom file function and provides custom index and delete bank functions. Features such as Delete Play, Shuffle, Delete Shuffle, 3Ω-way Music Scan (remote control only), Auto Space (remote control only), Timer Play, 8Ω-mode repeat, and Index Search (remote control only) are provided. Equipped with an optical digital output. Equipped with two analog outputs, fixed and variable, with gold-plated terminals. Equipped with headphone port with lineout linked volume that can also be operated from remote control. Wireless remote control is included."

An optical system fixing mechanism has been adopted for the mechanism, and the optical pickup is fixed to the strong base part and the disk side is moved. This greatly reduces vibration of the pickup, and the current required for servo is limited to relatively slow movement to compensate for distortion and eccentricity of the disk, and the fluctuation of servo current is reduced.

MOTOR
In this system, the disk is fixed from above using a stabilizer to eliminate vibration of the disk, and a BSL motor with less rotational unevenness is used as the disk drive motor. The digital filter is equipped with a newly developed variable (V. C.) digital filter. The cut-off characteristics and phase characteristics of digital filters can be set by equations, and sound quality can be changed by changing these characteristics. Therefore, we have registered multiple equations for newly developed digital filter ICs so that you can select your favorite position according to your audio equipment, room environment, and music. In addition to the standard position with sharp roll-off characteristics, the ES series is equipped with No1Ω, 2Ω, 3Ω, and 4Ωwith slow roll-off characteristics. In addition, No3Ωand 4Ωcan be selected from 3Ωlevels each, for a total of 9Ωpositions. In the standard and spline positions of the variable digital filter, a full feed-forward digital filter is adopted. This digital filter employs a three step coupling of a double-type digital filter, which first generates complementary data at the midpoint between the data obtained from the disk and the data, and then uses the resulting data to create the next complementary data. Conventional digital filters use only the high-order bits by rounding the low-order bits of the calculation results obtained here, but this rounding error causes requantization noise. The full-feed-forward digital filter realizes an oversampling operation that also reflects low-bit data by performing a full-feed forward (FF) operation that combines the low-bit data with the result of the next stage operation. This eliminates almost all requantization noise in the audible band, greatly improving the quality of low-level signals. A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter. In this method, a stable and clean current source is prepared, and the current pulse is generated by switching using the output of the pulse generator. This eliminates the influence of voltage fluctuations and the influence of voltage noise in the arithmetic circuit, which are problems with conventional pulse D/A converters that use voltage. It also employs a complimentary service PLM that differentially synthesizes the output of the pulse D/A converter to reduce harmonic distortion. The line amplifier section employs a DC servo amplifier configuration that eliminates the coupling capacitor from the signal path. This eliminates the colorization characteristic of the capacitor and achieves stable amplification in the ultra-low frequency range. The servo circuit uses a high-precision digital servo, and by adjusting the servo amount of the optical pickup for each disc being played, servocontrol that more accurately reflects the disc condition is possible. A fine drive circuit has been adopted for the disk rotation system and the drive circuit of the optical pickup, and it is composed of a balanced push-pull capable of canceling the in-phase noise, thereby preventing noise from entering the earth line. In addition, the digital circuit board is reduced to a minimum volume, separated from the audio circuit board, and placed on the mechanical deck to reduce the influence on the audio. A static type FL tube is used for the display where there is no change in the display. This reduces the noise generated in the display area and reduces the influence on the audio circuit. An R core transformer is used for the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
The R-core transformer has a circular doughnut type cross-section with no gaps in the iron core, greatly reducing magnetic flux leakage and vibration. A center mechanical mounting system has been adopted for the internal layout, and the mechanical deck, which is the only mechanical operation section of the CD player, is placed in the center of the chassis to minimize the rotational moment applied to the chassis and improve the stability against vibration. The FB chassis is used for the chassis, and the whole chassis is firmly fixed as one box by a frame (Frame = frame) surrounding the outer circumference and beams (Beam = beam) passed in front and back. By combining members of different shapes and sizes, natural vibrations are mutually cancelled, and vibration of the chassis as a whole is greatly reduced. The top plate is equipped with a double-structured top plate. An eccentric insulator is used for the legs. This insulator is designed with the mounting hole offset from the center, and vibration propagation to the chassis is reduced by mutually canceling external vibration. The position and diameter of the hole are determined through repeated trial production and trial listening. This is particularly effective in attenuating mid - and high-frequency vibration components that affect audibility. The rotary music selection method using the jog dial is used for AMS, which is used to cue a few songs before or after. This makes it possible to make music selections that take advantage of the sense of the fingertips, such as quickly to the target music and slowly to the rest. Equipped with a custom edit function, you can control functions such as peak search, time edit, just edit, program edit, time fade, manual fader and variable fade. It is equipped with a custom file function and memory of custom index and delete bank is possible. The maximum number of cards is 224Ω. It is equipped with functions such as delete play, shuffle play, delete shuffle, auto space, timer play (auto start), 8Ω-mode repeat and index search. It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system. There are two analog outputs, fixed and variable. In addition, it is equipped with a headphone port with volume that can also be used for lineout. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"The R series CD player was developed using the same technology as the separate type CDP-R1Ωa and DAS-R1Ωa. It uses a center mechanical mounting system in which the mechanical deck is placed in the center of the chassis, which is least affected by external vibration. In addition, the mechanism is equipped with a high-rigidity stable-lock mechanism. The Stay-Lock Mechanism eliminates rattling by reducing the size of the components by eliminating excess projections from the components and assembling these components into a mutually constraining structure. In addition, the overall short span design greatly improves vibration resistance and strength against twisting and bending. On top of this, the G base unit and tray are reinforced with glass fiber by adding calcium carbonate of the same composition as marble to the base unit and tray. The G tray, a movable part, is equipped with a tray lock mechanism in which both sides of the tray are fixed to the mechanism block by two lock arms during performance. In addition to this, the top of the mechanical deck is equipped with a 5Ωmm thick extruded aluminum stabilizer to increase rigidity, and by placing it close to the disk, it acts as an air damper that vibrates the top plate and effectively reduces sound pressure entering the interior.

MOTOR
The servo circuit is equipped with a GTS servo, which continuously monitors the fluctuation of the pit train on the disk and works to eliminate the rapid fluctuation that the pit train cannot have. This GTS servo has a feature that mechanical noise is extremely small. In addition, since there is no wasteful response to scratches, sound skipping is difficult, and recovery to the pit string after passing through scratches is good, so the amount of information read from the disk increases. In addition, by separating and separating the grind line of the servo circuit with a bus bar, the influence on the ground potential of other circuits is greatly reduced, contributing to improved sound quality.

MOTOR
The optical disk drive motor is equipped with a 3Ω-phase BSL (brush & slotless) motor.

MOTOR
The 3Ω-phase BSL motor, which is structurally less susceptible to vibration, eliminates coking (torque pulsation) and improves stability. In addition, the safety margin of signal reading and servo tracking are improved. The D/A converter uses a pulse D/A converter similar to the DAS-R1Ωa. A pulse D/A converter uses one current source and one electronic switch and has only two output values, high (current flow) and low (no current flow). And all the intermediate values of audio waveforms are obtained by the time average of the pulse output, which is the spread of the binary output in the time axis direction. Therefore, in principle, the differential non-linear distortion caused by the error of the current source, the glitch and 0Ωcross distortion caused by the difference in the operation timing of the electronic switch, which are unavoidable in the conventional D/A converter, do not occur. The Pulse D/A converter achieves a maximum operating frequency of 50ΩMHz for the master clock and 50Ωmillion pulses per second. The Sony Extended Noise Shaping calculation method is used to calculate the pulses, and a high dynamic range is achieved by generating a high-density pulse train. The CDP-R3Ωuses two pulse D/A converters in the complimentary service mode to cancel harmonic distortion with auxiliary positive and negative outputs and to increase the S / N ratio by doubling the output current value. The master clock is placed so close to the pulse D/A converter that it can be said that it is directly attached, and a direct digital sync circuit for rearranging the data on the chip of the pulse D/A converter is mounted. This realizes a clean D/A conversion without jitter. The characteristics are improved by installing a low-jitter optical output unit. FB chassis is adopted for the chassis structure. This chassis is made of metal material of sufficient thickness and strength, and the whole chassis is joined by a frame surrounding the outer circumference and beams before and after passing the front and rear. This structure ensures almost total strength only by this frame and beams. It is fixed directly on the most neutral beam with low vibration without using any special metal fittings when mounting the mechanism and substrate. In addition, with CDP-R3Ω, the mass of the block is increased by fixing the large-weight power transformer on the same beam as the mechanical deck with anti-vibration measures. This is combined with the center mechanical mounting method to obtain a good weight balance, which simplifies the vibration moment and prevents the chassis from rotating. The legs are made of fine ceramic insulators combined with rubber with good braking performance. A 2Ω-transformer configuration is used for the power supply for digital servo independently and exclusively. In CDP-R3Ω, two transformers are housed in a single transformer case as a twin core transformer, and two transformers of the same size are arranged side by side to prevent mechanical tuning fork resonance. The front panel is designed to be as simple as possible, and only the minimum necessary functions related to play operation are arranged. Functions such as program performance are performed by the attached remote control. In addition to basic operations such as play / stop, the included remote control allows direct selection, program performance of up to 20Ωsongs, shuffle / delete shuffle performance with randomly rearranged songs, repeat performance in 6Ωmodes, etc. It also includes a program bank for storing the order of programmed songs, and a custom index for placing the original index in the desired part of a song. Equipped with an automatic timer start function that can start playing automatically by combination of external timers."
