name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A CD transport that pursues accurate signal pickup to the limit and ensures silence in every sense. We have developed and adopted a unique ""Twin Link Method"" to eliminate the clock disturbance that occurs during the signal transmission from the player to the D/A converter. In this system, the crystal oscillator for generating the master clock, which was conventionally installed in the player side, is installed in the D/A conversion section. This eliminates jitter from the clock at the time of D/A conversion and reduces phase distortion. In this twin-link system, optical round-trip cables are used. One cable is used for data transmission in the same way as before, and the other cable is used for synchronous signal transmission from DAS to CDP in the reverse way. We also use highly reliable and highly transparent silica-based optical fibers. The servo system employs a TS servo system designed not to respond more than necessary to fine irregularities caused by disc scratches or vibration disturbance. This circuit consists of an ordinary servo LSI and a TS compensator. The TS compensator continuously monitors the fluctuation of the pit string on the disk and eliminates the fluctuation that cannot be inherent in the pit string. Therefore, sound does not easily skip at the flaw, returns to the pit string after passing through the flaw, and increases the amount of information read from the disk. In addition, since the servo current is small, the load fluctuation of the power supply part is small, which also contributes to the sound quality improvement. The mechanism section employs a linear tracking mechanism that Sony is proud of. In CDP-R1Ω, aluminum die-cast is used for the housing of this mechanism to ensure sufficient strength and high accuracy. The FB chassis is composed of a frame that goes around the circumference and several beams that connect the frames before and after the frame. Each component with sufficient thickness and strength is reasonably and firmly jointed so that almost all the strength is ensured by the frame and beam alone. In addition, most of the mechanism and printed circuit board are fixed directly on the most vibrationally neutral beam without using any special metal fittings. By equalizing the strength of the entire body, the sound resonance is controlled.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply consists of two transformers : one power transformer with sufficient capacity and a choke transformer for noise reduction. The choke transformer acts as a kind of filter that blocks the digital noise leaking from the CD player and prevents noise from entering the AC line, which is the only electrical contact for optical transmission. Features include Program Performance / Program Bank, Custom Index with up to 6Ωindexes at any position on the disc, Repeat Performance with Full / One Specified Song / Programmed Song / Shuffle Play / Specified Between A and B / Custom Index, AMS with the ability to recall the beginning of the current or next song, and Direct Selection with the ability to recall a specified song. It has a coaxial output terminal that can be connected to a normal D/A converter unit. This uses a latched digital system that reduces clock jitter. It comes with a wireless remote control and includes only the minimum number of buttons."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"R10Ωseries CD transport with fixed optical system mechanism. An optical system fixing mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part. In a typical CD player, the disc is rotated on a fixed motor shaft, and the optical block for reading is moved from the inner circumference to the outer circumference. This method has the advantage of easy random access, such as moving from the first track to the fifth track, because the optical block is relatively light in weight. However, because the lightweight pickup part is easy to move, it is easily affected by external vibration, and it needs to be assisted by a focus and tracking servo mechanism. When the lens moves in a complicated manner, the servo current increases. This current flows into the ground, and at the same time, flux is emitted from the wire connecting the optical block and the substrate, degrading sound quality. In order to solve this problem, CDP-R10Ωhas a structure in which the optical block is fixed to the mechanism body, which is heavy and strong, and the disk side moves from the inner circumference to the outer circumference. This structure greatly reduces vibration to which the optical block is subjected, and the electric current required for the servo is only required to move the lens slowly to the side, thus reducing sound quality degradation.

TURNTABLE
A turntable system is adopted to reduce the effect of vibration on the disk side. In the CDP-R10Ω, the disk is mounted on an aluminum alloy turntable and fixed with a chucking pulley that generates high crimping force.

MOTOR
A non-servo thread mechanism is used for thread control to move the turntable side. The CDP-R10Ωthread control does not always move during the performance. It is structured to move intermittently at a rate of approximately 100ΩÏ‰ m once every 10Ωto 20Ωseconds, and the operation becomes more stable by taking a longer time of stopping.

TRANSPORT
In the non-servo thread mechanism, the timing of movement is determined by a theoretical amount calculated by a microprocessor, and the drive is performed by using a mechanically backlash free worm gear mechanism. The worm gear mechanism does not move even when a driving force is applied from the turntable side. It does not require electric power to stop, so it has an advantage in sound quality. The turntable is mounted on a bearing block containing a motor. The bearing block moves on a mechanical base to which the optical system is fixed by means of a thread control. To rattling during movement, the rails installed on the mechanical base are mirror-finished so that the bearing block wheels roll on the rails. The three main wheels ensure flatness, two side wheels maintain lateral accuracy, and five wheels maintain straightness. In addition, the bearing block and the mechanical base are attracted by magnetic force. The bearing block and the turntable are heavy and have a structure that is resistant to external vibration due to magnetic attraction between the bearing block and the mechanical base. Two wireless remote controls are included."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"An LD player compatible with Hi-Vision LD. The mechanism section employs a newly developed high-speed double-sided reproduction mechanism. This mechanism uses a parallel tilt system that allows both A and B sides of a warped disc to be reproduced under the same conditions. In addition, the optical block is supported by a double support system to minimize slight shaking and vibration. In addition, the effect of vibration is completely eliminated by adopting a belt drive system for the sled drive that moves the optical block and floating tilt and sled motors. We have also newly developed FND (frame number decoder)) LSIs and spindle servo LSIs to reduce image output time. The pickup section is equipped with a short-wavelength laser pickup with a wavelength of 670Ωnm that uses a self-pulsation red diode as the light source. In addition, the objective lens uses a highly reliable aspherical glass lens. In this way, we are thoroughly pursuing higher precision and stability in signal reading. This greatly reduces crosstalk even in NTSC LD reproduction, contributing to higher picture and sound quality. In addition, the effect of external noise is eliminated by using a differential RF output for signal transmission to the video circuit. Uses G chassis and G tray with high rigidity and excellent vibration absorption.

MOTOR
In addition, the spindle motor is equipped with a 3Ω-phase brushless motor that provides high torque and smooth rotation that is directly attached to the G chassis.

TURNTABLE
In addition, a die-cast turntable is used for the spindle motor, which is designed to prevent vibration. In addition to the NTSC LD, the Hi-Vision LD uses the first digital frame memory for a home LD player, enabling still image playback and variable-speed playback with the same beautiful picture quality as normal playback. The NTSC LD can be switched to the field memory according to the software. Direct video output via the BNC terminal is possible, and external independent Y/C separation circuits can be connected. In addition to significant improvements in crosstalk and S / N degradation in long-time disks due to the use of short-wavelength lasers, high-quality composite output is achieved through balanced transmission and high-precision BPF. It is equipped with a motion-adaptive three dimensional Y/C separation circuit using a 6Ω-megabit digital memory. For still images, the luminance signal and color signal are separated with high precision by 3Ω-dimensional processing that compares the correlation between frames on a pixel-by-pixel basis. For moving images where there is no correlation between frames, a proprietary high-precision 3Ω-line digital comb filter is used. This greatly reduces cross-color and dot interference, and greatly improves diagonal resolution and signal-to-noise ratio. In addition, the digital TBC using 1Ω-inch commercial VTR technology suppresses color unevenness caused by disc eccentricity and maximizes the characteristics of the Y/C separation circuit. It is equipped with motion-adaptive 3Ωd digital CNR (Chroma Noise Reduction), the first home-use LD player, and significantly reduces color noise without degrading vertical resolution through frame processing. As in-field processing, the moving image portion is processed with high precision according to the image condition to reproduce beautiful images. Sony's proprietary MUSE high-resolution technology has been introduced, and it is equipped with a new TBC system that combines a PILOT/H TBC and 32Ω.4ΩMHz oversampling. The new TBC for PILOT/HTBC uses both the PILOT signal method, which locks the time axis immediately when the disc starts to rotate stably, and the H (horizontal synchronous) signal method, which enables cooperative error correction when the disc rotates stably. The PILOT TBC is used for playback start and high-speed scanning, and when the disc moves to a good regenerating condition, it switches to HTBC to maintain high time axis accuracy, and realizes more stable high-definition video playback. The 32Ω.4ΩMHz oversampling circuit doubles the sampling frequency of 16Ω.2ΩMHz, which is the minimum required for processing MUSE signals, to 32Ω.4ΩMHz. As a result, the filter characteristics of analog circuits are relaxed and transmission characteristics are greatly improved, and reproducibility of high-frequency signal components such as details is enhanced. The D/A converter uses an advanced pulse D/A converter, and the digital filter uses a full feed-forward digital filter to improve low-level distortion.

MOTOR
A DC servo amplifier is used for the line amplifier section.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with a dedicated power supply circuit for audio with R-core transformer to reduce interference between the circuits. There are 2Ωcolor variations of gold and titanium gray. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"CD/MD deck which combines MD deck and CD player. CD synchronized recording is possible with one touch operation. In addition, operation such as multi-jog dial can be switched according to switching of the select button of CD/MD, and centralized control is possible. Equipped with a line input terminal and microphone input terminal, you can select two sources from among CD, line and microphone for recording to MD. When you press the REC IT button on the remote control while a CD is being played, it automatically returns to the beginning of the song and starts recording to the MD. When one song is recorded, the MD stops automatically and the CD continues playing from the next song.

HEADS
By combining with the Music Scan function, which plays only the head part of the recorded music on the CD one after another, you can quickly select and record music. With a built-in loop function, when you press the LOOP button on the remote control at the desired point during CD playback, part of the phrase of the song will be played repeatedly. The loop length can be changed up to 5Ωlevels. You can also select NORMAL, which starts playback again from the point where you press the LOOP button after repeating the loop, or RHYTHM, which starts from the point where you advance by the time of the loop. This function can also be used during recording to MD. It is equipped with a time machine recording function, and if you press the multi-jog dial in the recording pause state, the sound recorded up to 6Ωseconds before is recorded on the disc. description:
## Description

"A CD/MD deck that integrates the MD deck and CD player and can be connected to a PC. In addition to digital recording from CD to MD, it is equipped with CD-synchronized recording functions such as CD-synchronized recording that allows you to synchronize the timing between the start of performance and recording with the touch of a button. When you listen to a CD and press the REC IT button on the remote control, it automatically returns to the beginning of the song and starts recording to the MD. When you record only one song, the MD stops automatically and the CD continues to play from the next song. Connection with PC is possible by using PC connection kit PCLK-PX1Ω(sold separately). This allows you to perform basic MD/CD operations, record from CD to MD, and edit MD discs on your PC. Kanji and hiragana characters entered into the MD from a PC can be displayed on the full dot display of the main unit. You can also use alphanumeric characters, symbols and katakana characters for the title function for naming discs and songs. In the MD deck section, we have newly developed an adaptive high-frequency control technology for the DSP for the 4Ω.5Ωgeneration ATRAC to improve high-frequency reproducibility and natural sound spread. This technology effectively uses limited data based on human audibility. In response to input signals, if the number of quantization bits is small, the high-frequency range is limited and the number of quantization bits is increased. In response to signals containing complex frequency components that are less affected by insufficient quantization bits, the reproduction band is extended to higher frequencies to improve high-frequency reproducibility. The signal processing system has been improved by the combination of this adaptive high-frequency control technology and the extension of the operation word length in the wide bit stream, and the total harmonic distortion rate has been improved by about 8ΩdB compared to the conventional system. Wide bit stream technology has been introduced to enable recording and playback with a wide dynamic range of 20Ωbits equivalent to more than 16Ωbits of MD format by changing input / output to 20Ωbits and expanding operation word length. A hybrid pulse D/A converter is used in the CD player. It is equipped with a sampling rate converter that automatically converts 32ΩkHz and 48ΩkHz sampling frequency to 44Ω.1ΩkHz. Equipped with a digital REC level control, the gain can be controlled from -12ΩdB to a maximum of + 12ΩdB around a gain of 0ΩdB. It also has a built-in memory function that can store the set recording level for each input channel. Equipped with a pitch control function, you can listen at different playback speeds from -98Ω.5Ω% to + 12Ω.5Ω%. It is equipped with a music sync function. When you press the music sync button on the remote control and the connected device starts playing, it senses the input of a music signal and automatically starts recording. It is equipped with a time machine recording function. If you press the multi-jog dial in the recording pause state, the sound recorded on the disc is traced back to the sound of up to 6Ωseconds before. Equipped with a monaural recording and playback function that allows the disc to be used twice as long as the display. It has a TOC EDTI function that allows you to divide, combine, and move songs. It also has an UNDO function that allows you to cancel the last edit and redo it. It is also equipped with a rehearsal function so that you can make decisions while checking edit points in COMBINE or DIVIDE. You can move edit points finely by minute, second, or frame (approximately 0Ω.01Ωsecond). Equipped with the A-B ERASE function that allows you to easily erase between two specified points in a song. It is equipped with a title function that can record up to 1Ω,700Ωcharacters of disc names and song titles on the disc. In addition to conventional alphabets, numbers and symbols, katakana characters can also be input, and input can be done from the main body or remote controller. The SCMS (Serial Copy Management System) allows digital recording only for one generation and does not allow digital recording for two or more generations. It is equipped with a smart space function that automatically adjusts the non-recording portion of digital recording to approximately 3Ωseconds. Wireless remote control is included."

## Description

"The 5Ωcd changer / MD deck integrates the 5Ωcd changer and MD deck, and also supports the MDLP mode. It is possible to dub 4Ωx speed (2Ωx speed in MDLP mode) easily from 5Ωcd changer to MD. With the MXD-D5ΩC, HCMS (High Speed Copy Management System) does not allow you to record the same song at 4Ωx speed within 74Ωminutes from the start of 4Ωx recording. It is equipped with the MDLP mode, which is an improvement of the ATRAC audio compression technology and realizes about twice the compression performance of the conventional system. ATRAC reduces the data size by eliminating sound components that are hard to hear. ATRAC3Ω, which is used in the MDLP mode, further improves the compression ratio while minimizing degradation of sound quality. As one example, we have adopted a data encoding method called Huffman coding, which focuses on the frequency of data occurrence. Shorter codes are assigned to frequently occurring data sequences, and longer codes are assigned to infrequently occurring data sequences to improve compression efficiency. In addition, in order to maintain high sound quality even with high compression, we are also improving the accuracy of band division and spectrum blocking, which are pre-processes for compression processing, prior to compression processing. As for band division, conventional ATRAC divided it into three bands (low band up to 5Ω.5ΩkHz, middle band from 5Ω.5ΩkHz to 11ΩkHz, and high band from 11ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) and passed it to the next circuit. However, ATRAC3Ωdivided it into four bands (high band divided into 11ΩkHz to 16Ω.5ΩkHz and 16Ω.5ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) to allow extra processing space. Spectrum blocking is divided into 1Ω,024Ωsamples, which is twice as large as ATRAC, and employs a circuit configuration that recognizes the signal more finely and compresses it. In MD, data consisting of one pair of Lch and Rch is recorded alternately at a fixed time interval (11Ω.6Ωms in ATRAC). ATRAC3Ωcontrols the content of signal processing precisely every 1Ωms so that appropriate signal processing can continue even when the nature of music suddenly changes. Furthermore, ATRAC3Ωhas a new step called tone component separation, which extracts tone components and encodes (compresses) them separately from other components in order to maintain high sound quality. The MDLP has two modes : LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode, which enables recording at twice the disc recording time, and LP4Ωstereo recording mode, which enables recording at four times the disc recording time. The LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode reflects the high compression ratio of ATRAC3Ωand is suitable for long-duration music recording and playback. The LP4Ωstereo recording (playback) mode uses a compression method that allocates a large number of bits for center localization signals (vocals, bass, etc.), which play an important role in music signals. By reducing the amount of data to be recorded, the LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode even longer recording times. The MDLP cannot be recorded or played with the conventional model because the data allocation on the disk is different from the conventional format. However, the MDLP compatible model can record or play with the conventional format. Also, high-speed recording in the MDLP format is up to 2Ωx speed, and S. F Edit cannot be performed on discs recorded in the MDLP format. The S. F Edit (Scale Factor Edit) function allows you to adjust the volume and fade in / out after recording. The scale factor is a parameter that represents the peak above the level of a 52Ω-part floating unit. You can adjust the volume by changing this value. With this function, even if the recording level of a disc becomes uneven, you can adjust it later. This function reads the recorded data from the disc, edits the data, and writes it back to the disc. By introducing wide bit stream technology, the dynamic range of the core ATRAC DSP and the audio data word length of peripheral circuits such as digital in / out have been increased from 16Ωbits to more bits, enabling recording and playback with a wide dynamic range. To move edit points, you can fine-tune the DIVIDE edit point in minutes, seconds, or frames (approximately 0Ω.012Ωseconds). The time of one frame is 0Ω.023Ωseconds in the MDLP LP2Ωmode / monaural mode and 0Ω.047Ωsecond steps in the LP4Ωmode. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier that uses a direct coupling type power amplifier section.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section uses a direct coupling method. All stages are directly coupled without using a coupling or capacitor. Compared with conventional output circuits using capacitors, this allows power to be taken even at a lower frequency and prevents a decrease in damping factor. In principle, this direct-coupling method amplifies up to direct current, so it protects the speaker by cutting out the very low frequencies below the music component. The preamp section is equipped with input circuits such as two phono inputs and an AUX input Route 3Ω, left and right independent tone control, low / high filter, and sliding balance control. In addition, a large dynamic range is obtained by using a high voltage of 50Ωv for the pre-part power supply and increasing the allowable level of each input. Equipped with a quick access switch, the phono 1Ωand tuner can be switched quickly with this lever. This eliminates the need to switch the rotary switch in many steps and suppresses inadvertent noise. The switches on the back allow you to use the preamp and power amp independently. description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier that inherits the circuit system and sound quality policy of TA-AX8Ω/TA-AX7Ω. Using the audio current transfer method, the music signal is converted into a current signal, and the voltage is taken out again by the linear gain controller using the power amplifier input. This makes the internal impedance of the preamplifier as seen from the power amplifier infinite and electrically separates the preamplifier from the power amplifier and the left and right channels. For volume, linear gain controller is used instead of attenuator type volume. The linear gain controller is a 2Ω-terminal gain controller that generates a pure input voltage to the power amplifier stage. As the gain decreases, the impedance decreases, resulting in improved sound quality in actual use.

POWER AMPLIFIER
Legato linear system is used for power amplifier section. In the Legato linear system, the high-speed output Hi-ft transistor is operated in the minimum cut-off region without changing the bias or the power supply voltage, thereby realizing low distortion over a wide band / wide dynamic range. Straight transmission using a heat pipe is realized. Pulse power supply is used.

POWER SUPPLY
A constant-current shunt regulator is used for the power supply of the preamp section.

POWER SUPPLY
This allows the power supply to the preamp section to be converted into a strong constant-current power supply before it is supplied to the preamp section.

POWER AMPLIFIER
This reduces interference with the power amplifier section. High-quality components such as high-speed rectifier diodes and large-capacity green capacitors are used. Magnetic materials are eliminated from components as much as possible. Equipped with a cartridge load selector of 2Ωpositions each for MM/MC. Equipped with a Rec out selector. Uses a oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity indication. Equipped with a tone control that can be switched between Direct and ON. Equipped with base boost, audio muting, and low filter. The phono terminal is gold-plated."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier has almost the same configuration as the high-end TA-AX8Ω. An audio current transfer method is used to eliminate interference between the preamplifier and the power amplifier. This circuit converts the signal applied to the preamplifier into a constant-current signal system using a current conversion amplifier, and loads the 2Ω-terminal linear gain controller at the first stage of the power amplifier. Therefore, the preamplifier as seen from the power amplifier has infinite impedance, which is biogenetically equivalent to being completely disconnected. As a result, four separate amplifiers with independent pre-amplifiers and power amplifiers for each left and right channel have been realized. This makes it possible to pursue independent characteristics and at the same time to provide ideal grounding, effectively improving performance. The input signal and load are fixed so that the effects of the earth loop and power source impedance, and the effects of wires and switches in the signal path can be ignored. In addition, the two terminal gain control reduces the impedance as the gain is lowered, making the acoustic characteristics more effective.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the power supply section of the preamplifier uses a constant current shunt regulator to isolate the influence of the power amplifier power supply, and the source impedance becomes almost 0Ω, ensuring stable regulation. A legato linear system has been adopted in which switching distortion and crossover distortion of the power stage are drastically reduced without using methods such as shifting bias or changing the power supply voltage. In principle, the high-speed output Hi-ft transistor is operated in the minimum cutoff region. There are no nonlinear elements added to the signal system, and the operating condition does not change depending on the magnitude of the input signal. In addition, switching distortion is not observed up to the ultra-high frequency band of 100ΩkHz, and stable operation including phase characteristics can be ensured, so high-speed wide-band characteristics can be achieved. The power amplifier of the TA-AX8Ωis a clean switching DC amplifier using this legato linear system. In order to carry out the shortest distance wiring along the signal flow, it has been designed with the introduction of heat pipes applying heat treatment technology of spacecraft and electronic remote control of speaker switching.

POWER AMPLIFIER
As a measure against the temperature of power amplifiers, a heat pipe with thermal conductivity several hundred times that of a copper rod is used as a thermal conductor, which releases the transistor from the heat sink and eliminates lead wiring by attaching it directly to the circuit board.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a pulse power supply that guarantees extremely stable regulation despite its small size. In addition, since AC100ΩV is turned into DC as soon as it enters the amplifier, 50ΩHz/60ΩHz AC magnetic field is basically not generated, contributing to the non-flux of the amplifier. The power transistor is a Hi-ft transistor. This transistor has a structure in which low-power transistors with good high-frequency characteristics are integrated in an infinite Daigo, and the operating range is widened from 60ΩMHz to 80ΩMHz from the conventional 4ΩMHz, and the high-frequency response is extremely high-speed, thus reducing TIM distortion that pollutes sound. It is equipped with an FET differential servo equalizer amplifier without input / output capacitors. It is equipped with a fully connected DC amplifier without any capacitors from the signal system from the Phono input to the speaker output. This eliminates the low-frequency phase region. High-quality parts such as high-speed rectifier diodes and large-capacity green capacitors are used. Magnetic materials that affect sound quality such as non-magnetic aluminum top plate are eliminated as much as possible. Equipped with a two stage protection circuit that uses both a power limiter and current detection. It uses a soft-touch input selector with a relay that emphasizes sound quality. The selected position is confirmed by the indicator lamp. Equipped with a Rec out selector that allows you to select a recording source independently of the source being played. Equipped with MM/MC cartridge load selector, 100ΩpF/330ΩpF for MM and 40Ω� / 3Ω� for MC can be selected. The sound quality is adjusted by using a smooth linear gain controller. Equipped with tone control. It also has a TONE/DIRECT ON switching function that can pass through the TONE circuit. Equipped with a base boost function. It is equipped with a speaker selector with relay."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"Pre-main amplifier with CD direct function.

POWER AMPLIFIER
An audio current transfer system is adopted in which a total of four amplifier sections, a preamplifier section, a power amplifier section, and left and right amplifier sections, are electrically independent. In this method, a current conversion amplifier is inserted between the preamplifier and power amplifier, and the output of the preamplifier is converted into a current signal. The voltage signal is then converted back into a voltage signal by a linear gain control attenuator installed at the final stage of the current conversion amplifier. As a result, the effects of noise pollution factors such as contact resistance of switches and connectors and intrinsic impedance of wires, which could not be avoided with the conventional transmission method of voltage signal Ï‰ voltage signal, can be almost ignored.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In addition, the output impedance of the preamplifier section from the viewpoint of the power amplifier section becomes almost infinite, and the result is equivalent to the result of being disconnected from the viewpoint of electricity, and the performance is improved independently.

POWER AMPLIFIER
Legato linear system is used for the power amplifier section. In this method, dynamic distortion such as switching distortion and crossover distortion is reduced by using an orthodox and simple fixed bias method in terms of circuit without adopting a method of moving bias value or changing power supply voltage value. Dynamic distortion occurs because the operating range of the amplifying element used is narrow and the response speed in the high-frequency range is slow. To improve this, we have adopted a Hi-ft transistor with a wide operating range and a high response speed. By working in the ultra-cut-off range, the characteristic that no switching distortion is observed in the ultra-high-frequency range is realized. The volume uses a linear gain control attenuator that can be used with the audio current transfer method. This volume draws a curve in which the impedance decreases as the gain is reduced. The SN ratio in actual use is greatly improved compared to using a normal variable resistor. The CD Direct function is available.

EQUALIZER
When this function is ON, you can jump through the function / tape monitor / subsonic filter / graphic equalizer switch / tone control circuit to enjoy a more direct sound. Equipped with tone control with DEFEAT position. It is equipped with an input / output terminal for graphic equalizer connection and an AUX/TV input terminal for front panel priority. Large-capacity electrolytic capacitors for power supply and high-speed rectifier diodes are used. Oxygen-free copper wire with polarity display is used for the power cord. Equipped with a high gain equalizer for MC cartridges. Equipped with a subsonic filter. Equipped with speaker ON/OFF switch."

name: TA-F555ΩES
description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier is based on our proprietary technology and has been designed to support digital sources with thorough low brush-up of details. It employs an audio current transfer method that eliminates interference between the four amplifiers. In this circuit, the signal applied to the preamplifier is converted into a constant current type signal system using a current conversion amplifier, and the voltage signal is taken out again using a 2Ω-terminal linear gain control attenuator at the first stage of the power amplifier as a load. As a result, the preamplifier has infinite impedance as seen from the power amplifier and is completely electrically disconnected. At the same time, the L/R channels are separated so that the characteristics of the preamplifier, power amplifier and L/R channel can be pursued independently, and ideal grounding is possible. The input signal and load are clearly defined, there is no influence of the ground loop or power source impedance, and disturbance caused by wires or switches in the signal path can be ignored. The volume is equipped with a 2Ω-terminal linear gain control attenuator. This attenuator has characteristics such that the impedance decreases as the gain decreases and the acoustic characteristics become better. Therefore, the characteristics in actual use become better.

POWER SUPPLY
A constant-current shunt regulator is used in the power supply section of the preamplifier to completely eliminate the influence of the power amplifier power supply and to reduce the source impedance to almost 0Ω, ensuring stable regulation.

POWER AMPLIFIER
Legato linear system is used for power amplifier section. This technology drastically reduces switching and crossover distortion without changing bias or power supply voltage. It has such features as ""no nonlinear elements added to the signal system"", ""operating conditions do not change depending on the magnitude of the input signal"", ""no switching distortion is observed up to the ultra-high frequency band of 100ΩkHz"", and ""stable operation including phase characteristics is guaranteed"". As a result, high-speed and wide-band characteristics are realized, and high frequency distortion and good phase characteristics are obtained.

MOTOR
A DC servo is used in all amplifier sections of the equalizer, current drive and power amplifier. In addition, in order to eliminate thermal modulation distortion of circuits and elements, a constant PC circuit is adopted in the differential section of the equalizer amplifier and the first stage of the power amplifier. In addition, a dedicated heat sink is installed in each element to improve resolution in the audible band. We put in high-quality parts that have undergone repeated hearing tests. The power transistor is compatible with a Hi-ft transistor. This Tor G-ster has a wide-band operating range of 60ΩMHz to 80ΩMHz, which is more than one order of magnitude higher than the conventional 4ΩMHz, so that the high-frequency response characteristics are remarkably improved. In addition, it uses a large-capacity capacitor, high-speed rectifier diode, oxygen-free copper internal wiring material and power cord, copper-plated copper-tight case to reduce magnetic strain, etc. MM cartridge and MC cartridge can be connected. In addition, it is equipped with MC (40Ω� / 3Ω�) and MM (330ΩpF/100ΩpF) cartridge load selectors. Equipped with a Rec out selector that allows you to select the recording source regardless of the listening source and to copy it from Tape1Ωto Tape2Ω. It has a tone control circuit and a direct switch that passes through the circuit. Equipped with a base boost function. Equipped with a muting circuit. Built-in speaker protection circuit."

description:
## Description

"This is a pre-main amplifier of the high-end model of the ES series that goes through not only the circuit technology but also the construction and every part including the fine details due to the philosophy of simple and straight music signal. An audio current transfer system has been adopted to improve the characteristics of four amplifiers (preamp, power amplifier, L and R).

POWER AMPLIFIER
In this method, a current conversion amplifier is inserted between the preamp section and the power amplifier section. The output of the preamp section, which comes out as a voltage signal, is first converted into a current signal, and then converted back into a voltage signal by a linear gain control attenuator installed at the final stage of the current conversion amplifier. Therefore, the preamplifier section has infinite impedance as seen from the power amplifier, and is completely electrically isolated. As a result, it is possible to pursue the characteristics of each of the four amplifier sections independently. In addition, it is possible to ignore the noise pollution factors such as the contact resistance of the switch and connector and the intrinsic impedance of the wire. In addition, by adopting the linear gain control type attenuator, which can be used in the audio current transfer system, as the volume for volume adjustment, the impedance decreases as the gain is reduced. As a result, various characteristics at the volume position in actual use are improved.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply for the preamp section uses a constant current shunt regulator to eliminate the influence of the power amplifier power supply and to ensure stable regulation.

POWER AMPLIFIER
A high-speed output element Hi-f is provided in the power amplifier section without shifting bias or changing the power supply voltage. TIt employs a Leger-Linear system in which the transistor operates in a very small cutoff region. In addition, the 4Ω-para push configuration reduces dynamic distortion such as switching distortion and crossover distortion over a wide band. In addition, it is equipped with a powerful power supply part of 2Ωpower transformer, 6Ωwinding, 7Ωpower supply. A DC amplifier system is used to prevent the negative effect of the signal capacitor on sound quality.

POWER AMPLIFIER
To stabilize the operation of the DC amplifier and section to stabilize the operation of the DC amplifier and obtain a rich low frequency range. In order to eliminate thermal modulation distortion of the circuit and element, a constant PC circuit was adopted in the differential section of the equalizer amplifier and the first stage of the power amplifier to improve the resolution in the audible band. LC-OFC is used for wiring materials, printed circuit boards, power cords, etc. We also use a large number of carefully selected components such as high-capacity capacitors, copper-plated chassis to eliminate magnetostriction, and large heat sinks with high heat dissipation. The core material is an amorphous alloy, and a booster transformer for MC cartridge is built in with special filling process. Based on the G-chassis, each part is made more rigid when mounted. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier developed with the technology of higher-end equipment. A twin-monaural construction is adopted in which the power supply is placed in the center of the chassis and left and right power amplifiers are placed on both sides of it. Good channel separation is achieved by separating the power amplifier, which tends to cause crosstalk between channels, like a monaural amplifier in which the heat sink is independent on the left and right.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, in consideration of the influence of the high current power section and power supply section on the pre-section that handles small signals, we have adopted a 2Ωbox separate structure that separates the inside of the chassis with a beam.

POWER AMPLIFIER
MOS FET is used for the drive stage and final stage of the amplifier circuit. The high input impedance of the MOS FET allows the driver stage and output stage to be electrically separated to reduce interference with each other. As a result, high sound quality can be obtained with a relatively simple circuit structure, and odd-order distortion, which is easy to hear, can be suppressed. To take advantage of the superior characteristics of MOS FET, the new ES amplifier uses MOS-exclusive design. In this configuration, an optical bias circuit is adopted in which an optical element with the same temperature characteristics as the MOS FET is added to the bias circuit in order to suppress the change of idling current that occurs when the temperature characteristics of the bias circuit and the temperature characteristics of the MOS FET of the current amplification stage do not match. This keeps the idling current constant and ensures more stable amplification of the audio signal.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, by increasing the capacity of the bypass capacitor of the bias circuit, the impedance is lowered and a richer low-frequency range is realized.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with a newly developed torus toroidal transformer.

POWER SUPPLY
This transformer improves the adhesion of the coil by making the core section oval, which was rectangular in the conventional toroidal transformer. This improves the efficiency, greatly reduces the generation of vibration, and reduces the influence on the audio signal. In addition, the total length of the coil is shortened, which reduces the impedance. The Advanced S. T. D. (Spontaneous Twin Drive) power supply is used for the power supply circuit configuration. In the conventional S. T. D.

POWER SUPPLY
POWER AMPLIFIER
power supply, the voltage amplification stage (A class stage) and the power amplification stage (B class stage) are each provided with a dedicated rectifier circuit, and power is supplied separately and independently. This prevents changes in the power supply voltage of the power amplification stage at the time of large output from adversely affecting the power supply of the voltage amplification stage, thereby improving sound quality. The Advanced S. T. D. power supply is a further development of this system. An induction coil is added to the voltage amplification stage to reduce voltage fluctuations during rectification. In addition, a large-capacity capacitor is installed to supply a large instantaneous current. As a result, sound quality in the middle and high frequency range, S / N ratio and dynamic range are improved. Using a newly adopted pure input circuit, we have reduced the number of switches on the signal path from the input terminal through the input selector to the master volume to less than half of the conventional switches, thereby reducing signal degradation. For the same reason, we have adopted a muting circuit that does not have contacts on the signal path. Furthermore, by adopting the Tape Monitor method, the purity of the source signal is kept high. By adopting a large aluminum heat sink with independent left and right channels, the temperature inside the chassis is balanced between left and right and good separation characteristics are obtained. In addition, the TA-FA3ΩES employs a radial heat sink in which fins are concentrated at the base of the transistor, so that mid-to-high-frequency resonance, which greatly affects sound quality, is prevented from being transmitted to the transistor. FB chassis is used for the chassis structure. The FB chassis is made of metal material with sufficient strength and thickness to make the entire chassis as a single box. Moreover, the frame surrounding the outer circumference and the beams to the front, back, left and right have different shapes and sizes and are combined by screws. description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier was developed using the high-quality technology of the New ES series. A twin-monaural construction is adopted in which the power supply is placed in the center of the chassis and left and right power amplifiers are placed on both sides of it. Good channel separation is achieved by separating the power amplifier, which tends to cause crosstalk between channels, like a monaural amplifier in which the heat sink is independent on the left and right. For the pre-section that handles small signals, we have adopted a 2Ω-box separation structure that separates the inside of the chassis with beams in consideration of the influence of the power section and power section with large current. The amplifier circuit begins with a junction FET that eliminates the need for a coupling capacitor at the input stage, and extends to a MOS FET at the voltage amplifier stage (A-class stage), drive stage, and power MOS FET at the final stage, all of which use non-magnetic FETs exclusively for audio. MOS FET's high input impedance allows the driver stage and output stage to be electrically separated, reducing interference with each other. As a result, high sound quality can be obtained with a relatively simple circuit structure, and odd order distortion, which is easy to be heard, can be suppressed. To take advantage of the superior characteristics of MOS FET, the new ES amplifier uses MOS-exclusive design. This circuit is called an optical bias circuit in which an optical element having the same temperature characteristics as the MOS FET is added to the bias circuit in order to suppress the variation of the idling current that occurs when the temperature characteristics of the bias circuit and the temperature characteristics of the MOS FET of the current amplification stage do not match. This circuit is called an optical bias circuit in which an optical element having the same temperature characteristics as the MOS FET is added to the bias circuit, so that the idling current is kept constant and the audio signal is amplified more stably.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, by increasing the capacity of the bypass capacitor of the bias circuit and reducing the impedance, a rich low-frequency range is obtained.

POWER SUPPLY
We have adopted a newly developed torus toroidal transformer for the transformer of the power supply section.

POWER SUPPLY
In this transformer, the core section of the conventional toroidal transformer is made into an oval shape to improve the adhesion of the coil. This improves efficiency, greatly reduces vibration, and reduces the influence on the audio signal. In addition, since the total length of the coil is shortened, impedance is lowered. Advanced S. T. D. (Spontaneous Twin Drive) power supply is used for the power supply part. In the conventional S. T. D.

POWER SUPPLY
POWER AMPLIFIER
power supply, the voltage amplifier stage (A class stage) and the power amplifier stage (B class stage) are separately and independently supplied with power from the rectifier circuit. Thus, the change in the power supply voltage of the power amplifier stage does not adversely affect the power supply of the voltage amplifier stage even at high output, and the sound quality is improved. The Advanced S. T. D. power supply is a further development of this system. An induction coil is added to the voltage amplification stage to reduce voltage fluctuations during rectification.

POWER SUPPLY
A large-capacity capacitor is also equipped to supply a large instantaneous current, thereby improving sound quality in the middle and high frequency range, S / N ratio and dynamic range. The newly adopted pure input circuit reduces the number of switches on the signal path from the input terminal through the input selector to the master volume to less than half of the conventional switches, thereby reducing signal degradation. For the same reason, the muting circuit is also designed without contact points on the signal path. In addition, all signals from each input terminal were sent to the Rec out selector until now. However, by releasing circuits other than the source selected by the Rec out selector right after the input terminal, the purity of the signal is kept higher. A large aluminum heat sink for each of the left and right channels is installed to maintain a balance between the temperature inside the chassis and to obtain good separation characteristics. The FB chassis is made of metal with sufficient strength and thickness. The entire chassis is constructed as a solid box. In addition, the frame surrounding the outer circumference and the beams passed in front, back, left and right have different shapes and sizes and are combined by screws. This makes the frame and beams with different vibration modes combined, greatly reducing vibration inside and outside the chassis. In addition, the power supply and heat sink are fixed to the central base beam to ensure good weight balance and strength. An eccentric insulator is used for the insulator. By offsetting the screw hole from the center, the phase of vibration transmitted from each direction on the circumference to the screw is changed, and vibration transmitted to the chassis is mutually cancelled. The shape was a prototype and sound quality was examined. As a result, the diameter was reduced to 50Ωmm, which is smaller than conventional ones. The volume is a high-quality volume that uses a low-distortion print resistor and a non-magnetic, gold-plated slider brush. The output stage employs a super legato linear system that reduces switching distortion and crossover distortion, and also reduces distortion at the reproduction level in actual use. Built-in phono equalizer amplifier with low-noise FET. Equipped with an ES filter that reduces noise contamination from the AC line. Pre-output terminal is mounted. There are 2Ωvariations, gold and black. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"ES series pre-main amplifier that uses MOS-FET.

POWER AMPLIFIER
MOS-FET, which has excellent characteristics as an amplifying element, is used in the power stage and drive stage of the power amplifier section. In addition, a fixed optical bias circuit is used for the circuit system, and an optical element with the same temperature characteristics as the MOS-FET is inserted into the bias circuit to keep the idling current constant. A torus / toroidal transformer is used for the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
In this transformer, the cross-section of the iron core (core) is oval to improve the adhesion between the core and coil and reduce vibration. Using a pure input circuit, the contact points from the input terminal to the master volume are greatly reduced. In addition, a circuit design that does not use connectors as much as possible for the wiring between the internal blocks ensures straight signal transmission. With a source direct switch, the tone control circuit and balance control circuit can be bypassed if they are not required. The internal layout uses twin monaural construction with separate left and right power amplifiers. In addition, by adopting a 3Ω-block configuration in which the pre-part, power part and power part are clearly separated in the chassis, good channel separation with less crosstalk is obtained. An eccentric insulator is used for the leg part to reduce vibration from the floor. It has an input terminal that supports both MM and MC cartridges. Wireless remote control is included. The remote also provides basic control over Sony audio components such as CD players."

name: TA-E1Ω
description:
## Description

"A control amplifier that pursues simplicity and straightness, giving top priority to reproducing the information amount of SACD. In order to achieve high frequency reproduction, we have reduced the number of functions to the minimum required and eliminated signal degradation caused by switches, etc. as much as possible, making it possible to design circuits that achieve simple and straight signal flow. The basic circuit consists of an input section using a high-quality gold contact resin-encapsulated relay for switching signals at the shortest distance. The amplifier section uses a linear phase circuit with excellent frequency and phase characteristics. Each amplifier block consists of a metal core module. The last output stage is equipped with a MOS-FET with excellent high-frequency characteristics. A newly developed linear phase circuit is used for the amplifier. This circuit is characterized by low attenuation in the high-frequency range and low phase rotation, which reduces the need for phase correction and enables high-slew rate a high slew rate. Each amplifier block of balance input, balance output and line amplifier is a metal core module. Components are surface-mounted on a metal core (metal substrate) made of an aluminum alloy. The substrate itself has excellent thermal conductivity, and the heat balance of the entire circuit is extremely good. In addition, each block is made into a module, making it resistant to external vibration, contributing to improved sound quality and reliability. An amorphous power transformer is used for the power transformer. This transformer uses an amorphous metal core, which has excellent characteristics. Since it is an amorphous metal with no crystal structure, there is little conversion loss, electrical noise and mechanical vibration, and the S / N ratio and the amount of information in the sense of hearing are increased. Moreover, the transformer is mounted in a non-magnetic NF (non-fired) ceramic case with excellent vibration characteristics. A high-precision volume with an interlocking error of ¥0Ω.5ΩdB within a range of -100ΩdB to 0ΩdB is used. The volume uses oxygen-free copper terminals and a gold-plated multi-contact brush, the resistor uses a CP (Conductive Plastic) resistor with low strain and high reliability, and the exterior casing is machined from brass for a high strength case with a diameter of 50Ωmm and a maximum thickness of 9Ω.5Ωmm."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A DC preamplifier developed by inheriting the concept of amplifier making in the TA-E88Ω. In general amplifiers, the volume and switches are arranged on the front panel, and the input / output terminals are arranged on the rear panel. Although this layout is reasonable in terms of usability, signal degradation due to lead wiring was unavoidable. The TA-E86Ωeliminates this restriction and uses a component layout that gives priority to signal flow. The internal layout of the TA-E86Ωis such that the left and right channels are clearly separated by a shield plate. The volume and balance volume are directly attached to the printed circuit board near the shield plate for both L and R signal systems. The switches are also installed in separate positions for L and R, and they are interlocked and switched by the shaft from the front. In addition, all signal components are directly attached to the printed circuit board to prevent electromagnetic induction caused by lead wire routing. Functions such as tape copy switches and tone such as tape copy switches and tone controls, are eliminated as much as possible, and a simple circuit structure is used to improve sound quality.

EQUALIZER
Equipped with an equalizer amplifier of DC configuration.

POWER SUPPLY
The first stage is a cascode connection of differential amplification by dual FET, which suppresses degradation of high frequency characteristics and prevents mixing of unnecessary components due to external noise such as hum and power supply fluctuation by combination with constant current circuit. The second stage is a cascode connection of differential circuit by dual transistor, which reduces temperature drift and improves output linearity and distortion factor. Since it is a DC amplifier without an input capacitor, there is no low-frequency phase rotation.

EQUALIZER
The flat amplifier section has the same circuit configuration as the equalizer amplifier except for the circuit constant and time constant circuit.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The DC amplifier configuration prevents degradation of low-frequency characteristics. The MC head amplifier employs a newly developed ultra-low-noise transistor, LEC-II, which is equivalent to the conventional parallel connection of 10Ωlow-noise transistors, and realizes a high SN ratio. The circuit configuration is a single-stage differential and two cut-off direct-coupled configuration with Darlington connection. This circuit is almost equivalent to the HA-55Ωsingle head amplifier. It is equipped with a base boost amplifier as an auxiliary for miniature speakers. In general tone control, the entire low-frequency range is raised, but in the base boost amplifier, the volume of the low-frequency range is not lost because the boost is centered around 100ΩHz, while in the ultra-low-frequency range below 80ΩHz, the volume of the low-frequency range is not lost. In addition, the volume of the ultra-low-frequency range below 80ΩHz is reduced so that the speaker is not overwhelmed.

EQUALIZER
The Phono circuit is equipped with a low filter, which can cut out very low frequency harmful components such as sleds of records. It is also equipped with a 5Ω-stage cartridge load selector. Separate FET buffer power supplies are provided for the head amplifier and the equalizer / flat amplifier. This improves the crosstalk characteristics by suppressing fluctuations in the input voltage with high capability and by reducing the low-output impedance characteristics. The newly developed volume has excellent characteristics such as crosstalk, square-wave response, and distortion factor. Uses high-quality parts that have been carefully examined, selected, and developed in consideration of sound quality changes depending on the parts. A polypropylene film capacitor is used for the NF element. In this capacitor, the electrodes are finely divided by using a thick insulator with high rigidity for the insulation between the electrodes to reduce the electric field strength and suppress mechanical resonance. In addition, high-precision metal film resistors with temperature characteristics of ¥50Ωmm and allowable deviation of less than 1Ω% are actively used at important points to suppress deviation and drift of frequency characteristics. A copper plate of 1Ωmm thickness with a U-shaped cross section is used for the common ground of the left and right channels to reduce impedance by reducing resistance value. Gold-plated terminals are used for input / output terminals. Equipped with quick access type function selector, tape monitor switch and mode switch."

name: TA-ER1Ω
description:
## Description

"This is an R series stereo preamplifier designed to recognize the role of the preamplifier and to focus on the basics of amplification. In the TA-ER1Ω, the balance input terminal is directly connected to a high-equilibrium balance amplifier, and the input signal is immediately differentially synthesized. As a result, the CMRR (common-mode rejection ratio) of 50ΩdB of the high-equilibrium balance amplifier can be fully utilized for noise reduction, and the SN ratio of the transmission path, which is usually around 120ΩdB, has been successfully raised to around 170ΩdB. In order to reduce the voltage drop that causes signal loss, a high input impedance design that allows transmission with almost no signal current is adopted. By using a high-performance FET for the input element, the input impedance is increased from the normal 20Ωk � ~ 100Ωk � to a balanced input of 4ΩM �. This reduces the signal current to 1Ω/40Ω~ 1Ω/200Ωcompared to the normal one, and at the same time, the distortion is sufficiently suppressed. In addition, the high input impedance design reduces the load on the drive for the input device and allows the source signal to be transmitted faithfully. In addition, the distortion at the 0Ωcrossing of the low-frequency signal from the + side to the - side and from the - side to the + side is greatly improved and low-level bass reproduction is improved. It is designed to take advantage of the balance amplifier for unbalanced inputs. The hot and cold inputs of the balance amplifier are connected to the hot and cold inputs of the balance amplifier, and the hot and shield of the pin jack are connected respectively. Thus, only the signal transmitted between the hot shield of the pin jack is amplified, and the fluctuation of the ground potential inside the chassis is not amplified, so that the SN ratio can be increased. A parallel switched function is used to manage the ground line thoroughly. The input selector switches between hot and shielded simultaneously. Only the shield side of the selected input terminal is connected to the ground line, which is the reference for amplification, and the shield of other devices is disconnected. This eliminates the fluctuation of ground potential caused by multiple devices concentrating on the preamplifier, and improves the sound quality of unbalanced input. We have developed and installed a high sound quality attenuator using conductive plastic resistor for the volume. This resistor is made by mirror-coating a hard substrate with a low-strain carbon-based conductive resin. The precision of the resistor is extremely high, and it can narrow the input signal by more than 130ΩdB. It also boasts a gang error (difference in attenuation between channels) of less than 1ΩdB at -100ΩdB. The attenuator is housed in a brass case with a maximum wall thickness of 9Ω.5Ωmm, and the case and electrode brush are gold-plated to improve electrical and mechanical performance.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In order to realize a strong signal drive to the power amplifier, a MOS Direct SEPP method complimentary service circuit using power MOS FET as an output pair is mounted. Since the MOS FET has a transfer function of the second order characteristic, the distortion is mainly of even order, so that the adverse effect on the music signal is reduced. Furthermore, the combination of the MOS FET with the complimentary service SEPP circuit has the advantage that the second order characteristics cancel each other and lower distortion can be obtained. To take full advantage of this, the MOS Direct SEPP scheme carefully designs the pre-stage bias circuit to eliminate the source resistance that is usually added for bias stabilization. The direct output by the power MOS FET keeps the linearity of the signal good without losing the beautiful square characteristic of the element itself, and the bare output impedance is also sufficiently low. Therefore, even when a long cable is drawn from the preamplifier to the power amplifier, the drive performance is always stable. In order to improve the performance of each circuit section, we have adopted a unit amplifier configuration with separate boards for each amplifier block of phono equalizer amplifier, input balance amplifier, and output balance amplifier. Each unit amplifier board is fixed to the main board of each amplifier block by pin point support. The two layer construction enables smooth signal flow and easy printed wiring. In addition, a 12Ωmm thick stabilizer made of a high-rigidity resin composite material is mounted on the unit amplifier in order to improve vibration control, preventing the generation of modulation noise caused by vibration. Furthermore, in order to avoid the deterioration of the S / N ratio and the irregularity of vibration mode caused by the formation of a ground loop due to excessive L/Rch separation, the distance between channels is reduced as much as possible, and the L/Rch unit amplifiers are arranged in equilibrium on the main circuit board. In electrical terms, the power supply line and ground line are strictly separated by L/Rch. By twin monaural wiring, 110ΩdB separation and characteristics are achieved. A phono equalizer amplifier a phono equalizer amplifier for MC/MM cartridges. This amplifier has dedicated input terminals for MC and MM in order to reduce contact points caused by switching the switch. For the MC input, a step-up transformer is installed to increase the gain of the signal, and an input impedance of 3Ω� / 30Ω� can be selected. In addition, a floating connection can be selected by separating the shield side of the signal from the ground, so that higher sound quality can be obtained when noise sources such as power transformers can be kept away. For the MM input, a MM load terminal is separately provided. The input impedance / capacity of 100Ωk � / 100Ωpf can be changed to 50Ωk � / 100Ωpf by using the load pin.

EQUALIZER
The phono equalizer circuit uses an NF type and is assembled in a discrete configuration. The balance input is equipped with a phase invert switch so that it can be used with either No. 3Ωhot or No. 2Ωhot input devices. In addition, the pre-out is equipped with one balanced output and one unbalanced output. Both are equipped with positive-phase / negative-phase pair output terminals so that it can be used with No. 2Ωhot balanced input power amplifier and balanced BTL connection which are often used overseas.

TRANSPORT
The volume control mechanism is equipped with a locking gear mechanism driven by an ultrasonic ceramic motor and can be operated by a remote control. A thick gear plate is attached to the volume shaft, and the gear is engaged with the motor side gear each time the volume is operated, and it is separated after the operation. This structure prevents rattling because the drive mechanism is completely separated except during operation.

MOTOR
Also, the motor itself is powered by piezoelectric ceramic displacement, so there is no harmful flux or spark noise, and it is used as a weight when stopped. It is also advantageous from the aspect of vibration. In addition, the series of operations from start to stop of the motor is precisely controlled by a microcomputer, and stepping operation of about 1Ω/128Ωrotation (1Ω/5Ωscale) and continuous rotation operation can be freely performed. Equipped with a dual-mode attenuator, which is useful for low volume situations. Switching to the low-extend position changes the resistance / rotation curve to expand the range of adjustment for low volume situations from approximately three scales to approximately eight scales from the left at normal volume levels. In this system, no extra circuit is used at normal volume levels, so that sound quality is not degraded. Also, the L/Rch balance control employs a method that adjusts the gain of each L/Rch amplifier itself by switching the relay within a range of 1ΩdB step by 1ΩdB and 3ΩdB on one side. Equipped with a muting switch, signal off operation is possible. The power supply part is separated from the amplifier body in consideration of the effect of the flux of the power transformer, etc., and is designed in a separate case.

POWER SUPPLY
This power supply unit is equipped with a large toroidal transformer with low leakage flux and a high-quality power supply capacitor. It is designed to generate high-quality direct current before supplying it to the amplifier body.

POWER SUPPLY
This protects the audio signal from noise and allows for a design with room for both the power supply unit and the amplifier body. The TA-ER1Ωhas a built-in microcomputer for remote control volume operation and input switching using a relay exclusively designed for audio. To prevent this microcomputer signal from adversely affecting the audio signal, we have adopted a self-off system that stops all microcomputer operations within one second after the operation is completed. Since the L/Rch ground and the ground of L/Rch is short-circuited, the crosstalk characteristic deteriorates. Therefore, it is advantageous for sound quality if the position of the headphone terminal is close to the ground reference of the amplifier. Therefore, the headphone port is installed on the rear panel so that you can enjoy headphone listening with higher sound quality. Specially designed OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrates manufactured by rolling OFC ingots are used for circuit boards, and 6ΩN OFC wires with less than 1Ωppm of impurities are used for all signal lines from input to output, power supply, and ground wiring. Uses a brass machined gold plated pin jack terminal with sufficiently high flange strength. Gold plating is more than 10Ωtimes thicker than that used in ordinary Hi-Fi equipment, ensuring long-term connection stability. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"An AV control amplifier equipped with Dolby Pro Logic and equipped with DSP developed with Sony's digital technology. Equipped with DSP (Digital Signal Processor). The sound heard at concert halls and other venues consists of three types of sounds : direct sound coming from instruments and other sound sources, early reflected sound coming after bouncing off walls and ceilings several times, and main reverberation sound coming later after following a complex path. DSP is developed with the concept of creating sound fields at concert halls and other venues by controlling the magnitude, direction, length, and interval of early reflected sound and main reverberation sound. The TA-E1000ΩESD is equipped with two types of dedicated LSIs developed by Sony for the DSP : the CXD1355ΩQ and the CXD1160Ω. The CXD1355ΩQ provides the DSP with the control of the DSP and also includes an 8Ωfs digital filter. The CXD1160Ωprovides the DSP with the control of the DSP and the equalization. description:
## Description

"An AV preamplifier equipped with the latest digital cinema sound technology and also compatible with DTS. These include large-capacity power transformers, electrolytic capacitors for power supplies, signal switching relays, and MELF-type resistors, all of which are carefully selected from those used in Sony's high-end Component R Series. Digital i-volume is used for the volume part. The digital i-volume is designed to take advantage of the characteristics of the current pulse D/A converter. With the current pulse D/A converter, the level of the output audio waveform can be changed by changing the value of the current source. Therefore, the digital i-volume is controlled by indicating the amount of current through the built-in microcomputer. As a result, the analog volume, which is sensitive to vibration, does not exist on the circuit, including for balance adjustment, and the volume can be adjusted without losing the resolution of digital data up to the final output terminal. It is equipped with a jitter-free D/A converter system. By performing D/A conversion using the clean clock signal of the oscillator installed immediately adjacent to the D/A converter, the jitter component (fluctuation of time axis) contained in the input clock is removed. The jitter-free signal is converted into a pulse-modulated waveform by high-speed operation at 50ΩMHz using an advanced pulse conversion method, a method unique to Sony that does not generate high-frequency distortion even in 1Ω-bit D/A conversion methods. A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter. Since the Advanced Pulse converted signal is a pulse train represented by a voltage, passing this signal through a low-pass filter produces an audio waveform as it is.

POWER SUPPLY
However, the voltage pulse signal is susceptible to fluctuations in the power supply voltage, and is also susceptible to voltage-induced noise generated by digital circuits. Therefore, the current pulse D/A converter uses a clean current source for switching using voltage pulses to generate current pulses, thereby making it less susceptible to voltage fluctuations. The A/D converter is equipped with CXD8607Ωas an LSI for the A/D converter. To enable high-quality D/A conversion of digital signals, a 96ΩkHz / 24Ω-bit interface receiver is adopted. The transmission speed of the coaxial digital input terminal is increased to 96ΩkHz, twice the normal transmission speed, and the usable bit tone is 24Ω-bit. The input digital signal passes through the DSP section and is converted into an audio signal by a D/A converter. The D/A converter also has the ability to convert a 96ΩkHz signal into an audio waveform without downsampling. We have introduced new digital cinema sound technology with higher computing power than before. The TA-E9000ΩES uses two 32Ω-bit DSPs from Shinkai to dramatically improve calculation accuracy and sound quality. In addition, the 32Ω-bit DSP is used to receive the 32Ω-bit DSP data for the decoder without any loss. The new Digital Cinema Sound is equipped with a Virtual Theater mode that combines the Cinema Studio mode and the Virtual 3ΩD mode. This mode is equipped with two types of modes : a mode in which an actual rear speaker is installed, and a mode in which only the front speaker is used. Equipped with SHARC, a 32Ω-bit DSP made by Analog Devices Inc. for decoding Dolby digital. The SHARC is a 32Ω-bit floating-point DSP that provides better sound quality than that of traditional 20Ω-24Ωbit precision fixed-point DSPs. The RS 232Ωc interface is installed for upgrading the surround program. It comes with a bi-directional remote control with a 4Ω.5Ωinch liquid crystal touch panel. For the TA-E9000ΩES, two types of upgrade kits were released. The VUCD-E9000ΩA can support Cinema Studio EX and Virtual Matrix 6Ω.1Ωdeveloped after the release of the TA-E9000ΩES. The BS-E 9000Ωb is compatible with MPEG-2ΩAAC decoding, which is a VUCD digital audio system."
