name: TA-N9Ω
description:
## Description

"This monaural power amplifier was developed with the latest technology and devices aiming at the highest performance and sound quality as a power amplifier to reproduce high-quality sources with a large dynamic range more faithfully, which was born with the appearance of PCM equipment. A high-voltage double-diffused MOS-FET is used for the power element. The V-FET used in Sony amplifiers had greatly improved basic performance such as distortion factor compared with transistors. However, the negative bias of the V-FET makes it difficult to use in applications. For example, in the TA-N7Ω, a measure was taken to improve this. For example, a cascode connection with a transistor with superior high-frequency characteristics was used. The power MOS-FET (2ΩSK173Ω/2ΩSJ54Ω) used in the TA-N9Ωwas developed by further expanding and developing the high-withstand voltage technology of 1000ΩV and the power FET manufacturing technology obtained at the time of trial manufacture of the V-FET. Among MOS-FETs, it has a double-diffused structure that is considered advantageous for high-frequency characteristics and high-withstand voltage. When a power amplifier is composed of this power MOS-FET, a large output can be easily obtained because it can handle a large current (up to 10ΩA) at a high withstand voltage (210Ωv). In addition, it has high reliability and safety, and because it has excellent high-frequency naked characteristics, there is little transient intermodulation distortion. The TA-N9Ωuses this element for the output stage in 5Ω-pair parallel push-pull operation. The circuit configuration of the amplifier section consists of a DC differential amplifier circuit with dual FET for the first stage and current mirror load. The second stage consists of a DC amplifier with an active amplifier. The voltage amplifier stage has a bare gain of approximately 100ΩdB. Moreover, since the bare characteristics before applying NF are improved, the distortion in the NF loop is also greatly reduced. The power driver stage is driven by a small transistor with excellent high-frequency characteristics because the input impedance of the power MOS-FET is large.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The complete DC amplifier configuration eliminates the problem of phase rotation in the low frequency range. We have developed and adopted a heat pipe for audio equipment for the heat radiation part. Since the TA-N9Ωhas a large output, the maximum signal voltage is ¥90ΩV and the instantaneous current is 16ΩA. This can affect the output stage to the first stage of the power amplifier.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In particular, when the wire of the power element of the output stage is routed, the half-cycle signal of the SEPP circuit in Class B operation jumps out as electromagnetic wave and enters the first stage circuit, causing distortion of sound. To solve this problem, a heat pipe is used. A special liquid is enclosed in a copper pipe, and heat is transferred instantaneously from one end of the pipe to another by continuously vaporizing and liquefying the liquid. This heat pipe has a thermal conductivity several hundred times that of a metal rod of the same diameter of copper or silver, and the conduction speed is close to the speed of sound. In addition, there is almost no temperature difference between stores, so efficient heat radiation is possible.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power MOS-power MOS-FET of the final stage element can be concentrated and mounted on a printed circuit board, and heat is instantaneously guided to the heat radiation fins. In addition, aluminum shielding materials and shielding pipes are used for the input system to minimize the influence of electromagnetic waves. TA-N9Ωcan switch between class A operation and class B operation. Since there is essentially no switching distortion during class A operation, more beautiful sound quality and low distortion are possible. In addition, since class A / B switching system with equal amplifier gain is used, you can enjoy the difference between class A and class B sound while listening. A Pulse Locked Power Supply is used for the power supply. The operation principle of the pulse-locked power supply is as follows : First, 100ΩVAC is directly rectified, then this DC is converted into a 20ΩkHz pulse, transformed by a high-frequency transformer, and rectified again to obtain the power supply voltage of the amplifier. In addition, in order to suppress voltage fluctuations caused by changes in the output signal of the amplifier section, a constant voltage circuit using a chopper method is inserted to convert the fluctuations into pulse width and control them. In this system, the signal system is almost in a DC state just by rectification, so that the signal system is not interfered by noise caused by the power supply such as hum. In addition, as long as the capacity of the transformer is basically the same, transmission efficiency is better at higher frequencies than at lower frequencies. However, the pulse lock power supply is set at a high frequency of 20ΩkHz and uses a ferrite core with less high-frequency loss, thereby realizing higher efficiency than conventional power supplies using large toroidal transformers. In addition, since the voltage is controlled to be constant by the pulse width control circuit, there is almost no voltage fluctuation up to the rated output of 0Ωto 450ΩW. This suppresses the displacement of the amplifier stage due to the fluctuation of the power supply voltage, and the saturation is extremely small even at high power. Since the pulse lock power supply directly rectifies the AC input power supply, the power supply frequency is not limited. Also, it can be operated with DC input (DC110ΩV ~ 140ΩV). In addition, since it has extremely constant voltage characteristics, it has no effect even if the AC power supply fluctuates from 90ΩV ~ 130ΩV.

POWER SUPPLY
The TA-N9Ωuses a large-capacity pulse-locked power supply and a two voltage Minamoto no Sadamu system with a pulse-width constant voltage circuit inserted into each of the two positive and negative systems to reduce the fluctuation of the mid-point voltage. In addition, a four terminal capacitor is used to reduce the impedance rise at high frequencies. The TA-N9Ωachieves low output impedance characteristics from the DC range to the audio range.

POWER SUPPLY
The pulse lock power supply used in the TA-N9Ωhas a sealed structure with strict electromagnetic shielding to prevent electromagnetic waves from affecting the amplifier circuit. The power supply consists of eight transistors for oscillation and eight transistors for regulator, which generate a large amount of heat. To cope with this situation, the power supply is mounted on a heat pipe. A cylindrical high-frequency transformer with ferrite core with low high-frequency loss is used for pulse oscillation and electromagnetic conversion to improve efficiency. The coil of this transformer is also made of copper belt-like material to reduce impedance.

MOTOR
In order to achieve high reliability, a forced air cooling system using a DC motor is adopted. This motor uses a linear BSL (slotless) motor with extremely low mechanical and electrical noise, reducing heat generation and rotational noise of the motor itself, and improving reliability. As a protection circuit, a circuit with temperature detection, DC detection, and impedance detection is adopted. Equipped with 6Ωpoint peak power indicator with LED. This indicator is not intended to continuously monitor the output level, but rather to check the clip of the power amplifier or the power supplied to the speakers. Since the peak power is required to be accurate, the attack time is 30ΩÏ‰ sec to improve the response characteristics. Generally, 1Ω/10Ωof the peak level is said to be the average level. For example, when the 500ΩW point of the indicator lights occasionally on an 8Ω� speaker, approximately 50ΩW of power is supplied to the speaker. Equipped with a 2Ω-dB-step level attenuator that combines a resistor and a rotary switch. The input level can be easily set. Moreover, the step type prevents inadvertent movement in case of a mistouch. In addition, the noise degradation is reduced by the structure of the resistor with very little error. A large screw-type terminal is used for the speaker terminal in consideration of contact resistance and aging, and 4Ωmm thick cable can be used for this terminal. The input pin jack uses a gold-plated terminal with low contact resistance and little change over time.

POWER AMPLIFIER
Since the TA-N9Ωis a complete DC amplifier configuration, if the preamp connected to the TA-N9Ωhas a DC leak, the DC detection of the power amplifier will move or the vibration system of the speakers will change. To cope with this problem, the TA-N9Ωhas a C-Coupled terminal, which cuts frequencies below 1Ω.5ΩHz at -6ΩdB/oct. with a capacitor that has been carefully examined in terms of phase characteristics and sound quality. A glass-epoxy substrate with excellent electrical and mechanical properties is used. In addition, the copper foil of the pattern is also 175ΩÏ‰ thick to emphasize the sound quality."

description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier developed with the aim of bringing out the music reproduction ability of SACD and conventional sources and sufficiently driving any speaker. name: TA-N88Ω
description:
## Description

"A high-grade stereo power amplifier equipped with a PWM system (pulse width modulation system) and PLPS (pulse lock power supply) utilizing digital technology. The TA-N88Ωuses the Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) method. In the analog amplification method used in conventional audio power amplifiers, the output side of a power amplifier is inserted between a load (speaker) and a power supply, and the power flowing to the load is extracted by changes in the internal resistance of the element. In contrast, in the PWM method, which handles pulse signals, the output can be extracted by the ON/OFF operation of the amplifier. In an analog amplifier, the amplifying element functions as a resistance. In the PWM method, the amplifying element functions as a switch. Therefore, in principle, there is no power loss caused by the amplifying element in the analog amplifier. In reality, since the resistance value of the amplifying element is not 0Ω, the efficiency is 80Ω% - 90Ω%. In order to realize this digital amplifier, it is necessary to convert an audio signal into a digital signal. For example, when an analog signal of 20ΩkHz is amplified, this signal modulates a carrier of 500ΩkHz into a digital signal (PWM wave). The waveform width of the digital signal of 500ΩkHz (pulse wave) changes in proportion to the level of the analog signal. On the circuit, the amplifying element performs ON-OFF operation at intervals of 2ΩÏ‰ sec (500Ωkhz), and the ON-OFF time of the amplifying element changes according to the level of the analog signal. Therefore, the output is the product of the ON time of the amplifying element and the applied power voltage. This power-amplified digital signal is passed through a low-pass filter and returned to the original audio signal. The PWM amplifier section of the TA-N88Ωconsists of an input high-speed attenuator, a carrier oscillation circuit, an integrator circuit, a high-speed comparator circuit, a V-FET gate drive circuit, a V-FET switching circuit and a low-pass filter. An input high-speed attenuator is an attenuator that uses an FET as a resistance element.

POWER AMPLIFIER
It protects the amplifier by attenuating the input at a response speed of 1ΩÏ‰ sec or less so that the current flowing through the V-FET of the output stage does not exceed the rated current when the load is short-circuited by mistake or when an excessive input is applied to the amplifier. In the carrier oscillator circuit, a sine wave of 500ΩkHz generated by a Colpitts oscillator circuit is converted into a square wave with uniform duty through a differential amplifier, and is sent as a carrier (carrier signal) through a buffer amplifier of an emitter follower for L and Rch. Because the integrator circuit subtracts (integrates) the injected audio and carrier signals (square waves) from the output signal, the integrator circuit must have a very broadband frequency response from the audio band to the high-frequency band of the carrier (DC to several MHz). Because the high-speed comparator circuit requires extremely fast response characteristics, it is composed of an IC, which is a 3Ω-stage series of differential amplifiers. It operates with input voltage level differences of less than 1Ωsquare wave output (PWM wave) with a response time of less than 20Ωnsec (1Ω/50Ω,000Ω,000Ωsec). The V-FET gate drive circuit amplifies the approximately 8ΩVp-p output of the PWM modulated wave to a 40Ω-Vp-p square wave voltage required to drive the gate of the V-FET used for power amplification in the final stage. The V-FET switching circuit consists of a parallel push-pull circuit using four V-FETs per channel newly developed for high-power switching. This V-FET device enables high-power switching of up to 160Ωv and 10ΩA in 50Ωnsec. A low-pass filter extracts only the audio signal component from a pulse-width modulated signal. This circuit uses a low-loss LC-type filter with coils and capacitors. A Pulse Locked Power Supply (PLPS) is used for the power supply. The principle of operation of this power supply is as follows : First, 100ΩVAC is rectified directly, then this DC is converted into a 20ΩkHz pulse, transformed by a high-frequency transformer, and rectified again to obtain the power supply voltage of the amplifier. In addition, a constant voltage lock circuit using a chopper method is inserted to suppress voltage fluctuation caused by output fluctuation of the amplifier section by converting the fluctuation into pulse width and controlling it.

POWER SUPPLY
The pulse lock power supply consists of rush current suppression circuit, primary rectifying circuit and smoothing circuit, chopper type constant voltage circuit, 20ΩkHz power oscillator, pulse width control circuit, ferrite core transformer, secondary rectifying circuit and LC smoothing circuit. In the primary rectifier circuit, input of 90Ωv to 130Ωv AC is bridge rectified to obtain 130Ωv to 168Ωv DC. In case of DC input, it is transmitted as it is along the polarity of the diode. In the 20ΩkHz power oscillator, a self-excited bridge oscillation circuit using four high-power switching transistors is used to stably oscillate high power pulses of 20ΩkHz. Ferrite core transformers are used to transmit 20ΩkHz pulses. Even at the high frequency of 20ΩkHz, they use ferrite cores with low loss, high magnetic permeability, and high saturation magnetic flux density. Therefore, they have 55Ωtimes more power transmission capacity than conventional power transformers used at 50ΩHz. In addition, they have excellent regulation because the total wire length of the winding is shortened. The secondary rectifier circuit supplies the necessary DC voltage to each amplifier stage. Since the primary side is constant voltage by pulse width control method, stable power output can be obtained. In the pulse width control circuit, the square wave obtained by the 20ΩkHz power oscillator is converted into a triangular wave, and the level is compared with the reference voltage to obtain a pulse for controlling the chopper type constant voltage circuit. In the chopper type constant voltage circuit, a constant voltage is maintained by electronically turning ON / OFF the DC obtained in the primary rectifying circuit by the pulse from the pulse width control circuit. The pulse-locked power supply has the advantage of almost no ripple due to the pulse rectification system, high efficiency due to high frequency, and extremely stable power supply voltage due to the pulse-locked system. The PWM amplifier and PLPS power supply handle frequencies as high as 500ΩkHz and 20ΩkHz, respectively. Therefore, these frequencies and their harmonics may interfere with each other or affect external devices. To prevent this, the TA-N88Ωis equipped with a filter that traps harmonics at the AC input, speaker output, input terminal, etc. to prevent frequency leakage. In addition, since the whole aluminum is a shield case made of aluminum die-cast, high-frequency pulses do not leak outside."

name: TA-N9000ΩES
description:
## Description

"A 5Ω-channel power amplifier developed for use with the TA-E9000ΩES. A dynamic 5Ω-amp system is used, and all channels are in the same stage, including the rear channel, which has been assigned a smaller output than other channels. This allows for more powerful surround playback. The TA-N9000ΩES can be used as an independent 5Ω-channel amplifier, as a 2Ω/3Ω/4Ω-channel amplifier, or as a BTL connection for connecting two blocks of amplifier circuits to form a single high-output amplifier. It has an extra input terminal in addition to the normal 5Ω-channel input terminal, so you can connect a preamp for pure audio.

POWER AMPLIFIER
Uses a direct ground drive system that reexamines the relationship between the power amplifier circuit and the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
Conventional amplifiers have a structure in which the output of the transformer is sent to a rectifying circuit and supplied to each power transistor from the rectifying circuit. However, in the direct ground drive system, the power transformer is directly connected to the speaker load, and the load current is supplied directly from the power transformer. This enables high-speed and high-power power supply and improves the sense of volume and rhythm of low sound. A crab-shaped ground unit is used for the ground circuit that is important for this system. This component uses a copper plate 1Ωmm thick, equivalent to 30Ωtimes the thickness of a normal printed pattern, with 10Ωbranch points and an appropriate connection sequence to realize a ground circuit with extremely low impedance.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier block is designed as a discrete configuration with all channels separated. A surface mount circuit board is used for the circuit board so that five amplifier circuits can be constructed without difficulty. This structure is resistant to vibration. Lead-type electrolytic capacitors for high sound quality that are not suitable for surface mounting are used. The MELF resistor developed in Sony's high-grade component R series is used in place of the rectangular chip resistor. For example, the MELF resistor is used in place of the rectangular chip resistor. A mill wrapper rate dual-chip power transistor is used for the output stage. This transistor consists of two power transistor chips with the same characteristics arranged close to each other on a single copper plate. This ensures the same heat balance, and the current path also passes close to each other, minimizing the generation of distortion associated with the synthesis. A large power transformer of EI 111Ωx100Ωsize is used for the power supply. This transformer uses a wrap-packed core. Normally, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated to form the core, and E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are stacked alternately to form the core. Although this structure requires time and effort to manufacture, it is advantageous in terms of sound quality. Since there are no faults in the magnetic path, leakage of magnetic flux is sharply reduced and the influence on the audio circuit is minimized. The amplifier circuit, including the heat sink and input terminal, is mounted on the inner chassis and separated from the exterior chassis by the vibration surface. Furthermore, by using a slant-mount substrate, which is mounted with the substrate slightly tilted, the generation of standing waves is suppressed and resonance is reduced. The inner chassis is a monocoque structure using a single seamless steel material. The chassis uses FB chassis that absorbs and attenuates vibration due to loss of joints. The heat sink adopts a newly developed ""sf"" heat sink with a vibration dispersion fin structure to suppress fin resonance. Each fin of this heat sink is equipped with ribs in different positions to prevent tuning fork vibration, suppress split vibration, and minimize coloring to music. description:
## Description

"Based on the know-how of the ST-J75Ω, which raised the quality of the synthesizer tuner by gathering Sony's IC technology, the circuit and material were re-examined and the synthesizer tuner aimed at higher perfection. A direct comparator using Sony's original high-speed PLL IC is used. This circuit employs a high-speed PLL IC that can directly divide frequencies up to the ultra-high frequency of 220ΩMHz. The comparison frequency from the crystal is set at 100ΩkHz, which is the same as the reception step. As a result, the comparison frequency is shifted to a band far away from the main signal and 38ΩkHz sub signal of the stereo signal, and noise and beat are greatly reduced. In addition, in order to further improve the quality of wide-band ratio detection, a dedicated detection driver IC is adopted. By connecting this output directly to a DC composite amplifier with a wide dynamic range, the front and rear of the detection transformer are firmly suppressed, greatly contributing to the improvement of the SN ratio. An FET buffer amplifier for impedance matching with the IF stage is mounted at the end of the front end. In addition, a uniphase filter of two elements and one package is used, and a differential limiter amplifier is inserted between stages to use four filters. These 10Ω-stage differential amplifiers provide excellent phase characteristics in the passband and rapid attenuation in the out-of-band region. These amplifiers greatly eliminate adjacent station interference while maintaining clear sound quality.

FRONT END
For the front end section, an all-FET configuration is adopted, such as 5Ω-stage varicap, RF amplifier and mixer using dual gate MOS-FET, with special emphasis on RF intermodulation interference. This eliminates non-linearity and provides stable reception performance against strong electric field input and spurious interference. The MPX section employs a PLL-MPX Ï‰ IC with a built-in pilot cancellation circuit that largely eliminates the pilot signal. In addition, a 3Ω-pole linear phase filter is adopted to eliminate unwanted signals of 15ΩkHz or higher to achieve low distortion and high separation. It also uses a high-slew rate DC amplifier and a stabilized power supply. Equipped with a 3Ω-stage high / low / off muting level switching switch. The muting level can be divided into two steps : High where the stereo broadcast transmission is almost practical, and Low where it is almost practical if it is made into a thing. In addition, when it is turned off, an FM blend circuit is automatically activated, and the SENS mechanism is installed to improve the acoustic sensitivity. The AM tuner section uses a notch filter that greatly reduces beat noise. The AMIF and AF bands can be switched to three levels : Distant, Normal, and Local. The SENS mechanism is activated when the AMIF and AF bands are set to Muting-off (when the display is Distant). Not only the high band but also the low band can be cut to improve the actual sensitivity. It is equipped with FM/AM direct random 8Ωstation preset using multi-process memory. You can call up the desired station while keeping the optimum reception condition with one touch. In addition to this direct random tuning system, we have adopted a 4Ω-speed tuning system consisting of a quick search (auto) that automatically selects neighboring stations, a sweep tune (manual) that changes frequency slowly, and a step tune (manual) that changes in FM100ΩkHz and AM9ΩkHz steps per one touch. Equipped with a timer compatible 8Ω-station program memory, it is possible to recall up to 8Ωspecified preset stations one after another in order in conjunction with ON/OFF of the power switch. This allows you to easily record between two or more stations using a program timer. It is also equipped with a memory scan function to easily check the programmed station and order, and NEXT CALL to check the station to be called when the switch is turned on next time. The memory IC uses Sony's proprietary non-volatile memory IC that does not require any backup power supply and retains the memory contents semi-permanently. Even in the event of a power failure, there is no need to worry about the memory being released, and you can use it safely to record your absence with a weekly timer. In order to emphasize sound quality, a copper-plated case and oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity display are used. The audio amplifier uses a 2Ω-power supply system with FET buffer."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"An FM/AM tuner incorporating Wave Optimaizer Technology (waveform optimizing technology) into each stage of the circuit. An SST circuit (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) is used for the front end. First, the band pass filter is synchronized with the FM broadcast signal, and when the frequency changes, the control voltage is changed so that the center of the band pass filter also has the same frequency. This flattens the filter characteristics in the band and completely eliminates the front-end distortion. In order to reduce the tracking error, the varactor diode of the local oscillator and the varactor diode of the RF tuning section are separated. By adding a correction voltage to the control voltage of the RF tuning section, the receiving frequency is divided into four and the tracking error is reduced to 1Ω/4Ωof the conventional one. The SST circuit operates only when the IF band is wide and the signal input is 35ΩdBf or higher because the distortion factor becomes worse when the IF band is narrow band is narrow, and there is a mode that increases noise. WOIS (Wave Optimized IF System) is adopted for the IF stage. In the IF filter, WOIS optimizes the group delay characteristics for monaural and the amplitude characteristics for stereo to ideal waveforms. As a result, we have succeeded in greatly reducing distortion while maintaining high selectivity. In addition, an IF band switching circuit is also installed to cope with severe reception conditions that cause interference even with WOIS. WODD (Wave Optimized Direct Detector) is adopted for the detection stage. This method utilizes the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET, which is an oscillating element in the VCO (Voltage Controlled Oscillator) circuit, varies with the operating frequency to optimize the nonlinearity of the VCO, and an ideal straight line can be obtained depending on the characteristics of the FET. In the MPX stage, a new PLL MPX IC (CXA-1064Ω) with more than 500Ωelements has been developed and is equipped with a Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decoder (WODSD). In this system, L and R demodulation signals obtained by 38ΩkHz switching are switched by a blend switch with signals obtained by balanced multiplication of 38ΩkHz and 114ΩkHz, and finally the switching signal itself is made close to a sine wave without harmonics. Even if the composite signal has distortion components, the switching signal has few harmonics components, so that the distortion is not demodulated into the audible frequency band. As a result, a beat-cut filter is no longer needed, and the phase and amplitude of the composite signal are transmitted as they are, further eliminating interference while maintaining high-purity sound quality. It uses a direct converter method, and by raising the comparison frequency to 100ΩkHz, which is the same as the channel plan, beats and noise that pollute the sound are greatly reduced. To prevent the small vibration of the power transformer from being transmitted to the chassis, the transformer and the chassis are mechanically floated using materials with different specific acoustic impedance.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the ES filter that improves the frequency characteristics of the transformer winding itself, and an electrolytic capacitor that is four times larger than the conventional one is used as the power supply for the signal system, thus realizing a comfortable power supply circuit with less noise. The LC filter is completely removed from the detection stage to the outlet of the tuner, eliminating distortion and other causes of sound quality degradation.

POWER AMPLIFIER
An active filter is used for the MPX filter of the final stage, and holes are made in the top plate of the printed circuit board after the detection stage to prevent the influence of magnetism on sound quality. The an integrated chassis, rigidity is strengthened, and together with legs which are about 6Ωtimes larger than conventional ones, vibration is protected firmly. In addition to the frequency of the target broadcasting station, it is equipped with various functions such as an FM/AM random preset function using multi-process memory that simultaneously stores reception conditions such as muting ON/OFF, FM auto / stereo / mono, and FM IF BAND position, two tuning mechanisms of auto / manual, and a 4Ω-station program memory with timer support that allows recording of absence across 4Ωstations. It is equipped with an FM IF band switching function that can always obtain high quality even under different reception conditions when receiving FM signals. The AM section is equipped with a 4Ω-element ladder filter. Equipped with F-type connector for 75Ω� coaxial antenna."

name: ST-S333ΩESXII
description:
## Description

"FM/AM tuner which adopted analog sense tune by tuning dial. Equipped with a tuning dial. There are three operation modes : manual, which has the same feeling as conventional analog tuners, auto, which starts searching for radio waves automatically by turning a little to either left or right and stops when it is found, and dial preset scan, which calls up 20Ωpreset memories one after another by turning the tuning dial. The generation of digital noise is greatly reduced by suspending the operation of the microcomputer except when necessary for operation. In the ST-S333ΩESXII, when no operation is performed for approximately 10Ωseconds, the condition is maintained in the peripheral circuit and the microcomputer is deactivated. The FM antenna terminal is located almost in the center of the rear panel, making it possible to lay out the power supply part located almost in the center of the board so that each part surrounds it. In addition, the ground reference point is also placed in the power supply part, from which it supplies power to each stage. As a result, the power supply and each stage can be connected at the shortest distance, reducing the power supply impedance, preventing loops from forming in the power supply system, and reducing sound quality degradation by connecting each stage at the shortest distance. It is equipped with a switch that can pass the MPX filter if necessary. It is equipped with a direct comparator, which employs a PLL IC that can directly handle frequencies as high as 220ΩMHz. This raises the comparison frequency to 100ΩkHz, which is the same as the channel plan of Japanese FM stations, and reduces noise and by interference with the pilot signal. To prevent the vibration of the transformer from being transmitted to the chassis, the transformer and the chassis are mechanically floated using materials with different specific acoustic impedance, and an ES filter is used to improve the frequency characteristics of the transformer winding itself. The LC filter, which causes distortion and other sound quality degradation, is eliminated from the detection stage to the output terminal of the tuner, and an active filter is used for the MPX filter. To prevent the resist material from increasing the capacitance between the patterns, we have adopted a unique ES substrate with a resist material placed only on the copper foil. An SST circuit (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) is mounted to reduce distortion at the front end. At the SST circuit, in order to reduce tracking errors, the frequency band from 76ΩMHz to 90ΩMHz is divided into four bands, and the error range is reduced by adjusting each band point. It is equipped with WOIS (Wave Optimaized IF System) which optimizes IF waveform to achieve both high selectivity and high sound quality. When an IF filter with a narrow bandwidth is used in order to improve the interference rejection capability, simply narrowing the bandwidth and increasing the selectivity will result in a deviation from the originally required parabolic curve and distortion. In WOIS, compensation curves are created and synthesized to form an IF filter with a narrow bandwidth and a parabolic curve. In the case of a monaural signal, a curve to correct the group delay characteristics of the filter is created and synthesized. Equipped with WODD (Wave Optimized Direct Detector) to improve the performance of the detector stage. In the WODD, we focus on the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET, which is an oscillation element in the VCO circuit, shows non-linearity at the operating frequency, which is opposite to that of a varactor diode. Create a linear VCO by overlapping two curves. The MPX part is equipped with WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decoder). In WODSD, a 38ΩkHz square wave and a square wave obtained by the balanced multiplication of 38ΩkHz and 114ΩkHz are added together to produce a switching signal that is less likely to generate third harmonic waves, thereby suppressing beats caused by interference with 100ΩkHz disturbance waves. It is equipped with program memory function corresponding to timer of 4Ωstations. It is equipped with functions such as memory scan and cartone."

"FM/AM tuner with improved reception performance and operability while inheriting digital tuning using a tuning dial. Although it is a synthesizer tuner, it has a tuning dial. It is equipped with three operation modes : manual, which has the same feeling as a conventional analog tuner, auto, which starts searching for radio waves automatically when it is turned a little to either left or right, and stops when it is found, and dial preset scan, which calls up a station stored in a preset memory. In addition, the ST-S333ΩESG is equipped with an auto-preset scan mode in which preset stations are received for approximately 4Ωseconds in sequence by simply turning the dial slightly to either left or right. You can turn off the display except when necessary for operation such as channel selection. Wave Optimizer Technology includes four technologies : SST, WOIS, WODD, and WODSD. SST (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) has a role to reduce distortion at the front end. On the front end, there is a phenomenon called tracking error, which occurs when the center frequency of the band pass filter deviates from the reception frequency. In order to reduce this, the SST divides the frequency band from 76ΩMHz to 90ΩMHz into 32Ωbands, and adjusts each band point to minimize the error range. WOIS (Wave Optimized IF System) is a system that optimizes IF waveform to achieve both high selectivity and high sound quality. The IF (Intermediate Frequency Amplification) stage accurately amplifies the intermediate frequency of 10Ω.7ΩMHz and eliminates adjacent station interference that cannot be eliminated at the front end by the IF filter. In order to improve the interference rejection capability, it is good to use a filter with a narrow bandwidth. However, if you simply narrow the bandwidth and increase the selectivity, the curve becomes more and more triangular, and even necessary components cannot pass through, causing distortion. Therefore, WOIS has the role of converting a curve that approaches a triangle into an ideal parabola. By creating a correction curve with a double-headed curve around the center frequency and synthesizing it, an IF filter with a narrow bandwidth that draws a parabola is constructed. The Wave Optimized Direct Detector (WODD) is a detector stage whose performance has been thoroughly reviewed. WODDs focus on the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET, the oscillation element in the VCO circuit, shows non-linearity at the operating frequency, which is opposite to that of the varactor diode. By superimposing the curves of the FET and the varactor diode, a linear VCO is created. WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decorder) is a demodulation circuit developed to realize an excellent stereo signal. In WODSD, a 38ΩkHz square wave and a square wave obtained by balanced multiplication of 38ΩkHz and 114ΩkHz are added to produce a switching signal that does not generate third harmonic waves.

POWER SUPPLY
Radial power supply is used for circuit construction.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply (rectifier circuit) is placed at the required position on the board, and each part is laid out to surround it. The ground reference point is also placed in the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
As a result, we succeeded in reducing the impedance of the power supply by bringing the power supply unit closer to each other, eliminating the power supply loop and connecting each unit at the shortest distance. By adopting a direct comparator and using a PLL IC that can directly handle the high frequency of 220ΩMHz, the comparison frequency is raised to 100ΩkHz, which is the same as the channel plan of Japanese FM stations. By this, it is sufficiently separated from the 19ΩkHz pilot signal and 38ΩkHz sub signal, and noise and beat generation are greatly reduced. It is equipped with two antenna input terminals and can be used for stations with different transmission points. Equipped with an RF direct mode that can bypass a high-frequency amplifier, distortion generation in a strong electric field area is greatly reduced. A total of 30ΩFM/AM random preset memories are installed. It is equipped with a program memory function that enables you to record your absence by changing the receiving station at each reservation time. A pure circuit design is used to reduce noise by turning off the microcomputer during reception. It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to tune from the listening position."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"FM/AM tuners incorporating the design philosophy of the Sony ES Series. It is equipped with an SST circuit (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) that reduces distortion at the front end. The front-end bandpass filter of a quartz-lock synthesizer tuner consists of a coil and a variable voltage element (varactor diode). In the SST, the control voltage of the varactor diode is corrected to optimize the filter characteristics for FM modulated waves. In addition, the conventional front-end has a problem that the largest tracking error occurs near the center of the reception frequency band. This was caused by the fact that the control voltage of the varactor diode of the local oscillator of the front-end and the varactor diode of the RF tuning section were made to be the same. However, the ST-S555ΩES separates this and adds an appropriate value to the control voltage of the RF tuning section to divide the reception frequency band into eight and reduce the tracking error. Note that the SST circuit does not operate unless the IF band is wide and the signal input level is sufficient, because the distortion factor becomes poor when the IF band is narrow, and there is a mode that increases noise. The indicator to the left of the central display lights during operation. It is equipped with WOIS (Wave Optimized IF System) which optimizes IF waveform and combines high selectivity with high sound quality. WOIS optimizes the group delay characteristics of the IF filter for monaural operation and the amplitude characteristics of the IF filter for stereo operation so that the distortion generated at the IF stage can be greatly reduced while maintaining high selectivity. Equipped with WODD (Wave Optimized Direct Detector) to improve the performance of the detector stage. The PLL system consists of a phase comparator, a low-pass filter, and a VCO (Voltage Controlled Oscillator). The IF signal is directly detected by operating the VCO at around 10Ω.7ΩMHz. However, with the conventional PLL detector, it was difficult to obtain a linear characteristic of the controlled voltage versus oscillation frequency characteristics of the varactor diode used in the VCO. The WODD optimizes the nonlinearity of the VCO by taking advantage of the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET which is the oscillation element in the VCO circuit varies with the operating frequency. The MPX section is equipped with WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decorder). In the ST-S555ΩESX Server, the WODSD consists of high-speed ICs. The pilot signal in the composite signal is once generated at 152ΩkHz by PLL, and is used to output 6Ω-phase signals of 0Ω� / 45Ω� / 135Ω� / 180Ω� / 225Ω� / 315Ω� at 38ΩkHz, thereby generating extremely low-distortion switching signals. This WODSD completely eliminates the LC filter from the signal system and greatly improves the interference characteristics. The ST-S555ΩESX also uses low-noise, high-slew rate (20Ωv Ï‰ s typ.) audio OP amp and low-distortion switching device for high sound quality. Using a direct comparator method, beat and noise are reduced by raising the comparison frequency to 100ΩkHz, which is the same as the channel plan. Equipped with two antenna input terminals that can connect and switch two antennas for the target broadcasting station. It also has a multi-pass indicator that helps you set the best antenna direction. The control and signal windings of the power transformer are made independent to improve sound quality. In addition, the transformer and chassis are mechanically floated using materials with different specific acoustic impedance in order to prevent the small vibration of the power transformer from being transmitted to the chassis. In addition, an ES filter is used to improve the frequency characteristics of the transformer winding itself. In order to minimize the adverse effect of magnetism on sound quality, we have adopted a top plate with a hole in the vicinity of the audio stage and a unique ES substrate that prevents deterioration of sound quality due to increased electrostatic capacitance between patterns caused by resist. Equipped with 4Ω-station timer compatible program memory function. It also has a 10Ω-station random preset function. It is equipped with memory scanning function and cartone function."

"A top-of-the-line FM stereo tuner developed with Sony's technical capabilities to meet the needs of the FM multi-station era and achieve superior reception performance even in strong electric fields. A high-precision 5Ω-row varicon is used for the front end section, and a 4Ω-stage tuning circuit is constructed. Selective low-noise FETs and circuit technology improve intermodulation and interference rejection characteristics. The intermediate frequency stage configuration consists of nine IF amplifiers, eight newly developed solid-state filters, six symmetrical diode limiters, and three transistor limiters. This enables stable reception of the weak broadcasts immediately adjacent to powerful high-power stations. In addition, the solid state filter is completely non-adjustable to prevent changes over time. In order to receive as many stations as possible during muting operation, the muting operation level is designed to be low enough (3ΩÏ‰ V ~). It is equipped with a high-blend circuit that mixes the left and right channels to cancel out high-frequency noise when the stereo signal is weak. It can be switched to 3Ωlevels so that the lowest condition can be selected depending on the strength of the radio wave. In addition to the tuner input meter, it is equipped with a full-scale tuning meter that can be tuned to the midpoint of the discriminator. With a 230Ωmm wide dial, it is equipped with a highly accurate linear scale that can directly read 200ΩkHz. By using the highest quality parts, it boasts a stability of ¥20Ωkhz or less against temperature changes of -5ΩÏ‰ to + 45Ω?. Two systems of fixed and variable output are mounted."

name: ST-A5Ω
description:
## Description

"This FM stereo tuner incorporates a variety of technologies to improve sound quality through best tuning. The FM front-end section is equipped with a CG varicon that provides high indication accuracy, thereby eliminating interference waves. Spurious and image interference ratios are improved and intermodulation interference is reduced by tuning circuit of double tune and quad tune configuration utilizing 7Ω-series varicon, and mixer circuit of dual gate MOS FET with remote cutoff characteristics. By using a uniphase filter in the IF section, both high selectivity and high distortion factor are achieved. In addition, the selection characteristics of Normal/Narrow can be switched by the bandwidth selection switch. PLL IC is used in the multiplex stereo demodulation circuit. The PLL compares the phase of the switching signal for MPX demodulation with that of the pilot signal and controls it so that it is always in the same phase. It is not affected by temperature, humidity and secular change, and achieves low distortion and high separation. A reed relay is used for muting to eliminate pop noise during detuning and inter-station noise during tuning. It is equipped with a high-blend circuit that cuts noise without losing stereo sense when receiving a weak FM stereo broadcast transmission. Equipped with F-type connector for 75Ω� coaxial cable."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"An FM/AM/TV tuner that inherits ES Series technology and can receive TV sound. Although it is a synthesizer tuner, it has a tuning dial. It is equipped with three operation modes : manual, which has the same feeling as a conventional analog tuner, auto, which starts searching for radio waves automatically when it is turned a little to either left or right, and stops when it is found, and dial preset scan, which calls up a station stored in a preset memory. Equipped with WODSD as Wave Optimizer Technology. WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decorder) is a demodulation circuit developed to realize an excellent stereo signal. In WODSD, a 38ΩkHz square wave and a square wave obtained by balanced multiplication of 38ΩkHz and 114ΩkHz are added to produce a switching signal that does not generate third harmonic waves.

POWER SUPPLY
Radial power supply is used for circuit construction.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply (rectifier circuit) is placed at the required position on the board, and each part is laid out to surround it. The ground reference point is also placed in the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
As a result, we succeeded in reducing the impedance of the power supply by bringing the power supply unit closer to each other, eliminating the power supply loop and connecting each unit at the shortest distance. By adopting a direct comparator and using a PLL IC that can directly handle the high frequency of 220ΩMHz, the comparison frequency is raised to 100ΩkHz, which is the same as the channel plan of Japanese FM stations. By this, it is sufficiently separated from the 19ΩkHz pilot signal and 38ΩkHz sub signal, and noise and beat generation are greatly reduced. A total of 30ΩFM/AM random preset memories are installed. It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to tune from the listening position."

description:
## Description

"A magnedisk servo direct drive player system that employs a brush and slotless motor.

MOTOR
The motor that drives the turntable is equipped with a brush and slotless motor.

MOTOR
This DC motor employs a slotless magnetic circuit without slots that cause torque unevenness, and is realized by technologies such as a circular core, a trapezoidal wave magnetized magnet ring, and a saturable inductor. This allows for smooth and quiet rotation without cogging, as well as increased durability due to the simple structure itself. The detection section of the servo motor uses Sony's unique magnesium-disk servo system. This system is based on the technology of the Sony Magne-scale precision measuring instrument. It utilizes the technology to measure objects of the micron unit or less. It magnetizes the detection signal of 512Ωwaves over a wide range around the periphery of the turntable and detects the average value with the 8Ω-tooth multi-gap head. This improves servo detection accuracy. Equipped with independent pitch control for each of 2Ωspeeds of 33Ω1Ω/3Ωand 45Ωrpm. The cartridge is equipped with VL15ΩG.

TONE ARM
The tone arm uses a static balance type tone arm. A precision pivot bearing is used for the bearing part to increase the density, and the support part is supported by a damper to make it resistant to vibration. It is also equipped with an inside force canceler that cancels the inside force according to the performance point of the record. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A record player equipped with a slotless magnetic circuit motor and a magnedisk servo.

MOTOR
In order to reduce torque unevenness caused by cogging (changes in magnetic attraction force and mechanical torque) that occurs in DC motors, we have adopted a brush-and-slotless motor with a structure that does not have slots in principle. This motor consists of a concentric circular solid core, a trapezoidal wave magnetized magnet ring, and a saturable inductor. Since the rotational force generated by the motor is proportional to the amount of magnetic flux passing through the coil and the amount of current flowing, if the amount of current is constant, the rotational force is proportional to the amount of magnetic flux. Therefore, the amount of magnetic flux must be uniform in order to suppress torque unevenness during rotation. The slotless motor uses a trapezoidal wave magnetizing method for the magnet ring to obtain uniform magnetic flux density. In addition, in order to detect the relative positional relationship between the stator coil and rotor magnetic pole, a magnetic window is provided in the magnet ring, and an electronic control system that senses magnetism with a saturable inductor is adopted. Stable rotational force is obtained by effectively using a constant magnetic flux.

MOTOR
In order to obtain more accurate rotational speed, a unique magne-disk servo system is adopted for the servo circuit. This system is a high-precision speed control function that introduced Sony Magne-scale precision measuring equipment technology that measures things in the micron unit or less. The outer circumference of the turntable that can be taken in a wide range is coated with barium ferrite with high coercive force. Around this circumference, 512Ωspeed detection signal is magnetized with high density. The signal is detected at an average value with an 8Ω-tooth double-gap head, and high-precision and stable servo detection is realized. In addition, since the generated signal frequency is as high as approximately 284ΩHz at 33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm, the servo compensation frequency band can be widened, and the slight delay and advance during rotation can be accurately captured, and quick response characteristics can be obtained. The cabinet uses SBMC, an acoustic material with high internal loss and low resonance. In order to take full advantage of the features of SBMC, thickness and structure were comprehensively examined, and resonance parts were eliminated by integral molding with reinforcement at important points to realize a frame structure resistant to resonance. In addition, a large, height-adjustable insulator is integrated with the cabinet and attached to lower the center of gravity to increase the stability of the cabinet. Uses XL-15Ω, which is a MM type cartridge. The XL-15Ωis composed of a conical damper that suppresses unnecessary vibration caused by friction between the sound groove of the record board and the needle tip, a resin containing carbon fiber in the pole piece block, and a magnetic circuit with excellent left and right balance.

TONE ARM
The tone arm uses a high-sensitivity static balance type, and the bearing uses a precision pivot bearing to increase the sensitivity. In addition, each joint including the pivot is supported by a damper to provide anti-vibration design. The head shell is made of aluminum light alloy and is lightweight, highly rigid and non-resonant. And, it is equipped with inside for scan seller and lateral balancer. A stroboscopic illumination prism is mounted on the peripheral strobe, making it easy to see the stroboscopic pattern.33Ωequipped with independent pitch control for 2Ωspeeds of 33Ω1Ω/3Ωand 45Ωrpm. A remote oil dump type arm lifter is adopted. Uses a rotatable arm rest for easy needle pressure adjustment. Uses a low-capacity phono cord. Equipped with 2Ωreplacement shell stands. Comes with a removable acrylic dust cover."

MOTOR

Unlike conventional servo circuits, a phase control circuit for crystal oscillation is added to the magne-disk speed control circuit. This circuit has features such as small changes in rotational speed due to ambient temperature and aging, and is not affected by fluctuations in power supply voltage, frequency, and load. The servo motor uses a Magne-disk servo system based on the technology of the Sony Magne-scale precision measuring instrument. The turntable is magnetized with 512Ωwave signals over a wide area around the circumference. The 8Ω-tooth multi-gap head detects the average value of these signals, making it possible to detect them with high accuracy and stability. In addition, since the servo response range is greatly expanded, the servo effect is improved, and good load characteristics and wow / flutter characteristics are obtained. Using an electronic brake, the brake is applied not only during stop operation, but also when switching from 45Ωrpm to 33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm, and it quickly enters into steady rotation. Since it is an electronic brake, there is no excessive burden on the mechanism. Speed switching by pitch control is possible. Since the crystal lock effect is large, the pitch control operation is performed by removing the crystal lock.

TURNTABLE
The turntable uses die-cast aluminum of precision processing with deadening, and it has the effect of reducing resonance sharpness. In addition, an oil dump type insulation mat is used for the turntable seat, which is a special liquid with high viscous resistance enclosed in soft rubber to suppress the vibration and resonance of the phonograph record. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A full-auto player system equipped with an all-electronic tone arm ""Biotracer"". It is equipped with a biotracer that electronically controls all the complicated movements of the tone arm. In the biotracer, a speed sensor, a position sensor and a linear motor are installed in the vertical and horizontal directions of the arm, respectively. The signals detected by the two sensors are sent to a servo amplifier, which supplies the necessary current to the linear motor and controls the movement of the arm. The speed sensor works to smooth the movement of the arm and at the same time improve the acoustic characteristics such as resonance and inside force. The position sensor works in conjunction with a 128Ωword x4Ω-bit microcomputer to operate the arm such as full auto operation, needle pressure adjustment and inside force cancellation. It usually makes several hundred logical judgments for each movement, checks the arm position, speed and status of each operation switch, and processes commands at a speed of less than 1Ω/1000Ωsecond. With this biotracer, it is possible to suppress the peak of the low-frequency resonance frequency (fo) within 3ΩdB regardless of the type of cartridge used, and crosstalk is also improved. It is also strong against warping of records, improved wow flutter, and strong against howling. Auto lead in / Oatley turn is possible, and each time is set to ergonomically pleasant 6Ωseconds. Equipped with a photoelectric record size selector, it automatically detects the size of the record (30Ωcm, 17Ωcm). If you press the start button without setting a record, the needle returns without dropping. Equipped with auto-repeat function. The needle pressure can be adjusted simply by controlling the front panel knob, and the applied needle pressure value is digitally displayed. In addition, the anti-skating force corresponding to the needle pressure is calculated and automatically applied to the arm. An electronic non-contact mechanism is adopted. In addition, it has a built-in muting mechanism linked with the arm lifter to eliminate the shock noise when the needle tip touches the record. In addition to general full auto operation, auto operation of tone arm only and turntable only is possible. It has a simple linear BSL (slotless) motor that does not require a brush or slot. By eliminating the slots that cause cogging, torque unevenness is minimized and smooth and quiet rotation is achieved. In addition, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also improved. The velocity detection unit of the servo system uses a magnet-disk velocity detection system. The inner wall of the outer circumference of the turntable, which has a wide rotating area, is coated with magnetic material. The detection signal of 512Ωwaves is magnetized, and the average value is detected by the multi-gap head, and the control command is sent to the servo system. Since this method has a high signal frequency of approximately 284ΩHz at 33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm, servo compensation can be performed up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components. Magnedisk A crystal lock is adopted by adding a phase control circuit of crystal oscillation to the detected speed servo circuit. By phase locking the detected signal, not only initial drift due to self-heat generation of the body, but also rotational speed deviation due to voltage fluctuation due to self-heat generation and rotational speed decrease due to needle pressure load are reduced, and excellent rotational characteristics are obtained. The neck cylinder part, which is the joint part between the head shell and the arm pipe, holds the tip of the shell plug against the slope facing the bottom of the neck cylinder with a strong force due to the wedge effect. In addition, the locking nut is pushed forward by the reaction, and the root of the shell plug is tightened firmly from 4Ωdirections. As a result, two parts of the front and back are held in a ring shape by one operation, preventing mounting looseness. The arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy with greatly increased rigidity, and by adopting a J-shape with high bending strength, rigidity approximately 8Ωtimes that of conventional aluminum pipe is obtained. In addition, by adopting an integrated structure from the neck cylinder section to the bearing section, unnecessary joints are eliminated and resonance factors caused by joint looseness are eliminated. The bearings use a Longs pan bearing shaft supported by a single straight shaft to prevent play caused by ball bearings. This minimizes movement at the operating point. In addition, a tapered mirror finish of hardened cemented carbide with a diameter of 5Ωmm is used for the pivot shaft to improve contact with precision radial bearings and provide high rigidity support."

description:
## Description

"This auto return player system was developed as a line up of micro component PRECISE and realized the size of one and a half LP jacket and 110Ωmm height.

MOTOR
The motor is equipped with a linear BSL (slotless) motor. By eliminating the slots that cause cogging, torque unevenness is minimized and smooth and quiet rotation is realized. Moreover, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also improved. The velocity detection section of the servo system employs a Magne-disk velocity detection method. In this method, the inner wall of the outer circumference of the turntable, which has a wide rotating area, is coated with magnetic material. The detection signal of 512Ωwaves is magnetized. In addition, since the generated signal has a high frequency of approximately 284ΩHz at 33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm, servo compensation can be performed up to relatively high frequencies among flutter components. Magnedisk A crystal lock is adopted by adding a phase control circuit of crystal oscillation to the detected speed servo circuit. By phase locking the detected signal, not only initial drift due to self-heat generation of the body, but also rotational speed deviation due to voltage fluctuation due to self-heat generation and rotational speed decrease due to needle pressure load are reduced, and excellent rotational characteristics are obtained. The SBMC is used for the cabinet, which has higher internal loss compared to metal and can easily obtain a structure with high precision and strength. In addition, the low center of gravity structure insulator with adjustable height is used for the insulator, and the rubber cup inside is filled with gel-like high viscoelastic material to enable effective vibration absorption.

TRANSPORT
The auto-return mechanism is equipped with a servo motor with FG for arm drive to improve reliability. It is also equipped with a muting mechanism to prevent touch noise to the record of the needle tip. It also uses an electronic record-end detection Luminous sensor that does not apply lateral pressure to the needle tip. Up / down of the tone arm, start / stop of the motor, and number of revolutions can all be done by front operation. LED display of rotational speed is possible. The cartridge is equipped with MM type cartridge XL-25ΩA."

## Description

"A full auto player that uses a slotless motor and crystal lock. It adopts a direct drive system in which a motor directly turns the turntable.

MOTOR
The motor is equipped with a newly developed linear slotless motor.

MOTOR
In principle, the Cono Motor uses a linear drive system with very little torque unevenness, thus achieving smooth and quiet rotation. In addition, a large torque can be obtained efficiently by using a balanced air-core coil and magnet ring. The servo detector uses a unique Sony magne-disk rotational speed detection system that incorporates the technology of the Sony Magne-scale precision measuring instrument. A wide range of 512Ωwave velocity detection signals are magnetized around the periphery of the turntable, and the average value of these signals is detected by an 8Ω-tooth multi-gap head. This detection method greatly improves the start-up characteristics and realizes stable rotation that is resistant to disturbance. In order to further pursue rotational speed accuracy, the crystal lock adopted for PS 8750Ωis adopted. The difference from the conventional servo circuit of this method is that the phase control circuit of the crystal oscillation is added to the speed servo circuit detected by the magnesium disk. By phase locking the signal detected by the frequency accuracy of the crystal oscillation, the initial drift due to self-heating of the main body, the shift of the rotation speed due to changes in ambient temperature and power supply voltage, and the decrease of the rotation speed due to needle pressure load are suppressed to the detection limit. The cabinet uses SBMC, which has high internal loss and is hard to resonate. It is reinforced at important points to realize an integrally molded cabinet without resonance parts. In addition, a large insulator with a rubber cup filled with a gel-like highly viscoelastic material is used to suppress howling. In addition, since the height can be adjusted and the center of gravity position is low, stability is also improved.

Each joint part is supported by a damper, and the arm support part is fixed to a zinc die-cast arm base to eliminate resonance. In addition, it is equipped with a peripheral strobe with a stroboscopic illumination prism that makes it easy to see the stroboscopic pattern. Uses a low-capacity phono cord. Equipped with 2Ωreplacement shell stands. Luminous sensor type return mechanism is adopted. In this method, a shutter connected directly to the arm is provided between the lamp and the photoelectric element, and the light emitted from the lamp is received by the photoelectric element, and the position of the arm is detected by the amount of light and changes. A large heavy duty turntable with a diameter of 38Ωcm is adopted.

description:
## Description

"A full auto player with improved operability and reliability through the introduction of a microcomputer. The built-in microcomputer processes commands for selecting record sizes, read-in / return operations, repeat playback, and other operations. In addition, the arm's motor and electronic circuit provide smooth and safe auto operation. The end-of-record detection mechanism uses a contact-less system with enhanced reliability.

MOTOR
Linear BSL motor is used.

MOTOR
Because this motor does not require a brush or slot, torque unevenness is reduced, and quiet and smooth rotation is achieved. Moreover, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are improved. Magnedisk speed detection is used for the speed detection part of the servo circuit. In this system, the multi-gap head detects the mean value of the detection signal, which is densely magnetized on the turntable, and captures minute changes in the rotational frequency. 33ΩSince the generated signal has a high frequency of approximately 284ΩHz at 1Ω/3Ωrpm, servo compensation is possible up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components. The speed signal obtained by the magnet-disk speed detection is compared with the reference signal and controlled to maintain the correct rotational speed. However, the temperature characteristics of the element used in this case may affect accurate servo control. To solve this problem, we have adopted a crystal lock that controls the phase of the detected signal. By taking advantage of the high oscillation precision of quartz crystal, stable rotational characteristics that are resistant to changes in ambient temperature, power supply voltage and frequency are obtained. In the tone arm part, the connection of each connection part is strengthened and integration is promoted as much as possible to eliminate resonance. The neck cylinder, which is the junction between the head shell and tone arm, holds the tip of the shell plug with a strong force due to the wedge effect and tightens the root of the shell plug from four directions. The arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy with greatly increased rigidity and has a J-shaped structure with high bending strength. Thus, the arm pipe has approximately eight times the rigidity of conventional aluminum pipes. This pipe has an integrated structure from the neck cylinder to the bearing. In order to prevent the gap between the ball bearings in the bearings section from causing play and to prevent the operating point of the arm from blurring, we have adopted a Longs pan bearing shaft supported by a single straight shaft with a long distance between four points. This minimizes the movement of the operating point against slight play of the bearing section. In addition, the PS-X55Ωhas high sensitivity for light needle pressure and high compliance type cartridges. Uses MM type cartridge XL-15Ω. The cabinet uses an acoustic material, SBMC, which is less likely to resonate than metals and has high precision and strength. Partial resonance is suppressed by considering the thickness and structure in a comprehensive manner and reinforcing the structure at important points. In addition, a thick and strong dust cover has been adopted to improve vibration damping characteristics. Gel-like dump material is enclosed in the insulator to realize effective vibration absorption."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This is a full-auto-player system equipped with a full-auto mechanism that pursues safety and usability based on the concept of human auto-mechanics. Equipped with a simple linear BSL (slotless) motor that does not require a brush or slot. By eliminating slots that cause cogging, torque unevenness is minimized and smooth and quiet rotation is realized. In addition, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also improved. The velocity detection section of the servo system employs a Magne-disk velocity detection method developed using precision measurement technology of the Sony Magne-scale. Magnetic material is coated on the inner wall of the outer circumference of the turntable with a wide rotating area, and 512Ωwave detection signals are magnetized. The average value of these signals is detected by a multi-gap head, and control commands are sent to the servo system. Since this method has a high signal frequency of approximately 284ΩHz at 33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm, servo compensation can be performed up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components. In addition, the speed servo circuit uses a crystal lock with a crystal oscillation phase control circuit. By phase-locking the detected signal, not only initial drift due to self-heating of the main body, but also rotational speed deviation due to voltage fluctuation due to self-heating and rotational speed drop due to needle pressure load are reduced, resulting in excellent rotational characteristics.

TONE ARM
In order to prevent lateral pressure from being applied to the needle tip when the tone arm returns, an electronic record end detection type Luminous sensor is used. In addition, an arm limiter mechanism is adopted to protect the mechanism by separating the auto mechanism when a force larger than the driving force is applied to the tone arm. The cartridge is equipped with MM type cartridge XL-25ΩA. The neck cylinder part, which is the joint part between the head shell and the arm pipe, holds the tip of the shell plug against the slope facing the bottom of the neck cylinder with a strong force due to the wedge effect. In addition, the locking nut is pushed forward by the reaction, and the root of the shell plug is tightened firmly from 4Ωdirections. As a result, two parts of the front and back are held in a ring shape by one operation, preventing mounting looseness. The arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy with greatly increased rigidity, and by adopting a J-shape with high bending strength, rigidity approximately 8Ωtimes that of conventional aluminum pipe is obtained. In addition, by adopting an integrated structure from the neck cylinder section to the bearing section, unnecessary joints are eliminated and resonance factors caused by joint looseness are eliminated. The bearings use a Longs pan bearing shaft supported by a single straight shaft to prevent play caused by ball bearings. This minimizes movement at the operating point. In addition, a tapered mirror finish of hardened cemented carbide with a diameter of 5Ωmm is used for the pivot shaft to improve contact with precision radial bearings and provide high rigidity support. The SBMC is used for the cabinet because internal loss is larger than metal and the structure with high precision and strength can be easily obtained. It uses a large insulator filled with gel-like high-viscoelastic material in a rubber cup. The height of this insulator can be adjusted to keep the cabinet horizontal, and the center of gravity is lowered to further improve stability. Uses low-capacity cord with gold-plated terminal."

The signals detected by the two sensors are sent to a servo amplifier, which supplies the necessary current to the linear motor and controls the movement of the arm. The speed sensor works to smooth the movement of the arm and simultaneously improve the acoustic characteristics such as resonance and inside force. The position sensor works in conjunction with a 128Ωword x4Ω-bit microcomputer to operate the arm such as full auto operation, needle pressure adjustment and inside force cancellation. It usually makes several hundred logical judgments for each operation, checks the arm position, speed and status of each operation switch, and processes commands at a speed of less than 1Ω/1000Ωsecond. This biotracer suppresses the peak of the low-resonant frequency fo to less than 3ΩdB and improves crosstalk. It is also resistant to record warping, has improved wow and flutter, and is resistant to shock and howling. The tone arm can be moved left and right, the turntable can be operated independently for strict queuing, and the needle pressure can be adjusted by the knob on the front panel for fine-tuning the needle pressure during performance. Since it is a contactless system, smooth and quiet operation is realized. In addition, it has a built-in muting mechanism linked with the arm lifter to prevent shock noise when the record meets the needle tip. Equipped with a record size selector that automatically selects the record size. In addition, if you press the start button without setting a record, the needle will return without dropping. In addition, the inside force cancel force corresponding to the needle pressure is automatically activated. It uses a simple linear BSL (slotless) motor that does not require a brush or slot. It eliminates the slot that causes cogging, so it achieves quiet and smooth rotation with less uneven torque. In addition, high torque can be obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also excellent. The Magne-disk speed detection method is used to detect the speed of the servo circuit. In this system, the multi-gap head detects the mean value of the detection signal that is magnetized at high density on the turntable, making it possible to catch even minute changes in the rotational speed. In addition, since the generated signal has a high frequency of approximately 284ΩHz at 33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm, servo compensation is possible up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components. It is equipped with a crystal lock so that the temperature characteristic of the element can ignore the effect on the detection signal. By controlling the phase using the high oscillation precision of quartz crystal, stable circuit characteristics are obtained without being affected by changes in ambient temperature and power supply voltage and frequency. By strengthening the joint of each connection part of the tone arm and promoting integration as much as possible, resonance elimination is attempted. First, the neck cylinder mechanism, which is the joint of the head shell and tone arm, has a structure in which the tip of the shell plug is held by strong force due to the wedge effect and the root of the shell plug is tightened firmly from four directions. In addition, the arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy and has a J-shaped structure with a high bending strength, giving it approximately eight times the rigidity of conventional aluminum pipes. In addition, this pipe has an integrated structure from the neck cylinder to the bearing. In order to prevent movement of the operating point of the arm by looseness caused by the clearance for rotating the ball bearing in the bearing section, we have adopted a structure in which the arm is supported by a straight shaft with a long distance between the fulcrums. This minimizes movement of the operating point even in the case of slight looseness of the bearing section. The SBMC sound material is used in the cabinet, and the partial resonance is reduced by examining all aspects such as thickness and structure, and by providing reinforcement in important parts. In addition, vibration is reduced by making the dust cover thick. A gel-like dump material is enclosed in the insulator to reduce the adverse effect of vibration."

## Description

"This is a full-auto player that thoroughly pursues the ideal of picking up all the music information engraved in the sound groove from every angle. It is equipped with Sony's original biotracer. This is a system that electronically controls all operations with a microcomputer that makes several hundred logical decisions every one thousandth of a second, speed and position sensors, and linear motors. This reduces tracking error and enables clearer music playback. The rotary system employs a 3Ω-stage block configuration, incorporating the most advanced technologies in the development of motor technology and control system to enable the turntable to rotate quietly and smoothly.

MOTOR
By removing the brush and slot from the DC motor, the BSL motor which fundamentally eliminated the cause of torque unevenness, the magnet-disk speed detection which quickly catches minute rotation changes by average detection signal of high-density magnetization on the turntable with the multi-gap head, and the quartz lock which performs accurate servo by utilizing high oscillation accuracy of the crystal, stable rotation characteristics are acquired.
