name: SONY
description:
## Description

"Full auto-player system with MC cartridge installed as standard. It is equipped with a biotracer that controls all operations electronically by means of a microcomputer.

MOTOR
By electronically controlling all operations with a microcomputer that makes hundreds of logical decisions every one thousandth of a second, speed and position sensors, and linear motors, it is possible to limit the low-frequency resonance peak to less than 3ΩdB no matter what cartridge is used, to improve cross-modulation distortion and low-frequency crosstalk, and to trace even records with slight warpage. The cartridge is equipped with an MC cartridge XL-333ΩE with an air core 8Ωcoil made of samarium-cobalt and with a replaceable needle. It is equipped with a Lummus Straight Arm that brings out the goodness of the light needle pressure high compliance cartridge and makes use of the traceability of the biotracer. In addition, in order to increase the rigidity of the arm pipe, the special aluminum alloy is tapered to increase the rigidity and suppress the influence of unwanted resonance.

MOTOR
The rotation system employs three stages : a linear BSL motor in which the brush and slot are removed from the DC motor to completely eliminate the cause of torque unevenness ; a magnet-disk speed detection in which the average value of the detection signal that is magnetized at high density on the turntable is detected by a multi-gap head to catch even small changes in rotation speed ; and a quartz lock in which accurate servo is achieved by utilizing the high oscillation accuracy of quartz crystal. These three stages achieve stable rotation. It employs an electronic needle pressure application method in which the needle pressure can be adjusted by the volume controller on the panel, and the inside force cancel amount corresponding to the needle pressure can be set simultaneously. As a result, the deviation of the proper needle pressure value due to the change of environmental temperature can be adjusted while listening to the playback sound. In addition to the normal auto operation, the front panel controls manual-like operations such as up / down of the tone arm and start / stop of the turntable. Strict queuing is possible without touching the arm. Equipped with an opto-electronic disc size selector that automatically selects the size of the record and leads in the tone arm. This mechanism also serves as a protective function that the needle does not work when there is no record. Equipped with a muting mechanism that eliminates the generation of noise when the record board and needle tip contact. The cabinet uses SBMC with large internal loss to eliminate resonance. We have also adopted a large insulator filled with a highly viscoelastic material. By using the sync unit sold separately, it is possible to play sync with the cassette deck."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"Equipped with an auto 0Ωbalance mechanism and digital display of needle pressure, this full-auto player system further expands the potential of biotracer.

TONE ARM
The tone arm is equipped with a biotracer which is an electronically controlled tone arm. The tone arm consists of a microcomputer that makes hundreds of logical decisions in one thousandth of a second, speed and position sensors, and a linear motor that electronically controls all operations. As a result, the low-frequency resonance peak can be suppressed to less than 3ΩdB regardless of the type of cartridge used. At the same time, the crosstalk is also improved, resulting in excellent low-frequency reproduction. It is also robust against sleigh records, and reduces the wow and flutter sensation, resulting in improved overall sound quality. The arm pipe is made of an aluminum alloy with increased rigidity and has a J-shaped structure with high bending strength, achieving rigidity approximately eight times that of conventional aluminum pipes. In addition, the arm pipe to the shaft is integrated with a single straight shaft to prevent movement of the operating point and suppress unnecessary vibration of the arm. Equipped with a contactless opto-electronic auto-disc size selector that automatically selects the record size and provides a safety function to prevent the tone arm from dropping when no record is installed. The rotating system uses a 3Ω-stage block consisting of a linear BSL motor, magne-disk speed detection, and quartz lock.

MOTOR
By adopting a linear BSL motor without brushes and slots in the DC motor, the mechanical torque change called cogging is eliminated, and quiet and smooth rotation is realized. Moreover, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency. In the magnet-disk speed detection, a multi-gap head detects the mean value of the detection signal, which is magnetized at high density on the turntable, and detects minute changes in the rotational speed. Also, since the generated signal frequencies are relatively high, servo compensation is possible up to the higher frequencies of the flutter components. It uses a quartz lock and utilizes the high oscillation accuracy of quartz to obtain stable rotational characteristics even with changes in ambient temperature and power supply voltage and frequency.

CABINET
In order to reduce the effect of vibration, an acoustic material SBMC is used for the cabinet, and an insulator filled with a high viscosity elastic material is used for the insulator. It employs an auto 0Ωbalance mechanism that eliminates the need for 0Ωbalance adjustment when the cartridge is replaced. When the tone arm is brought near the armrest, the 0Ωbalance of the arm is automatically adjusted. In addition, when the auto 0Ωbalance circuit using the microcomputer does not balance the 0Ωbalance, the digital needle pressure display flashes to give a warning. The needle pressure can be adjusted electronically by means of a needle pressure control volume located on the front of the instrument. The needle pressure value is displayed in digital form. The needle pressure can be adjusted even while playing the record, so that the optimum value can be obtained while listening to the performance. In addition, proper anti-skating is automatically set according to the needle pressure setting. The tone arm's lead-in / out, up / down, and all other operations are driven by a linear motor driven by a microprocessor circuit and can be operated with the dust cover closed. It is equipped with a queuing function, and the left and right movement of the tone arm can be controlled by a button. The tone arm moves slowly for the first 5Ωmm and then moves rapidly. Equipped with an electromagnetic brake, it instantly ensures normal rotation when changing the rotational speed. Equipped with a muting mechanism. Since it is structured so that muting is released when the needle tip is completely lowered, noise does not occur when the needle tip touches the record board. By using the separately sold synchronized remote control unit, it is possible to play synchronized with the cassette deck."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"A linear tracking player system equipped with an active trace servo system in addition to a biotracer. Biotracer is used for the tone arm part. In the biotracer, a speed sensor, a position sensor and a linear motor are installed on the vertical rotating part and horizontal driving part of the arm, respectively. The signals detected by the two sensors are sent to a servo amplifier, which supplies the necessary current to the linear motor to control the movement of the arm. In addition, it is easy to follow the disk. It can reproduce slight warpage and eccentricity without any problem. In addition, we have succeeded in suppressing the low-frequency resonance peak to less than 3ΩdB regardless of the cartridge used. This makes it possible to bring out the original character of the cartridge. It also improves crosstalk.

MOTOR
Linear tracking system equipped with newly developed active trace servo is adopted. Active Trace Servo is based on the major premise that the disk pitch always moves inward while varying variably. The motor for arm cross-feed is rotated in advance, and the change in pitch is read by the biotracer position detection sensor. When the pitch becomes coarse, the moving speed of the arm is increased, and when the pitch becomes fine, the moving speed of the arm is decreased. By this, the speed of the needle tip and the speed of the arm support are almost matched. With this active and race servo, the arm can move continuously without stopping while slightly changing the moving speed. This eliminates the so-called wild chervil caterpillar movement and greatly reduces phase distortion caused by sudden movement of the arm support. In order to eliminate the rattling of the arm support part which is a problem in the linear tracking system, the slide bearing by the mono-rail guide which matches the support shaft of the horizontal feed with the arm support point is used for stabilization, and the rattling is suppressed by the powerful damping force of the biotracer.

MOTOR
TURNTABLE
A linear BSL motor of the same system as the turntable is used for the motor for arm cross-feed. The turntable motor uses a linear BSL motor that was developed based on the Nohha for the turntable for consumer players and cutting machines. There is no slot (groove) that causes torque unevenness, and the brush is removed for a simple structure. The speed detection section of the servo circuit uses a Magne-disk speed detection method that employs precision measurement technology of the Sony Magne-scale. The multi-gap head detects 512Ωwave signals that are magnetized with high precision on the periphery of the turntable. This method enables servo compensation up to relatively high frequencies of flutter components.

MOTOR
In addition, in order to prevent the accurate servo from becoming ineffective due to the temperature characteristics of the element, we have adopted a quartz lock that controls the phase of the rotational frequency by utilizing the high oscillation accuracy of the crystal. This ensures stable rotational accuracy that is not affected by fluctuations in ambient temperature or power supply voltage. When the rotation is stabilized, the Locked indicator on the front panel lights to indicate that the quartz lock has been performed. The tone arm has a square pipe to increase rigidity and suppress natural vibration. In addition, the shell connector is also devised, and the tip of the shell plug is held by strong force due to the wedge effect, and the base is tightened from four directions using a neck cylinder mechanism. The SBMC has been adopted for the cabinet, which is less likely to resonate due to its larger internal loss than metal, can be machined with high precision, and has greater strength. In addition, a large rubber cup filled with a gel-like high-viscosity elastic material is used for the insulator, and an acrylic dust cover, which is resistant to howling, is used for the dust cover, thereby suppressing vibration from the outside in both solid propagation and air propagation. Equipped with auto 0Ωbalance function, vertical speed sensor and linear motor replace counter weight to automatically take 0Ωbalance. In addition, since the needle pressure adjustment is an electronic needle pressure application method that makes use of the power of the linear motor, it can be controlled while the disk is being played back. Almost all operations can be done with the front panel buttons except for replacing the disc. In addition to the normal auto operation such as start / stop of performance, Oatley peat, and rotation number switching, the dedicated BSL motor enables the tone arm to feed left / right, needle tip up / down, and turntable start / stop operation. If you press the FAST button at the same time as the left / right feed button of the arm, the moving speed will be increased. The size is automatically detected by the optoelectronic disk size selector. In addition, even if the start button is pressed without setting the disk, the needle tip does not move downward and returns as it is. Equipped with muting circuit linked to up / down of tone arm. It is always muting on when it is up, so you do not need to reduce the volume of the amplifier when you change the cartridge. The separately sold synchronized remote control unit allows synchronized play with the cassette deck."

"An armless player system equipped with a cabinet for TTS 2500Ω.

TURNTABLE
A direct drive turntable equivalent to TTS-2500Ωis used for the turntable part. Since the arm board part is independent from the cabinet, replacement of the arm can be performed easily. Also, there was a replacement arm board sold separately.

CABINET
The cabinet has a walnut finish and contains a special shock absorber to absorb external vibrations. Also, the removable acrylic dust cover is designed with a fleece top."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This 3Ω-head deck is the culmination of Sony Deck technology and was developed using Sony's technology. This is the first tape drive system in its class to use the closed-loop dual capstan system.

TRANSPORT
By placing the head part in the center of a pair of capstan and pinch roller, not only constant head touch can be obtained, but also tape vibration and uneven tension caused by tape running can be suppressed.

TRANSPORT
The capstan drive motor employs an ultra-low vibration eddy current type motor and an AC servo motor with a frequency generator (FG) attached to its shaft. It is controlled by a servo amplifier to maintain a constant rotational speed, enabling stable rotation with less vibration.

HEADS
The head uses an F & F head (ferrite & ferrite) that boasts about 200Ωtimes more wear resistance than conventional laminated heads. It has an all-ferrite structure in which both the core part and the guard part are hardened with ferrite. Furthermore, it is fused and welded with unstrained glass of the same hardness. There is no disturbance of the gap edge, and the narrow gap is maintained semi-permanently. In addition, since the front surface of the head is finished with a uniform black mirror (mirror surface), the head touch is good and dust adhesion is also prevented. It is equipped with an FM recording mechanism and a lock mechanism is added to the recording and playback buttons. If you use a timer that can be set in small increments, you can record repeatedly as many times as you want by turning the power on / off. The pinch roller is released during the rest period to prevent excessive load on the mechanism. With the adoption of logical control, the tape can be freely operated from rapid forward / rewind state to direct regenerating condition, and from recording / regenerating condition to direct rapid forward / rewind without damaging the tape. The rotating state of the reel motor is detected by a frequency generator (FG), and after the tape stops completely, it automatically moves to another operating state.

HEADS
A FET is used for the first stage of the head amplifier, and a direct coupling system is adopted in which this FET and an F & F (ferrite & ferrite) head are directly connected. Since there is no element that degrades the sound quality between the head and the first stage FET, the output of the head can be directly transmitted to the amplifier. In order to maximize the characteristics of all commercially available tapes, the bias and equalizer are independent, and a tape selector is installed to provide the optimum bias and equalizer. Equipped with a microphone attenuator, if the microphone input level is too high, the microphone input can be attenuated to an optimum level of 15ΩdB or 30ΩdB. Equipped with a tension arm for more stable tape travel. Since this arm is linked to the electric mechanism, it automatically stops when the tape is finished. Equipped with a pause mechanism. In this pose state, only the mechanism is stopped, so if you move the reel with your hand, you can get a detailed cue. Since the microphone input circuit and line input circuit are independent, mixing is possible. Equipped with a tape height adjuster, the height of the tape can be adjusted when the tape is moved to the reel surface. Equipped with a reel size selection switch that can be used with 7Ωinch and 10Ωinch reels. Equipped with line-out volume. We have eliminated the reel cap and adopted a reel lock that holds the reel easily and securely."

description:
## Description

"AV amplifier with built-in FM/AM tuner equipped with unique visual touch mechanism. It comes with a one button remote control that transmits radio waves. It can be operated with a single remote control while watching the screen displayed on the monitor. This one button remote control uses a gyroscope to detect the vertical and horizontal angle change of the hand holding the remote control and convey it as the movement of the pointer on the screen. UHF-band radio waves are used instead of infrared waves to transmit remote control signals. Compared with infrared waves, radio waves have the advantage that signals can easily reach even if there are obstacles such as sofas. Commands from the one button remote control are retransmitted from the infrared transmitter on the front panel of the AV amplifier to control the VCR and LD player. Since the AVU-1000Ωis designed for wide directivity, it can be operated with almost no problem even when stored in a rack. Since the AVU-1000Ωis equipped with a remote control signal learning function, it is compatible with AV equipment manufactured by other companies than Sony. In addition, the AVU-1000Ωcan operate lighting devices, electric screens, and other devices that are controlled by infrared remote controls. It has a visual Line 5Ωand four audio inputs. It is equipped with functions such as Auto Start which can set the source started when the power is turned on, Auto Play which automatically starts playback only by selecting a function, and Sound Field Link which can link sound field programs to functions. In addition, it is equipped with an auto program function that automatically executes a series of operations such as switching the function to LD, turning off the light, and playing back the LD. Two programs can be set independently up to 10Ωsteps. Each step can also be set with a waiting time (1Ωsecond, 2Ωseconds, 5Ωseconds, 10Ωseconds). It is equipped with 10Ωsound field programs including Dolby Pro Logic. In particular, two programs, Theater and Live, add the sound of a theater and the sound of a concert hall to the signal output from the Dolby Pro Logic Decoder. You can enjoy Dolby stereo movie and music software in the atmosphere of a movie theater or concert hall. Equipped with a digital surround processor, it is equipped with various parameters that simulate the size of the room, the material of the wall, the front-rear and left-right positions of the seat, etc., and can be set according to the sound field program. Equipped with a 3Ω-band digital equalizer that can adjust the bass, mid and treble independently. Both bands can be increased or decreased by ¥10ΩdB in 1ΩdB steps. The Mid band adopts a parametric method that can change the slope (Q) characteristics in addition to selecting the center frequency, so that sound can be created according to the source to be reproduced and the situation. For example, you can listen to a CD while watching a video, and you can select the image of a visual device and the sound of an audio device independently from each other for simultaneous casting playback. name: TA-V606Ω
description:
## Description

"An AV amplifier equipped with digital cinema sound technology. With a 5Ω.1Ωchannel input, you can enjoy 5Ω.1Ωchannel surround sound with a DVD player with a Dolby digital processor, or 3Ω-1Ωstereo sound with a 5Ω.1Ωchannel input. It is equipped with a cinema studio mode using digital cinema surround, which is Sony's original surround technology. Cinema Studio Mode allows you to enjoy the sound effects of three different types of Sony Pictures Entertainment studios. A dynamic 5Ω-amp system with front L/R, center and rear L/R amplifiers is adopted, enabling more powerful surround playback. A large transformer with a wrapped core is used for the power supply. In conventional EI core transformers, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated and then combined (welded or bonded) to form the core. However, by adopting a wrap-packed structure in which E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are stacked alternately, there is no part that is cut in a fault in the magnetic path, reducing leakage of magnetic flux.

POWER SUPPLY
The electrolytic capacitor is also equipped with a large-capacity and large-size type for pure audio that is carefully selected through repeated trial listening not only in electrical characteristics but also in acoustic characteristics. The heat sink uses a high-rigidity large heat sink made of extruded aluminum that is tuned to suppress harmful fin squeal. The heat sink itself is also firmly fixed to the chassis body to reduce vibration structurally. The legs are equipped with an eccentric insulator. The eccentric insulator has a structure with a screw hole to avoid the center position, and by changing the phase of vibration, it is canceled and transmission to the chassis is reduced. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This ES series AV amplifier is compatible with Virtual Matrix 6Ω.1Ωmode and Digital Concert Hall mode. It is equipped with the Virtual Matrix 6Ω.1Ωmode corresponding to the 6Ω.1Ωa new surround system standard for movie theaters. In this mode, the rear channel, which used to be two channels, is divided into three channels : left, center, and right to clarify the sound localization of the rear part. Virtual Matrix 6Ω.1Ωmode includes Cinema Studio Reverbation (B), Virtual Multi-Dimensional and Screen Depth Matching, which are included in Cinema Studio EX mode. In addition, the rear center speaker is implemented as a virtual speaker for the case where the surround environment is already available in 5Ω.1Ωchannel. It is equipped with a digital concert hall mode to enjoy 2Ω-channel stereo sources such as CDs as a concert hall. In the Digital Concert Hall mode, DSP technology is used to create the reverberation that is not included in the software, and it reproduces the impact of a live concert in which the stage and the audience come together. In the Digital Concert Hall Mode, the acoustic characteristics of the Comcell ???? Hall in Amsterdam and the Musique Feline Saar in Viennea are carefully measured and incorporated into the DSP, and the reverberation sound falling on the audience seats is reproduced by virtual speakers using virtual 3ΩD technology. The A mode reproduces the Consell ???? Hall, and you can enjoy the sound field feeling that the initial reflection sound is rich, the stage is very large, and the height of the hall is high. The B mode reproduces the Muzik Feline Saar, and you can enjoy the rich reverberation without the initial reflection sound being conspicuous. In either mode, you can select the amount of reverberation to be generated, with the Standard at the center and three positions of dry (low reverberation) and wet (high reverberation), and the amount of reverberation can be adjusted. Equipped with Cinema Studio EX mode. This mode integrates cinematic studio reverberation, virtual (semi) multi-dimensional mode, and screen depth matching. You can choose from three modes, A/B/C, depending on the characteristics of the mixing studio that actually measured the reverberation in Hollywood. Three DSPs are installed in the audio format decoding and sound field processing section. Dolby Digital and DTS are decoded using a dedicated 24Ω-bit decode DSP, and digital cinema sound is calculated using two 32Ω-bit DSPs developed by Sony for sound field processing. It is equipped with a fully independent 6Ω-channel D/A converter and a 2Ω-channel A/D converter for digital cinema sound processing of analog input. The A/D converter has a 20Ω-bit resolution and the D/A converter supports 96ΩkHz/24Ωb-bit for all channels. A dynamic 5Ω-amp system is used for the amplifier section, and the same power transistor is used for each channel amplifier. This transistor has a built-in temperature compensation circuit, and stable operation is possible even when the transistor is cooled immediately after the power is turned on or when it is heated for a while. Equipped with an analog direct function.

POWER SUPPLY
If this function is turned ON, the power supply of the video and digital circuits can be stopped depending on the situation, reducing the noise harmful to enjoying the analog source. The frequency response has been expanded to 100ΩkHz to support next-generation audio formats such as SACD. Equipped with 5Ω.1Ωchannel input jacks. This jack can also be used as an input jack for 3Ω-1Ωstereo. Component video input / output terminal is mounted. The heat sink is a sf heat sink. This heat sink uses a vibration dispersion fin structure to suppress fin resonance, and by inserting a different rib into each fin, tuning fork resonance is prevented and split vibration is suppressed.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In addition, the power amplifier block uses a horizontally opposed construction placed between a pair of sf heat sinks to ensure stable operation by creating a uniform environment with amplifiers for five channels.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with a large power transformer that uses a wrapped core. In the conventional EI core transformer, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated and then combined to form the core. In the wrap-packed structure, however, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are alternately stacked on top of E-type magnetic steel sheets to form the core. As a result, there are no faults in the magnetic path, greatly reducing leakage of magnetic flux. A pin-type transformer is used to extract the intermediate voltage from the coil of the transformer. For transformers of this size, lead wires are generally inserted into the coil for connection. However, in the lead type, winding disorder occurs due to swelling of the connection part. In the pin-type transformer, winding disorder does not occur because the coil is directly connected to the terminal, leading to high sound quality. An eccentric insulator is used for the legs. This insulator changes the phase of the transmitted vibration and cancels it by providing a screw hole avoiding the center. Newly developed driver part integrated design is adopted for the display part, and FL tube of 2Ω-line display is adopted. By integrating the driver into the tube as an integrated LSI, it is difficult for lighting noise to leak to the outside of analog circuits. In addition, the two line display increases the amount of information. On-screen capability. Equipped with an FM/AM tuner. Comes with a bi-directional wireless remote with learning and LCD capabilities."

For example, if a DVD player image is connected directly from the component outputs to a projector, audio can be used with the power of the video amplifier turned off by using the CD-input. Digital inputs can be used for Dolby Digital and DTS decoding and digital cinema sound processing. It supports decoding of Dolby Digital and DTS formats. It is equipped with three DSPs for decoding and sound field processing from decoding of sound formats to calculation of digital cinema sound. Dolby We have newly adopted a 24Ω-bit DSP dedicated to decoding digital and DTS. Since this DSP is dedicated to decoding, there is no waste in the arithmetic circuit and operation noise is extremely reduced. In addition, a hardware arithmetic block is built in to increase the precision of repeatedly used arithmetic. This demonstrates the ability to approach the limit of 24Ω-bit DSP with total arithmetic precision. The TA-V777ΩES uses two 32Ω-bit DSPs specifically developed by Sony for sound field processing. These DSPs are highly capable of processing sound fields even with a single DSP. In addition, the TA-V 32ΩES raises the operating clock of these DSPs, allowing more room for the sound field processing of Cinema Studio EX with additional screen depth matching. All digital inputs support 96ΩkHz/24Ω-bit, and the D/A converter is capable of converting a 96ΩkHz signal into an audio waveform at the same rate without downsampling. Equipped with a digital input swap function, the coaxial terminal assignment can be changed according to the convenience of the system. Digital addition to the standard roll-off roll-off characteristics in addition to the standard roll-off characteristics. The standard roll-off characteristic follows the Theory of digital audio and is rich in information. The slow roll-off characteristic has a gentle attenuation characteristic in the band of 20ΩkHz or higher, so that the transient response is quiet and the sound is comfortable to the ears. This allows dialogue and dialogue to be positioned in front.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section uses a dynamic five amplifier system in which the same power transistor is used for all five channel amplifiers. The power transistor is a mill wrapper rate dual-chip power transistor. This device consists of two adjacent power transistor chips with the same characteristics on a single copper plate. This device has the same characteristics, the same heat balance, and the current path passes through adjacent locations, so that the generation of distortion associated with synthesis can be minimized. The volume part uses 6Ωconnected volumes independent of each channel to suppress the feeling of turbidity caused by interference between signals. In addition, the transformer is equipped with an intermediate tap for extracting the required voltage according to each supply circuit. The intermediate tap is extracted by using a pin type for extracting the coil itself to the tap section. POWER SUPPLY

The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer with a mass exceeding 6Ωkg. In the conventional EI core transformer, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated and then combined (welded or bonded) to form the core. The transformer used in the TA-VA8ΩES has a wrap-packed structure in which I-type and E-type magnetic steel sheets are alternately stacked on top of E-type magnetic steel sheets. Although this structure takes time to manufacture, it is advantageous in terms of sound quality. Since there is no fault section in the magnetic path, leakage of magnetic flux is sharply reduced and the influence on the audio circuit is reduced. The TA-VA8ΩES electrolytic capacitor used in the power supply is a sound-quality-oriented capacitor manufactured for the TA-VA8ΩES.

A FET is also used in the AM tuner to reduce noise, and a double-tuned ceramic filter prevents interference. Equipped with a tuning meter. Uses FM equally spaced scale dial. Green dial illumination is used. It has a headphone port. There were separately sold Eurasian cheek finish wood cases and mount brackets."

name: SS-GR1Ω
description:
## Description

"The R Series speaker system was developed with original know-how aiming at comfortable and rich sound. The enclosure uses a super-oval enclosure that prevents harmful reflected waves and reduces the concentration of internal sound pressure. This enclosure uses a unique super-oval shape designed by applying a high-order elliptic function to the shape of the round part. It is manufactured by introducing the rounding technique used in the side plate molding of a grand piano. The rounding technique is a time-consuming process in which dozens of plates of approximately 1Ωmm thickness with different internal losses are stacked, bent, and kneaded together to form a single baffle plate without any cuts. This realizes a smooth shape extending from the front to the side and back. It smoothly diffracts sound waves and creates a unique soft form. We have adopted a resonance control (RC) frame that guides the sound of the enclosure in a better direction while ensuring that the enclosure has sufficient sound insulation characteristics. In the RC frame, a large, robust wooden frame is placed in the center of the enclosure to form the framework of the enclosure with front and rear baffles connected to it. As a result of careful vibration mode control, the structure and sound similar to those of string instruments such as cello and contrabass are realized. In addition, by applying a slanding process to the left and right of the top plate and giving it a function similar to the soundboard used for piano, the sound is made more natural. The speaker unit above the mid-range is equipped with a CD (Constant Directivity) horn, a machined horn with a front baffle. The CD horn performs impedance matching between the vibration system of the unit and air, not only increases the radiation efficiency of sound waves, but also provides excellent directional characteristics for a predetermined radiation angle. In the SS-GR1Ω, the directional range is set to 90Ωdegrees horizontally and 40Ωdegrees vertically on the axis. In the horizontal direction, the sound pressure outside the range is lowered to minimize the reflection of the sound on the wall of the listening room. In the vertical direction, harmful interference between the speaker units is reduced to obtain sound without turbidity. In addition, the horn is machined directly from the baffle plate to reduce harmful horn noise, and there are no steps or grooves at the horn opening to enable smooth sound wave emission. Using a time alignment system, the sound source positions of woofer, mid-range, tweeter, and super tweeter are aligned on a vertical line, and sound waves of all bands are radiated so that they reach the ear equally. The network section has a crossover design of 18ΩdB/oct. with good slope sharpness and the ability to drive all units in positive phase. We also select individual parts through trial listening. For example, we use an iron-core coil for low-frequency sound and an air-core coil for medium-frequency sound. We select the right material for the right place and use it after curing it with a resin mold. We also select capacitors with aluminum electrolytic type, MP type, and film type. In addition, to prevent adverse effects such as electromagnetic induction, the circuit boards of network circuits are separated for each band and fixed together on the bottom plate of the enclosure, which is the most stable in terms of layout.

WOOFER
In the low range, a 30Ωcm cone type woofer using pulp mixed with polyamide fiber for the diaphragm is mounted. By adopting a triple suspension system with a three point support with a damper behind the voice coil, the rolling phenomenon is prevented and the voice coil stroke is stabilized. In addition, the triple suspension system can make the edge material softer than that of the two point support, so compliance (mobility) is increased and distortion in the ultra-low frequency range is reduced. In addition, aluminum die-cast with excellent vibration characteristics is used for the frame, and a sound with less turbidity is achieved by deadning treatment for vibration isolation. The mid-range is equipped with a 10Ωcm balanced drive mid-range consisting of a cone section made of pulp paper mixed with polyamide fiber and a SiC dome section. The balance drive method places the contact point between the diaphragm and voice coil (bobbin) at the point where the diaphragm can be driven most efficiently. This minimizes harmful split vibration and expands the piston motion range. In addition, both the voice coil and magnetic circuit are larger in the balanced drive than in the general cone type unit, so it contributes to the improvement of the distortion, and the distortion from 1ΩkHz to 3ΩkHz, which is easy to be heard, is suppressed to 0Ω.1Ω% or less. In addition, it is housed in an independent back cavity to optimize back pressure.

TWEETER
A 3Ω-cm dome type tweeter using SiC for the diaphragm is mounted in the high range. In order to reduce the conversion loss from electricity to sound, we have adopted a surface drive structure in which the voice coil drive is performed outside the diaphragm surface. In the surface drive, the sound wave is generated through the shortest route from the voice coil (bobbin) to the diaphragm surface, so the sound wave is emitted from the diaphragm surface faster than the sound that has passed inside the diaphragm. Therefore, the characteristic sound of the diaphragm itself is hardly generated.

TWEETER
A 2Ωcm dome type super tweeter using biocellulose for the diaphragm is mounted on the super high frequency range. Biocellulose was developed jointly by Sony, Ajinomoto Co., Ltd., and the Research Institute for Fiber and Polymer Materials of the Agency of Industrial Science and Technology. It has a high propagation speed comparable to that of aluminum, an internal loss comparable to that of paper, and an extremely light weight of approximately 0Ω.01Ωg except for the edge.

CABINET
The exterior of the enclosure is finished with a veneer with a walnut."

## Description

"ES series active super woofer that adopts advanced SAW system. The unit has 2Ω20Ωcm cone type woofers. This unit uses a large magnet with a diameter of 120Ωmm, a large-diameter damper, and a voice coil. In addition, the cone paper is a non-prescone with strong elasticity and is fixed with a wide strong edge to realize a unit structure that is resistant to distortion even at large amplitude. A large-capacity audio condenser is also used. In consideration of the acoustic characteristics of humans, we have incorporated a correction circuit that increases the volume of the deep bass sound, which is difficult to hear at low volume, and approaches the flat characteristics as the volume increases. The high-cut frequency is continuously variable. It has a line output terminal to which a second subwoofer can be connected."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"SONY's No. 1Ωstand-alone D/A converter. Adhering to the philosophy of the ESPRIT series, we pursue the highest priority for sound quality in all aspects of the circuit configuration, structure, and device.

POWER SUPPLY
The DAS 702Ωes is divided into three sections : a digital section, an analog section (including a D/A converter circuit) and a power supply section. In addition to the audio circuit, the D/A converter section that uses a dedicated IC is used independently for Lch/Rch. This fully twin-mono configuration is used to thoroughly pursue sound quality. The digital section contains a clock generator, a data demodulation circuit, and an oversampling digital filter in a shield case to prevent the digital circuit from interfering with the analog and power sections. The PLL circuit for clock generation is divided into Route 3Ωand composed of optimum circuits and constants for each region. The PLL for the aperture, which is the time reference of the analog signal, is made independent to realize a circuit with high stability. The data demodulation circuit uses a newly developed C-MOS LSI (CX23053Ω) to decode the digital audio interface format input signal into normal 16Ω-bit data, emphasis control signals, and other synchronization signals. An over-sampling digital filter is installed. By increasing the sampling frequency, the band of the noise portion of the digitized signal component shifts to a higher frequency. This eliminates the need for a steep attenuation characteristic of the low-pass filter, which cuts the noise when returning the audio signal. This enables the use of a low-order low-pass filter with less distortion and phase shift. The DAS-0ΩES uses the CX23034Ωdigital filter that was developed for oversampling and has excellent characteristics such as a passband ripple of less than + 0Ω.01ΩdB and a stop-global attenuation of more than 80ΩdB. 702ΩeS has excellent characteristics. The D/A converter circuit uses a ladder-type IC, which provides current output when 16Ω-bit parallel data is input. This circuit does not require a clock as seen in the integration type, making it very simple. Compared with the integration type, the ladder type tends to have a slightly larger differential non-linearity error and has some disadvantages in terms of the distortion factor in the specification. However, we have obtained good results by adopting it and making the circuit simple. The DAS 702Ωes uses two of these ICs to simultaneously add input data to the left and right channels to adjust the phase of the L and R channels. To prevent distortion, a sample-and-hold circuit is installed to convert current values into voltage values. This circuit converts the current values into voltage values. The output of the D/A converter circuit shows a new value at an interval of approximately 11ΩÏ‰ sec (at 44Ω.1ΩkHz). This value is sampled for approximately 5Ω.5ΩÏ‰ sec in consideration of a sufficiently stable timing and held for the remaining approximately 5Ω.5ΩÏ‰ sec. Since this sampling start point is the time reference of the converted analog value, the clock with high time axis accuracy generated by the aperture PLL of the clock generator is used. A low-pal filter is installed to remove high-frequency components outside the audio band contained in the output signal of the sample-and-hold circuit. In terms of circuitry, a GIC-type seventh order Butterworth active filter has been adopted, and audio signal components only pass through the resistance, which has succeeded in minimizing sound quality degradation. The output amplifier is an audio op-amp. Especially fTThe frequency at which the current amplification factor hfe becomes 1Ωis extended to approximately 700ΩMHz. The PNP side, which is usually around 1Ωto 2ΩMHz, is an excellent process that achieves almost the same performance as the NPN side. The element structure with good thermal balance and IC package with large heat capacity make use of Sony's tradition. In addition, we use a lot of carefully examined materials such as simple and straight transmission by twin mono circuit configuration of L/Rch separation using bus bar, LC-OFC wire material, metal coating resistance, etc.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section includes a large-capacity (190ΩVA) power transformer with two windings for analog and digital circuits, an ultra-high-speed rectifier diode, and a large ceramic powder electrolytic capacitor with a total capacitance of approximately 33Ω,000ΩÏ‰ F.

The first 4Ωbits are the SYNC part for synchronization, the next is the 24Ω-bit field for audio data, and the last 4Ωbits are the part for emphasis ON/OFF and information accompanying data such as subcodes. The data thus assembled is subjected to a modulation called biphase mark, in which data 0Ωis inverted once and data 1Ωis inverted twice. However, in the SYNC part, a special pattern called preamble is embedded, and the inversion by data is ignored, so that the duration of high level is longer than other parts. The D/A converter uses this preamble part for synchronization. Equipped with an indicator capable of automatic switching for sampling frequency of 32ΩkHz/44Ω.1ΩkHz/48ΩkHz. description:
## Description

"D/A converter, the successor to DAS 702Ωes. The layout of the DAS 703Ωes is divided into three parts, digital part, analog part and power supply part, and the construction is simple and follows the signal flow. In addition, the digital part is contained in a shield case, and an optical transfer method using light is adopted for data transmission from the digital part to the analog part, which prevents the digital circuit from interfering with the analog circuit and degrading the sound quality. We have reduced the size of the digital circuit in order to maximize the advantages of the digital separate system. The digital circuit consists mainly of a data demodulation circuit and an oversampling digital filter. The data demodulation is processed by a single LSI (CX 23053Ω) developed for the decoder. The digital filter uses an LSI (CX 23034Ω), which has an excellent filter attenuation of more than 80ΩdB. A high-precision double PLL clock generation circuit is used for clock generation. The clock required for the digital filter and data demodulation circuit must accurately track the jitter in the input signal, but the clock for the sample-and-hold circuit is the time axis of the analog output signal and must be prevented from tracking the jitter. Taking these points into consideration, the DAS 703Ωes is designed as a high-precision double PLL that combines two PLLs with different characteristics : a digital PLL of jitter tracking type and an analog PLL of jitter non-tracking type. An optical transfer method using an optical transmission element (photocoupler) is adopted for data transmission from digital circuit to analog circuit, which reduces various distortion and noise caused by ground current. We have adopted a ladder type D/A converter IC. In the ladder type, when 16Ω-bit parallel data is input, a current corresponding to each bit is generated first, and then the sum is obtained through a resistor network called a ladder. The DAS 703Ωes uses a current-output type, which is larger and more robust than the voltage-output type, which uses the internal resistance of the IC. It is also designed to use the voltage conversion itself as a sample-and-hold circuit. This effectively eliminates the need for an amplifier and provides fresher sound quality. Equipped with a direct sample-and-hold circuit. The sample-and-hold circuit samples only the latter half of the D/A converter IC, where the data is stable, and holds this value until the next stable data comes. This is because the output of the sample-and-hold circuit is distorted if the unstable value immediately after conversion of the input data of the D/A converter IC is output as it is. The direct sample-and-hold circuit also directly converts current to voltage. The analog low-pass filter uses a GIC type 7Ωth order Butterworth active filter. The output of the analog filter is output through an output amplifier that also serves as a de-emphasis circuit. The DAS 703Ωes output amplifier combines a cascode dual FET with no capacity distortion at the first stage and a power MOS FET buffer circuit with a large current capacity at the output stage. This amplifier has sufficient volume and high-quality mid - and high-range. The chassis is made to be a tough one by rationally combining structural materials of sufficient thickness and strength. The insulator uses a vibration suppression structure that combines ceramics and non-resilient rubber.

POWER SUPPLY

Also, the digital one is a little bit small but has a capacity that can cover the whole normal CD player. Ceramic powder dispersion type electrolytic capacitor is adopted for electrolytic capacitor. This condenser improves sound quality by dispersing fine ceramic powder in the electrolytic solution to activate the movement of abnormal noise in the electrolytic solution. An ES board is used for the printed circuit board. The resist coating on general printed circuit boards increases the capacitance between patterns, which has an effect on sound quality. On ES boards, the resist between patterns is removed to ensure sound quality with less hardness and distortion. Resin molded acoustic resistor is used for the resistor. name: DAS-R1Ω
description:
## Description

"This is a D/A converter that converts digital signals into analog signals with extremely high precision and eliminates resonance. The digital filter is an 18Ω-bit type with 8Ωx oversampling. The sampling frequency of 44Ω.1ΩkHz input from a CD player is converted to 352Ω.8ΩkHz, which is 8Ωtimes the sampling frequency. This greatly increases the information density and reduces the load on the analog filter to improve sound quality. In addition, the DAS-R1Ωdigital filter has an extremely high order of 293Ωorder, so it has excellent characteristics such as a ripple within ¥0Ω.00001ΩdB within the band, a preecho of -124ΩdB or less, and a displacement of 120ΩdB or more at 150ΩkHz. Moreover, the calculation error is much smaller than the final output of the 18Ω-bit calculation value, so it is virtually error-free. In order to reduce requantization noise, we have introduced a calculation method called noise shaping. In this method, errors in the data are always accumulated, and the accumulated errors are also considered when rounding to determine the output. The D/A conversion method uses the overlap staggered D/A conversion method. In this method, two D/A converter ICs operating at 4Ωfs per channel are used, and the output is synthesized with the operation timing shifted by half a cycle. The two D/A converters alternately receive 8Ωtimes over-sampled data, and overlap operation is performed. The feature of this method is that the aperture effect, which is a kind of filter characteristic, starts at 4Ωfs even though it is 8Ωfs D/A conversion. This eliminates dither noise caused by noise shaping that concentrates near 4Ωfs. As a result of the overlapping operation, the distortion and noise are averaged, and the distortion factor is improved by up to 3ΩdB compared with the case where the D/A converter is used alone. Moreover, the output current is doubled, and the SN ratio is improved by up to 6ΩdB. The FB chassis is used to eliminate unnecessary vibration and resonance. It consists of a frame around the perimeter and several beams connecting the previous and next frames, each of which is thick enough to be firmly joined together.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with dedicated power transformers for both digital and analog power supplies to reduce mutual interference.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the power supply section has enough space to occupy approximately 2Ω/3Ωof the internal space to compensate for stable power supply. In addition to the twin-link optical input terminal for connection with CDP-R1Ω, two coaxial input terminals are installed. The digital input automatically corresponds to three sampling frequencies : 32Ωkhz, 44Ω.1Ωkhz and 48Ωkhz. You can also determine the source of the program being played by using an indicator that shows the sampling frequency during operation and the Digital Input indicator linked to the input selector switch."

description:
## Description

"R series D/A converter equipped with high density linear converter system composed mainly of pulse D/A converter. A pulse D/A converter uses one current source and one electronic switch and has only two output values, high (current flow) and low (no current flow). And all the intermediate values of audio waveforms are obtained by the time average of the pulse output, which is the spread of the binary output in the time axis direction. Therefore, in principle, the differential non-linear distortion caused by the error of the current source, the glitch and 0Ωcross distortion caused by the difference in the operation timing of the electronic switch, which are unavoidable in the conventional D/A converter, do not occur. The Pulse D/A converter achieves a maximum operating frequency of 50ΩMHz for the master clock and 50Ωmillion pulses per second. The Sony Extended Noise Shaping calculation method is used to calculate the pulses, and a high dynamic range is achieved by generating a high-density pulse train. The DAS-R1Ωa uses two pulse D/A converters in complimentary service mode to cancel harmonic distortion with auxiliary positive - and negative-phase outputs and to increase the S / N ratio by doubling the output current. The CDP-R1Ωa and DAS-R1Ωa use the Twin Link S method, which enables one master clock, in order to realize a more complete separate type. Apart from the data tradition from the player side to the converter, it is equipped with an interface that sends a clock signal from the converter side to the player. This is structured so that both units are connected by two optical cables in a round trip, and data read from the disk can be sent out in synchronization with the movement of the D/A converter. The master clock is placed so close to the pulse D/A converter that it can be said that it is directly attached, and a direct digital sync circuit for rearranging the data on the chip of the pulse D/A converter is mounted. This realizes a clean D/A conversion without jitter. We have also developed a logical synchronous circuit based on a high-purity twin PLL interface purity twin PLL interface with less leakage of digital noise, and developed an interface IC with this built-in circuit. The characteristics are improved by installing a low-jitter optical input unit. FB chassis is adopted for the chassis structure. This chassis is made of metal material of sufficient thickness and strength, and the whole chassis is joined by a frame surrounding the outer circumference and beams before and after passing the front and rear. This structure ensures almost total strength only by this frame and beams. It is fixed directly on the most neutral beam with low vibration without using any special metal fittings when mounting the mechanism and substrate. The legs are made of fine ceramic insulators combined with rubber with good braking performance.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with two transformers, one for the interface and the other for the audio, to reduce mutual interference between circuits handling different types of signals. In addition, to reduce the noise of the transformer due to its structure, it is stored in the transformer case filled with resin. It is equipped with a multi-interface function that automatically responds to 32Ωkhz, 44Ω.1Ωkhz and 48Ωkhz, and is also compatible with DAT decks and BS tuners."

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"An R10Ωseries D/A converter that uses a current pulse D/A converter. The newly developed current-pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter. The current pulse D/A converter is a single-bit D/A converter that uses current pulses. In the D/A converter, digital data is converted into a pulse train. In the conventional D/A converter, the pulse train is represented by a voltage. The voltage value that represents the pulse height is the power supply voltage applied to the converter IC. If the power supply voltage does not fluctuate, there is no problem. In reality, however, the power supply voltage fluctuates depending on the current consumption, and the height of the pulse train fluctuates slightly. In addition, since it is a voltage pulse, it is difficult to completely prevent the mixing of voltage noise generated by the arithmetic circuit, etc.. To avoid these problems, it is necessary to review the fact that the pulse is represented by a voltage. The current pulse D/A converter used in the DAS-R10Ωconverts the physical quantity used for D/A conversion from voltage to current, and is not affected by the noise of the arithmetic circuit, thus improving sound quality. A current pulse is generated by alternately distributing a single DC current to two circuits. When a current flows through one circuit (when there is a pulse), the other circuit becomes 0Ω, so that a pair of positive and negative current pulses are obtained. This allows perfect balance transmission over the entire audio signal path from the time of signal generation, reducing the influence of noise. The current-pulse D/A converter has a feature of eliminating power supply voltage fluctuations and is rich in low-frequency expression. In addition, the newly developed complex voltage-current conversion circuit (CIV circuit), which converts current pulses into voltage waveforms, has noise elimination performance. Therefore, compared with voltage-type pulse D/A converters, there is less noise in the output signal, and a low-order low-pass filter with good group delay characteristics can be used as a low-pass filter in the latter stage. In addition, the CIV circuit itself has excellent performance in that there is no group delay degradation in the audio band good results such as high S/N ratio, sense of orientation, and sense of scale are obtained. The digital filter uses a DSP parallel FIR type digital filter. With conventional digital data, when the data is oversampled by 8Ωtimes, the original data is doubled to create intermediate data, and the next data is doubled. Each time intermediate data is created, new data is filled in between the original data and the data. With this serial method, there is a rounding error at the time of intermediate data creation, and this error accumulates every time operations are repeated. The DAS-R10Ωuses eight DSPs, which have more computing power than a digital filter, and uses a parallel computing circuit that produces eight times more data than the original data at once, thus minimizing computation errors. All the analog signal paths, including the current pulse D/A converter, are made of discrete component without the use of integrated circuits. Therefore, there are no restrictions associated with the use of ICs, and the performance is maximized. In addition, there is no risk of noise contamination from the power supply system through the silicon substrate, which cannot be avoided with ICs. A metal core module is used for the amplifier circuit. This system consists of a metal core (metal substrate) made of aluminum alloy, heat-resistant insulating treatment, copper circuit patterns, and surface mounted components. The metal core itself is a metal with good thermal conductivity, so the heat balance of the circuit as a whole is extremely good. In addition, since it is divided into modules, it is more resistant to external vibration. In addition, surface mounted components do not have lead wires, so the contact between the lead wire and the component body can be omitted, and the vibration of the lead wire itself can be eliminated. The motherboard for the digital circuit section and the D/A converter section uses a 4Ω-layer board to connect signals at the shortest distance and to deploy power and ground on the entire surface. As with the metal core module, surface mounting is positively adopted for mounting the components on the motherboard, shortening the signal path and improving the mounting density of the components. The operation program of the DSP can be switched by the filter switch on the front panel. In the DAS-R10Ω, the operation program is supplied from a ROM (read-only memory) installed outside the operation block. In addition to the normal ROM which is the standard mode, the ROM with the optional program written is installed, and it can be switched according to compatibility with the system and source."

description:

name: SONY
description:
## Description

"Digital surround processor with digital delay and Dolby surround. We have adopted a digital delay circuit and a semiconductor device developed in-house. In addition to the delay of the audio signal, the matrix synthesis corresponding to each surround position is also processed by the digital circuit. As a result, there is no phase rotation of the delay sound, which tends to occur with analog delay, and the surround effect with excellent sense of localization is obtained. The newly developed C-MOSIC and high-speed digital presence synthesizer ""CXD-1079Ω"" are used for the IC. It has built-in arithmetic units such as multipliers and adders and interfaces with peripheral ICs, and enables real-time high-speed digital signal processing to obtain sound field effects by combination with various RAMs. In addition, the single-chip design greatly reduces digital noise and unwanted radiation, which are problems with digital audio equipment. The A/D and D/A converters are linear with 16Ω-bit quantization bits and an integral type with a sampling frequency of 44Ω.1ΩkHz. The delay time adjustment enables LR-independent control in 0Ω.1Ωmsec steps within the range of 0Ωto 90Ωmsec (10Ωto 30Ωmsec for Dolby Surround playback). The sound field space can be expanded and a sense of distance can be created freely with a precision of every 3Ω-4Ωcm in terms of sound velocity. In addition, up to three types of adjusted delay times can be stored and recalled with one touch. You can enjoy presence delay by preparing a second set of amplifiers and speakers. With Presence Delay, the presence speaker is placed in the direction of many reflective surfaces, such as the corner of a wall or ceiling, so that the initial reflected sound is played back. The initial reflected sound can be finely controlled by setting the delay time, and the volume level and balance can also be adjusted.

NOISE REDUCTION
Equipped with a Dolby surround position by digital delay circuit. With a built-in 20ΩW + 20ΩW power amplifier, surround playback is possible just by setting a small speaker in the rear. The delay time can also be adjusted in 0Ω.1Ωmsec steps during Dolby Surround playback. Other surround positions include matrix playback and hole playback."

description:
## Description

"This PCM processor is equipped with the same 16Ω-bit format as professional equipment, and the new function OVC enables long-time digital recording and playback. In a digital recording system, an analog signal is converted (quantized) by a processor into a binary digital code composed only of 0Ωand 1Ωand recorded on tape. In addition to the conventional 14Ω-bit EIAJ format, the PCM-16ΩE S is equipped with the same 16Ω-bit format that is also used for compact disks and professional devices, improving dynamic range and distortion factor in addition to the conventional 14Ω-bit EIAJ format. 501Ωes is equipped with 16Ω-bit format which is also used for professional equipment. In addition, 16Ω-bit tapes can be played on other 14Ω-bit systems as well as 14Ω-bit tapes. It is equipped with the newly developed OVC (Optimum Video Condition) adjustment function which enables the use of the VCR in the long-time mode. In the past, when a VCR is used in the long-time mode, the reading level of the digital signal becomes narrower than that in the basic mode, which adversely affects the sound quality during playback. However, the PCM-501ΩES is equipped with an OVC function that can set the data reading level to an appropriate value in the long-time mode. The optimum point can be set by checking the OVC indicator of the 3Ω-point LED display. As a result, the PCM 501Ωes can be combined with almost any video deck, enabling up to eight hours of recording and playback. An output terminal is mounted on the back panel that enables easy digital dubbing by connecting another VCR. Sony's proprietary 16Ω-bit A/D and D/A converters and high-performance, small-size LSIs enable high-fidelity design. It is equipped with a peak program meter that covers a wide range from -50ΩdB to 0ΩdB (reference level -15ΩdB) by double indication method that displays peak hold and real time level simultaneously. It is also equipped with an OVER display function that warns of input signal over-level and recording volume over-high, making it easier to set the level. The peak program meter Rch is equipped with a tracking indicator that displays the tracking status, making it easy to adjust the tracking of the video deck used. Equipped with a PB MUTE function that automatically mutes when a drop-out occurs and allows you to enjoy comfortable playback. It is equipped with auto-emphasis function which makes PCM digital sound more beautiful. It is equipped with a REC MUTE function that allows you to create an unsignalized portion during recording. Equipped with a Monitor Out connector that allows image monitoring regardless of power ON/OFF. Equipped with headphone volume terminal that can adjust the headphone level."

description:

The back channel can be adjusted with the level adjustment volume on the back side, and a power amplifier can be connected directly. description:
## Description

"MD deck No. 1Ωannounced by SONY. It was developed with the aim of becoming a basic sound recorder with easy-to-understand and easy-to-use operability as the first generation. With the AMS button, you can quickly call up and play the songs you want to listen to, and with the 25Ωkeys on the remote control, you can directly select songs with one touch. In addition, you can enjoy program playback, shuffle playback, one song / all songs / A-B repeat playback. A 4Ω-mega DRAM is used for the sound jump guard memory. Audio data read from the disc is stored in memory (up to approximately 8Ωseconds) and sent out. This makes it possible to start the memory with the sound immediately after the pause is released. It is equipped with a music calendar that allows you to check the number of tracks recorded on the disc and the station number during performance. Up to 25Ωsongs are displayed with a calendar frame when MD music software is installed, and without a calendar frame when recording mini discs are installed. A 12Ω-character FL display is adopted, and messages such as disc name and song title are displayed in alphabet (scroll display for 13Ωcharacters or more) on discs in which character information is recorded. In addition, it is equipped with a digital peak meter that can confirm the accurate recording level. With a built-in clock in the body, you can automatically record the date of each song by the year, month, day, hour, and minute by adjusting the clock once, and easily check when it was recorded. Equipped with the TOC EDIT function, editing functions such as COMBINE, which connects two consecutive tracks into one track, DIVIDE, which divides one track into two tracks, MOVE, which transfers one track to a desired track number, and ERASE, which instantly erases any track. With the DIVIDE edit function, you can adjust the starting position of the track in approximately ¥60Ωms steps. With the rehearsal function, you can set the music while listening to your ears to see where the music is divided. The MD mechanism is die-cast to achieve high reliability and durability. It uses an oversampling 1Ω-bit A / D converter and a hybrid pulse D/A converter. Equipped with an optical digital input / output terminal and a microphone input terminal. Equipped with an audio bus terminal, it can be easily combined with a system stereo such as Pro Pixie. By simply setting the MD-recorder to the regenerating condition, it is possible to perform auto function in which the input of the amplifier section is automatically switched, auto power on / off in which the power is linked, timer recording and playback. name: SONY
description:
## Description

"This MD deck inherits the high sound quality design of MDS-JA555ΩES, and is equipped with MDLP mode and S. F edit. It is equipped with the MDLP mode, which is an improvement of the ATRAC audio compression technology and realizes about twice the compression performance of the conventional system. ATRAC reduces the data size by eliminating sound components that are hard to hear. ATRAC3Ω, which is used in the MDLP mode, further improves the compression ratio while minimizing degradation of sound quality. As one example, we have adopted a data encoding method called Huffman coding, which focuses on the frequency of data occurrence. Shorter codes are assigned to frequently occurring data sequences, and longer codes are assigned to infrequently occurring data sequences to improve compression efficiency. In addition, in order to maintain high sound quality even with high compression, we are also improving the accuracy of band division and spectrum blocking, which are pre-processes for compression processing, prior to compression processing. As for band division, conventional ATRAC divided it into three bands (low band up to 5Ω.5ΩkHz, middle band from 5Ω.5ΩkHz to 11ΩkHz, and high band from 11ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) and passed it to the next circuit. However, ATRAC3Ωdivided it into four bands (high band divided into 11ΩkHz to 16Ω.5ΩkHz and 16Ω.5ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) to allow extra processing space. Spectrum blocking is divided into 1Ω,024Ωsamples, which is twice as large as ATRAC, and employs a circuit configuration that recognizes the signal more finely and compresses it. In MD, data consisting of one pair of Lch and Rch is recorded alternately at a fixed time interval (11Ω.6Ωms in ATRAC). ATRAC3Ωcontrols the content of signal processing precisely every 1Ωms so that appropriate signal processing can continue even when the nature of music suddenly changes. Furthermore, ATRAC3Ωhas a new step called tone component separation, which extracts tone components and encodes (compresses) them separately from other components in order to maintain high sound quality. The MDLP has two modes : LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode, which enables recording at twice the disc recording time, and LP4Ωstereo recording mode, which enables recording at four times the disc recording time. The LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode reflects the high compression ratio of ATRAC3Ωand is suitable for long-duration music recording and playback. The ATRAC DSP employs a Type-R DSP for ATRAC with twice the signal processing capability of the conventional DSP. In addition, the Intelligent Bit Re-Location Algorithm makes full use of the increased processing capability and re-analyzes the spectrum converted music data to search for minute levels of redundant bit allocation that have been difficult to find until now, and redistributes the bits preferentially to the frequency bands that are important for the listener. This further refines the bit allocation and makes it closer to the waveform of the original music source. By introducing wide bit stream technology, the dynamic range of the core ATRAC DSP and the audio data word length of peripheral circuits such as digital in / out have been increased from 16Ωbits to more bits, enabling recording and playback with a wide dynamic range. It is equipped with the MDLP mode, which is an improvement of the ATRAC audio compression technology and realizes about twice the compression performance of the conventional system. ATRAC reduces the data size by eliminating sound components that are hard to hear. ATRAC3Ω, which is used in the MDLP mode, further improves the compression ratio while minimizing degradation of sound quality. As one example, we have adopted a data encoding method called Huffman coding, which focuses on the frequency of data occurrence. Shorter codes are assigned to frequently occurring data sequences, and longer codes are assigned to infrequently occurring data sequences to improve compression efficiency. In addition, in order to maintain high sound quality even with high compression, we are also improving the accuracy of band division and spectrum blocking, which are pre-processes for compression processing, prior to compression processing. As for band division, conventional ATRAC divided it into three bands (low band up to 5Ω.5ΩkHz, middle band from 5Ω.5ΩkHz to 11ΩkHz, and high band from 11ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) and passed it to the next circuit. However, ATRAC3Ωdivided it into four bands (high band divided into 11ΩkHz to 16Ω.5ΩkHz and 16Ω.5ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) to allow extra processing space. Spectrum blocking is divided into 1Ω,024Ωsamples, which is twice as large as ATRAC, and employs a circuit configuration that recognizes the signal more finely and compresses it. In MD, data consisting of one pair of Lch and Rch is recorded alternately at a fixed time interval (11Ω.6Ωms in ATRAC). ATRAC3Ωcontrols the content of signal processing precisely every 1Ωms so that appropriate signal processing can continue even when the nature of music suddenly changes. Furthermore, ATRAC3Ωhas a new step called tone component separation, which extracts tone components and encodes (compresses) them separately from other components in order to maintain high sound quality. The MDLP has two modes : LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode, which enables recording at twice the disc recording time, and LP4Ωstereo recording mode, which enables recording at four times the disc recording time. The LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode reflects the high compression ratio of ATRAC3Ωand is suitable for long-duration music recording and playback. The LP4Ωstereo recording (playback) mode uses a compression method that allocates a large number of bits for center localization signals (vocals, bass, etc.), which play an important role in music signals. By reducing the amount of data to be recorded, the LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode even longer recording times. The MDLP cannot be recorded or played with the conventional model because the data allocation on the disk is different from the conventional format. However, the MDLP compatible model can record or play with the conventional format. Also, high-speed recording in the MDLP format is up to 2Ωx speed, and S. F Edit cannot be performed on discs recorded in the MDLP format. The S. F Edit (Scale Factor Edit) function allows you to adjust the volume and fade in / out after recording. The scale factor is a parameter that represents the peak above the level of a 52Ω-part floating unit. You can adjust the volume by changing this value. With this function, even if the recording level of a disc becomes uneven, you can adjust it later. This function reads the recorded data from the disc, edits the data, and writes it back to the disc. It is equipped with a sampling rate converter that automatically converts 32ΩkHz and 48ΩkHz sampling frequency to 44Ω.1ΩkHz.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses an R-core transformer with no gaps in the core of the transformer and a circular doughnut type in cross section to greatly reduce magnetic flux leakage and vibration. It is equipped with a time machine recording function, and if you press the multi-jog dial in the recording pause state, you can record up to 6Ωseconds before the sound on the disc. It is equipped with a monaural recording and playback function that allows you to use the MD twice as long as the display. You can DIVIDE, COMBINE, and MOVE songs, and it also has an UNDO function to cancel the last edit operation if you make a mistake. It is equipped with a rehearse function that allows you to check edit points in COORDINATE or DIVIDE. To move an edit point, you can fine-tune the DIVIDE edit point up to -128Ωsteps to + 127Ωsteps (one step is approximately 0Ω.06Ωseconds). Equipped with an A-B ERASE function that allows you to erase between two specified points in a song. It is equipped with a title function that can record up to 1Ω,700Ωcharacters of disc names and song titles on the disc. In addition to alphabets, numbers and symbols, katakana characters are also supported. You can input characters from the FOMA phone or remote controller during recording or playback. It is equipped with a smart space function that automatically adjusts the non-recording portion of digital recording to approximately 3Ωseconds. A compact card type remote controller is included. The SCMS (Serial Copy Management System) allows digital recording only for one generation and does not allow digital recording for the second or later generations. However, some programs from CS broadcasting cannot be recorded. You cannot import music data from the MD deck to a PC via the PC Link Kit."

## Description

"A 280Ωmm wide MD deck with MDLP mode. The ATRAC DSP employs a Type-R DSP for ATRAC with twice the signal processing capability of the conventional DSP. In addition, the Intelligent Bit Re-Location Algorithm makes full use of the increased processing capability and re-analyzes the spectrum converted music data to search for minute levels of redundant bit allocation that have been difficult to find until now, and redistributes the bits preferentially to the frequency bands that are important for the listener. This further refines the bit allocation and makes it closer to the waveform of the original music source. By introducing wide bit stream technology, the dynamic range of the core ATRAC DSP and the audio data word length of peripheral circuits such as digital in / out have been increased from 16Ωbits to more bits, enabling recording and playback with a wide dynamic range. It is equipped with the MDLP mode, which is an improvement of the ATRAC audio compression technology and realizes about twice the compression performance of the conventional system. ATRAC reduces the data size by eliminating sound components that are hard to hear. ATRAC3Ω, which is used in the MDLP mode, further improves the compression ratio while minimizing degradation of sound quality. As one example, we have adopted a data encoding method called Huffman coding, which focuses on the frequency of data occurrence. Shorter codes are assigned to frequently occurring data sequences, and longer codes are assigned to infrequently occurring data sequences to improve compression efficiency. In addition, in order to maintain high sound quality even with high compression, we are also improving the accuracy of band division and spectrum blocking, which are pre-processes for compression processing, prior to compression processing. As for band division, conventional ATRAC divided it into three bands (low band up to 5Ω.5ΩkHz, middle band from 5Ω.5ΩkHz to 11ΩkHz, and high band from 11ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) and passed it to the next circuit. However, ATRAC3Ωdivided it into four bands (high band divided into 11ΩkHz to 16Ω.5ΩkHz and 16Ω.5ΩkHz to 22ΩkHz) to allow extra processing space. Spectrum blocking is divided into 1Ω,024Ωsamples, which is twice as large as ATRAC, and employs a circuit configuration that recognizes the signal more finely and compresses it. In MD, data consisting of one pair of Lch and Rch is recorded alternately at a fixed time interval (11Ω.6Ωms in ATRAC). ATRAC3Ωcontrols the content of signal processing precisely every 1Ωms so that appropriate signal processing can continue even when the nature of music suddenly changes. Furthermore, ATRAC3Ωhas a new step called tone component separation, which extracts tone components and encodes (compresses) them separately from other components in order to maintain high sound quality. The MDLP has two modes : LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode, which enables recording at twice the disc recording time, and LP4Ωstereo recording mode, which enables recording at four times the disc recording time. The LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode reflects the high compression ratio of ATRAC3Ωand is suitable for long-duration music recording and playback. The LP4Ωstereo recording (playback) mode uses a compression method that allocates a large number of bits for center localization signals (vocals, bass, etc.), which play an important role in music signals. By reducing the amount of data to be recorded, the LP2Ωstereo recording (playback) mode even longer recording times. The MDLP cannot be recorded or played with the conventional model because the data allocation on the disk is different from the conventional format. However, the MDLP compatible model can record or play with the conventional format. Also, high-speed recording in the MDLP format is up to 2Ωx speed, and S. F Edit cannot be performed on discs recorded in the MDLP format. The S. F Edit (Scale Factor Edit) function allows you to adjust the volume and fade in / out after recording. The scale factor is a parameter that represents the peak above the level of a 52Ω-part floating unit. You can adjust the volume by changing this value. With this function, even if the recording level of a disc becomes uneven, you can adjust it later. This function reads the recorded data from the disc, edits the data, and writes it back to the disc. It is equipped with a sampling rate converter that automatically converts 32ΩkHz and 48ΩkHz sampling frequency to 44Ω.1ΩkHz.
